dkar chagashis brjod/ 13sngonagleng / 17dpe skrun gsal ngayand/ 19byang chub lam gyi sgron ma/ 23byang chub lam gyi sgron ma'i 'grel pa byang chub lam gyi snang ba rab tu gsal ba/dang po bshad bya'i yan lag 32gnyis pa gdams pa dngos kyi don/ 34/1/ mtshan gyi don/ 34/2/ 'gyur gyi phyag 35/3/ gzhung gi don/ 35(1) mchod par brjod cing bshad par dam bca' ba 35(2) gzhung dngos bshad pa/ 37/11 skyes bu gsum gyi rnam gzhag mdor bstan pa/ 37121 de dag gi lam gyi mtshan nyid so sor bshad pa/ 44/1/ skyes bu chung ngu'i mtshan nyid/ 45/2/ skyes bu 'bring gi mtshan nyid/ 46

4 dkar chag /3/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan nyid/ 49(1) mdor bstan pa/ 49(2) skyes bu chen po'i lam rgyas par bshad pa/ 50/11 pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam rgyas par bshad pa/ 50/1/lam gyi rnam gzhag bshad pa/ 50(1) bshad par dam bca' ba 50(2) lam yang dag pa nyid bshad pa/ 51rdo1〉 smon pa bslab bya dang bcas pa bshad pa/ 51(1) sbyor ba/ 51(11 tshogs gsog pa/ 51(21 skyabs 'gro khyad par can bya ba/ 53(31 sems gsum la blo sbyong ba/ 55(2) dngos gzhi/ 56(3) mjug bslab byar slob tshul/ 57(11 phan yon dran pa la bslab pa/ 57(21 byang chub kyi sems sbyang ba la bslab pa/ 58(31 byenags gnyis bsag pa la bslab pa/ 60(41 sems can blos mi spang ba la bslab pa/ 61(51 dkar nag chos brgyad blang dor byed tshul la bslab pa/ 61

dkar chag 5/2/ 'i〈cog pa bslab bya dang bcas pa bshad pa/ 61(1) mtshams sbyar te 'jug sdom blang bar bstan pa/ 61(2) 'jug sdom ji ltar len pa'i tshul/ 62/11 gang gis len pa'i rten/ 62(21 gang las blang pa'i yul/ 64(31 ji ltar len pa'i cho ga 64(1) bla ma yod pa'i cho ga 65(2) bla ma med pa'i cho ga 65 spyi bye brag gi sgo nas lung bzhin bshad par dam bca' ba/ 652 mdo de las byung ba'i sems bskyed dang sdom pa bzung tshul/ 67/11 sems bskyed/ 67(21 sdom pa bzung tshul/ 67(1) nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims khas len pa/ 68(2) sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims khas len pa/ 69(3) dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims khas len pa/ 69(3) sdom pa blangs nas bslab bya la bslab par bstan pa/ 70(11 tshul khrims kyi bslab pa la slob tshul/ 70(1) dngos/ 70(2) de'iche ba/ 71

6 dkar chag(21 sems kyi bslab pa la slob tshul/ 72(1) mngon shes 'byung ba'i rgyu'i phyir zhi gnas la bslab pa/ 72(2) zhi gnas la ji ltar bslab tshul dngos/ 74 zhi gnas kyi tshogs brten pa/ 742 zhi gnas ji ltar sgom pa'i tshul/ 753 zhi gnas sgom pa'i phan yon/ 76(31 shes rab kyi bslab pa la slob tshul/ 76(1) thabs shes zung 'brel gyi sgo nas lhag mthong la bslab par bstan pa/ 76(11 lhag mthong shes rab la slob dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ 76(21 thabs shes zung 'brel la slob dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ 78(31 zung du 'brel ba'i lam dngos bshad pa/ 79 mdor bstan pa/ 792 rgyas par bshad pa/ 79(11 thabs ngos gzung ba/ 79/21 de goms pa'i dgos pa/ 80(31 shes rab ngos gzung ba/ 80(2) lhag mthong la ji ltar slob pa'i tshul/ 81/11 rgyas par bshad pa/ 81(1) lhag mthong gi tshogs brten pa/ 81

dkar chag 7(13 rigs pa la brten pa bsam byung gi shes rab/ 81 'bras bu la dpyod pa yod med skye 'gog gi gtan tshigs/ 822 rgyu la dpyod pa rdo rje zegs ma'i gtan tshigs/ 833 ngo bo la dpyod pa gcig du bral gyi gtan tshigs/ 84(21 lung la brten pa thos byung gi shes rab bstan pa/ 85(2) lhag mthong sgom tshul/ 89(3) lhag mthong bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu/ 91 (11 dngos kyi don/ 91(21 de nyid lung gis bsgrub pa/ 91/21 masdo ga bsdu ba/ 93/2〉 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag bshad pa/ 94(21 sngags la 'jug pa'i tshul mdo tsam bstan pa/ 94/1/ rdo rje theg pa la 'jug pas dbang thob dgos par bstan pa/ 94(1) rten gyi gang zag 95(2) de la smin byed kyi dbang bskur ba/ 96(3) dbang bskur ba'i che ba bstan pa/ 97/2〉 rten gyi khyad par gyis dbang gong ma gnyis rung mi rung gi tshul/ 97/3/ de gnyis ma thob na rgyud nyan bshad sogs rung mi rung dpyad pa/ 99(3) rgyu gang la brten nas brtsams pa 99

8 dkar chag(4) mjug gi don/ 100(1) gang gis mdzad pa/ 100(2) sus bsgyur ba/ 101lam ga3rto rnam gsum/ 103lam gtso rnam gsum gyi tshig 'grel skal bzang thar pa'i 'jug ngogs/dang po bstan bcos 'chad pa'i yan lag mtshon tsam smos pa/ 106gnyis pa tshad mar gyur pa'i bstan bcos dngos bshad pa/ 108/1/ klad kyi don/ 108/11 mchod par brjod pa/ 108/21 brtsam par dam bca' ba 109/31 mnyan par bskul ba/ 110/2/ gzhung gi don/ 111(1) nges 'byung bshad pa/ 111(1)nges 'byung 'tshol dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ 111(2)nges 'byung bskyed pa'i thabs 113/11 tshe 'di'i snang shas ldog thabs/ 114/21 phyi ma'i snang shas ldog thabs/ 122

dkar chag 9(3)nges 'byung skyes pa'i tshad bshad pa/ 128(2) byang chub kyi sems bshad pa/ 129/11 byang chub kyi sems bskyed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ 1 29121 byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa'i thabs 133(3) yang dag pa'i lta ba bshad pa/ 136(11 yang dag pa'i lta ba 'tshol dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ 136/21 btsal ba'i lta ba dngos bstan pa/ 141(1) lta ba dathorngos bstan pa/ 141(11 snang stong dbyer med du rtogs na rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam la zhugs pa/ 141/21 snang stong so sor 'dzin na rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ma rtogs par bstan pa/ 146(2) lta ba rgyud la skyes pa'i tshad/ 149 (3) lta ba'i khyad chos/ 152/3/ mjug gi don/ 155/11 nyams su blang bar bskul ba/ 155/21 rtsom pa mthar phyin pa'i bya ba/ 162shes bya kun khyab mdzod las man ngag lugs kyi blo ldog rnam bzhi khol du phyung ba/ rdo1〉 thos bsam gyi lag rjes spyir bstan pa/ 165

10 dkar chag/2/ blo ldog rnam bzhi bye brag tu dbye ba/ 166/11 tshe 'di las blo ldog pa/ 166(1) blo ldog sgom pa'i rten dal 'byor rnyed dka' bsam pa 166(2) blo ldog dngos mi rtag pa bsam pa 170 'jig rten 'dir ring du mi gnas par 'chi ba rjes su dran pa/ 1702 'jig rten gzhan du ji ltar 'gyur ba'i tshul la bsam pa 171(21 'khor ba las blo ldog pa/ 173(1) bde sdug gi rgyu las 'bras bsam pa 173 las 'bras spyir bsam pa 1742 lci yang rbedugs bye brag tu bsam pa/ 176(2) 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam pa 182sdu/ga bsngal brgyad/ 1822 spyi'i sdug bsngal bsam pa 185/31 zhi bde las blo ldog pa/ 187/41 gzung 'dzin las blo ldog pa/ 193blo sbyong don bdun ma/ 197theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong don bdun ma'i khrid yig byang chub gzhung lam/dang po brgyud pa'i byung khungs/ 200

dkar chag 11gnyis pa spyi'i dgos don/ 201gsum pa khrid gzhung dngos 'chad pa/ 202/1/ gzhung khrid dngos 'chad pa/ 202/11 sngon 'gro rten gyi chos bstan pa/ 203(1) thun gyi sngon 'gro/ 203(2) khrid kyi sngon 'gro/ 203/21 dngos gzhi byang chub kyi sems sbyong ba/ 204(1)don dam byang sems zhar byung du bsgom pa/ 204 thun la balha/ma pa/ 2042 thun mtshams la balha/ma pa/ 206(2)kun rdzob byang sems gtso bor bsgom pa/ 206 sbyor ba/ 2062 dngos gzhi/ 2073 thun mtshams kyi chos/ 209/31 rkyen ngan byang chub kyi lam du bsgyur ba/ 210(1)kun trerdob byang sems la brten pa/ 210(2) don dam byang sems la brten pa/ 213(3) spyod pa khyad par can la brten pa/ 213

12 dkar chag/41 tshe gcig gi nyams len dril nas bstan pa/ 215 tshe 'dir ji ltar bya ba/ 2162 'chi khar ji ltar bya ba/ 217/51 blo 'byongs pa'i tshad/ 218(61 blo sbyong gi dam tshig 220/71 blo sbyong gi bslab bya/ 225ṭ+wāṃ2/ brgyud pa'i gdams pas kha skong ba/ 234blo sbyong brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dad pa'i gdung sel/ 241blo sbyong smon lam byang sems rgya mtsho'i 'jug ngogs/ 243dpe skrun smon tshig 247

—— ———— /sdeshāsnyesgroṣ+ṭha 76spre5 — paske /d+ku//ldom mgon bla brang nas gsung rab spyi dang bye brag sgrubs rje 'ardzamamagon kong sprul /rin po che dang /gang gi ring lugasasgrub brgyud kai paṃ pa'i dpe sa nye bar mkho yang rnyed son dka' ba'i rigs blo grosamatha' yas pa'i mdzod cesapa'i deb phreng gi rnam par don gnyer can rnams kyi dpal du gsar bzhengs zhu ba'i lasarim la rjesasu yi rang dang /kun / tu spyod pa 'dis tsos chen sa ba'i bsnyan par bya ba byed pa'i mig dper wīr zhing /wom mgon bla ma'i phrin lasargyasapa'i mthun rkyen du 'gyur ba'i re smon ṣ+ṭhas/kame pa o rgyan phrin lasardo rjes/nang lo 2551phyi lo 2007zla 8pa'i tshes27la/

)sam60glu50sī'u1skupuji2rke2sas 'u༄tsho/ /sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad nyid bdag sogs snyigs ma'i 'gro la rjes su chags pas bsam bzhin mi'i gar du gang gdul gyi rnam par rol pas 'gro ba 'dren pa'i mdzad bzang gis mjes pa'i skyes rabs phreng bar bstar ba las/ bdag cag rnams kyi me tog gang la phog pa'i lha skal 7skyabs rje 'jam mgon rin po che sku phreng gsum pa mchog gi bstan 'gror sman pa'i bzhed dgongs bla med du mar mchis la/ gus 'bangs gang gi zhabs 'bring du 'khod pa rnams kyis 7skyabs rje dam pa mchog gi mdzad 'phrin dgung du 'degs pa'i srid zhur rlom nas/ sgo gsum 'jug pa gcig 'dril gyi 'bad pas dgongs 'char 'khod pa'i mdzad 'a phrin gyi cha shas 'ga' zhig rags rim nas bsgrubs zin pa'i khul yin zhing / mdzad don lhag mar lus pa rnams las gtso bo zhig ni spyir ris med kyi gsung rab dang lhag par rang re bka' brgyud pa'i gsung rab med du mi rung ba rnams dus 'gyur gyi pho nyas lkog tu sbas pas dpe rgyun dkon zhing phal cher nub la nye ba rnams 'tshol sgrub kyis srung skyob bstan pa nam gnas su byed pa'i dpe mdzod tshad du 'khyol ba zhig dang / de'i yan lag tu gsung rab de dag don gnyer can yongs la 'grems spel khyab brdal du bya ba'i gsung rab dpe skrun sde tshan zhig 'dzugs skrun gnang rgyu'i thugs 'dun drag po yod pa ma tshad 7skyabs rje nyid la bod nas phyag dpe mi nyung ba tsam phyag son byung zin pa sogs mdzad 'char de dus nas dbu ku〈byegs mdzad pa lags/

de ltar 7skyabs rje dam pa mchog gi bzhed don gtso bor gnas pa bzhin gus 'bangs rnams nas kyang de nyid bsgrub bya'i gtso bor bzung nas 'bad rtsol nus 'tshams zhig bsten kyang dpal 'byor dang zhu sgrig pa sogs kyi mthun rkyen ma tshang ba'i rkyen gyis bsam sbyor don thog tu ma 'khel bar da bar rim lus su gyur/ da cha mgon po gang gi thugs bskyed dus su sad pas gnas mi longs spyod sogs gang 'thad nas mthun rkyen legs tshogs kyis gom bgrod mdun bskyod thub tsam byung ba las brtas pa'i dga' spro ni bdag cag rnams kyi 'tsho ba'i snying por khustin+da/34rnga5/des na da lan sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i gtsug rgyan 7rgyal dbang karma pa tse( rgyan 'gro 'dul 'phrin las rdo rje mchog la gsol ba btab don bzhin spar skrun gyi mtshan byang du blo gros mtha' yas pa'i mdzod kyi deb phreng zhes pa dang / deb phreng 'di yi sngon brjod thugs smon zab rgyas kyis brjed pa bka' drin bskyangs pas dbu btsugs te gsung rab deb phreng du spel ba'i las 'char 'di bzhin spel ba lags/ rnam dkar gyi bgyi ba 'di nyid kyi 'bras bur bstan 'gror sman pa rlabs chen rgya che rgyun mi chad du 'byung bas mgon po gang gi thugs dgongs yongs su rdzogs pa'i sgrub mchod dam par gyur te/ bdag sogs 'di nas byang chub bar thugs rje'i ra gur las mi 'dor bar tshe rabs kun tu zhabs rdul spyi bor bsten pa'i skal bzang rgyun ldan las thugs yid gcig 'dres kyis dpal ldan bla ma'i go 'phang dam pa thob pa'i smon 'dun rtse gcig bcas deb phreng 'grems spel gyi ngo sprod du/ 'jam mgon bla brang gi phyag mdzod bstan 'dzin rdo rjes spyi lo 2008zla 1 tshes 7 nyin/

dpe skrun gsal nga5nad/༄7/ /rang re gangs can gyi ljongs su chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum gyi sku ring la rgyal bstan mdo sngags yongs su rdzogs pa gser gyi yang zhun ltar dag cing khyab brdal du dar ba sprul pa'i lo paṇa dang rgyal blon rnams kyi sku drin las byung yod kyang / glang dar ma'i dus su sdig pa'i rgyal blon 'gas bod yul dbus su rgyal bstan ming gi lhag mar byas nas nyams nyes par gyur/ ring zhig na chos rgyal byang chub sems dpa'i rigs su 'khrungs pa'i bod kyi dpal mgon dam pa lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis rgyal srid chos bzhin bskyangs/ gtsug lag khang gsar du bzhengs/ byis pa blo rno ba kun lo tsā slob tu mngags/ paṇ+ḍi ta mang du spyan drangs te lo chen rin bzang sogs kyis gsung rab mang du bsgyur ba nas bstan pa phyi dar gyi 'go brtsams/ de'i dus bstan pa'i chom rkun rku thabs su gnas pas bstan pa la gzu lum dang ras bcos byas pa yang mang du byung bas/ gsang sngags log par spyod cing 'khrig pa dang 'tshe ba chos su smra ba sogs kyis rgyal bstan shin tu rnyogs pas dwangs snyigs 'byed dka' ba'i gnas su gyur/ gnas stangs der lha bla ma khu dbon rnam gnyis thugs kyis ma bzod par rgyal bstan dag spel bya bar 'phags yul nas jo bo rje spyan 'dren pa'i yon du gser 'tshol bar mtha' 'khob yul du phyin pa'i rkyen las lha bla ma ye shes 'od gar log rgyal pos btson du bzung / de'i tshe dbon po byang chub 'od kyis sku'i bong tshod dang mnyam pa'i gser 'jal nas gang gi sku srog blu bar 'dod pa na/ lha bla ma ye

20 dpe skrun gsal bshad/shes 'od kyi zhal nas bstan 'gror phan nus med pa'i lus rgas shing 'khogs pa 'dir zhen pa rtsa rtse tsam med pas blos btang nas blu yon gyi gser des rgya gar nas jo bo rje gdan drangs te rgyal bstan dag spel gyis 'gro kun phan bder 'god pa'i don chen 'grub na bsam pa rdzogs pa yin gsungs nas sku srog blu ru ma gnang zhing / tshul 'di dag jo bo'i snyan du gsol te nges par khong bod du gdan drangs nas bstan 'gror sman pa zhig ci nas kyang bya dgos zhes zhal chems bstsal/ de'i rkyen gyis lha bla ma byang chub 'od kyis skyo snang tshad med ngang spyan chab bsnyi/la bzhin nag 'tsho lo tsā bar dgos pa rgyu mtshan rnams bgrangs te rgya gar nas jo bo spyan 'dren par mngags/ lo tsā ba rang nyid 'phags yul nas phyir log ma thag pa yin kyang bka' bstsal ji phebs la ngo ldog byed thabs bral te tal mar 'phags yul du phyir bskyod kyis lo ngo lnga'i ring dka' spyad thabs tshul du mas jo bo bod du spyan drangs shing chos rgyal byang chub sems dpa' khu dbon 'das gson gnyis ka'i thugs dgongs rdzogs par mdzad/de nas lha/ bla ma ye shes 'od kyis jo bo rje'i snyan du bod du bab col 'dra min gyis rgyal bsta/na nyams nyes par gyur ba'i tshul rnams zhib par gsol nas/ bla ma nyid kyis ji ltar thugs nyams su bzhes pa bzhin theg pa chen po'i don mtha' dag tshang la chig nyung ba/ bstan pa'i dwangs snyigs legs par phyes pa'i bstan bcos mdzad par bskul bas/ dpal ldan jo bo rje a ti shas lugs gzhan las khyad par du 'phags shing brjod bya yongs su rdzogs pa dang / lag tu blang bde la skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa ma tshang ba med pa sogs khyad chos du mas mdzes pa'i bstan bcos byang chub lam gyi sgron ma rang 'grel dang bcas pa gangs can

dpe skrun gsal bshad/ 21bstan 'gro'i gsos su brtsams par mdzad/ de nas bzung bstan bcos de nyid kyi snying po bcud du phyung ba rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyis rje ba tsun grags pa rgyal mtshan la gnang ba zhen pa bzhi bral gyi gdams pa/ rje tsong kha pas mdzad pa'i lam gtso rnam gsum/ de dag gi brjod don gtso bo byang chub kyi sems rnam gnyis sgom pas nyams su len tshul gyi man ngag mchog tu gyur pa dge ba'i gshes gnyen bya 'chad kha ba ye shes rdo rje'i gsung theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong don bdun ma bcas rim par byung yod/ chos tshul kun la spyan ras kyi dag snang yangs pa'i ris med bstan pa'i bdag po rje 'jam mgon kong sprul blo gros mtha' yas mchog gis zhen pa bzhi bral gyi don 'a grel du blo ldog rnam bzhi'i gzhung rtsa 'grel rang rkang dang gzhan gsum la tshig 'grel gnad bsdus shing go sla bar mdzad pa thog mar thos pas sgro 'dogs gcod/ bar du bsam pas nges shes skyes/ mtha' mar sgom pas nyams su blang ba bcas kyi go rim du gnas pa bzhin deb phreng 'dir yang dkyus su lag len bde ba'i ched du dmigs te bkod nas par 'grems zhu ba lags kyang / bdag cag rnams la rtsom sgrig zhu dag gang ci'i shes myong zhan pas gnong ba ci mchis rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyis spyan sngar mthol bshags dang chabs cig dge 'don skyon sel gyi dgongs 'char lam ston lhug stso la yong ba'i re skul bcas bstan pa'i zhabs 'degs 'bad pa chung ngu 'dis kyang don gnyer can gang gi thugs rgyud la shes rab gsum gyi snang ba bde blag tu bskyed pas sa lam gyi rim pa brgal te bla med byang chub tu bgrod thub pa'i smon 'dun zhu/ rig pa'i rdo rje gtsug lag slob gnyer khang yig gsog dang rtsom sgrig sde tshan nas 2008 zla 5 tshes 24 nyin/

byang chub lam gyi sgron ma/rgya gar skad du/ bo dhi pa tha pra dī paṃ/ bod skad du/ byang chub lam gyi sgron ma/ byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad dag dang de yi chos/ /dge 'dun rnams la gus pa chen pos phyag byas te/ /slob ma bzang po byang chub 'od kyis bskul gyur pas/ /bya nga chub lam gyi sgron ma rab tu gsal bar bya/ /chung ngu 'bring dang mchog gyur pas/ /skyes bu gsum du shes par bya/ /de dag mtshan nyid rab gsal ba'i/ /so so'i dbye ba bri bar bya/ /gang zhig thabs ni gang dag gis/ /'khor ba'i bde ba tsam dag la/ /rang nyid don du gnyer byed pa/ /de ni skyes bu tha mar shes/ /srid pa'i bde la rgyab phyogs shing / /sdig pa'i las las ldog bdag nyid/ /gang zhig rang zhi tsam don gnyer/ /skyes bu de ni 'bring zhes bya/ /rang rgyud gtogs pa'i sdug bsngal gyis/ /gang zhig gzhan gyi sdug bsngal kun/ /yang dag zad par kun nas 'dod/ /skyes bu de ni mchog yin no/ /sems can dam pa byang chub mchog /'dod par gyur pa de dag la/ /bla ma rnams kyis bstan pa yi/ /yang dag thabs ni bshad par bya/ /rdzogs sangs bris sku la sogs dang / /mchod rten dam chos mngon phyogs nas/ /me tog bdug spos dngos po dag /ci 'byor pa yis mchod par bya/ /kun bzang spyod las gsungs pa yi/ /mchod pa rnam pa bdun dag kyang / /byang chub snying po'i mthar thug bar/ /mi ldog pa yi sems dag gis/ /dkon mchog gsum la rab dad cing / /pus mo'i lha nga sar btsugs nas/ /thal mo sbyar bar byas nas

24 dpal mar me mdzad ye shes/ni/ /dang po skyabs 'gro lan gsum bya/ /de nas sems can thams cad la/ /byams pa'i sems ni sngon 'gro bas/ /ngan song gsum dang skye sogs dang / /'chi 'pho sogs kyis sdug bsngal ba'i/ /'gro ba ma lus la bltas te/ /sdug bsngal gyis ni sdug bsngal ba/ /sdug bsngal sdug bsngal rgyu mtshan las/ /'gro ba thar bar 'dod pa yis/ /ldog pa med par dam bca' ba'i/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bya/ /de ltar smon pa'i sems dag ni/ /bskyed pa'i yon tan gang yin pa/ /de ni sdong po bkod pa yi/ /mdo las byams pas rab tu bshad/ /de yis mdo klog pa'am bla ma las mnyan te/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems kyi yon tan mtha' med pa/ /rnam par shes par byas la de gnas rgyu mtshan du/ /de ltar yang nas yang du sems ni bskyed par bya/ /dpal sbyin gyis zhus mdo dag las/ /de yi bsod nams rab bstan pa/ /gang tshe tshigs bcad gsum tsam du/ /mdor bsdus pa ni 'dir bri bya/ /byang chub sems kyi bsod nams gang / /de la gal te gzugs mchis na/ /nam mkha'i khams ni kun bkang ste/ /de ni de bas lhag par 'gyur/ /gaṅgā'i bye ma'i grangs snyed kyi/ /sangs rgyas zhing rnams mi gang gis/ /rin chen dag gis kun bkang ste/ /'jig rten mgon la phul ba bas/ /gang gis thal mo sbyar bgyis te/ /byang chub tu ni sems btud na/ /mchod pa 'di ni khyad par 'phags/ /de la mtha' ni ma mchis so/ /byang chub smon pa'i sems dag bskyed nas ni/ /'bad pa mang pos kun tu spel bya zhing / /'di ni skye ba gzhan du'ang dran don du/ /ji skad bshad pa'i bslab pa'ang yongs su bsrung / /'jug sems bdag nyid sdom pa ma gtogs par/ /yang dag smon pa 'phel bar 'gyur ma yin/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sdom pa spel 'dod pas/ /de phyir 'bad pas 'di ni nges par blang / /so sor thar

byang chub lam gyi sgron ma/ 25pa ris bdun gyi/ /rtag tu sdom gzhan ldan pa la/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa yi/ /skal ba yod kyi gzhan du min/ /so sor thar pa rigs bdun du/ /de bzhin gshegs pas bshad pa la/ /tshangs spyod dpal ni mchog yin te/ dge slong sdom pa dag tu bzhed/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sa dag gi /tshul khrims le'u gsungs cho ga yis/ /yang dag mtshan nyid ldan pa yi/ /bla ma bzang las sdom pa blang / /sdom pa'i cho ga la mkhas dang / /bdag nyid gang zhig sdom la gnas/ /sdom pa 'bogs bzod snying rjer ldan/ /bla ma bzang por shes par bya/ /de la 'bad pas 'di 'dra ba'i/ /gal te bla ma ma rnyed na/ /de las gzhan sdom nod pa yi/ /cho ga yang dag bshad par bya/ /de la sngon che 'jam pa'i dpal/ /e ba rā dzar gyur pa yis ji ltar byang chub thugs bskyed pa/ /'jam dpal gyi ni sangs rgyas zhing / /rgyan gyi mdo las bshad pa ltar/ /de bzhin 'dir ni rab gsal bri/ /mgon po rnams kyi spyan snga sa /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed cing / /'gro ba thams cad mgron du gnyer/ /de dag 'khor ba las sgrol lo/ /gnod sems khro ba'i sems nyid dang / /ser sna dang ni phrag dog nyid/ /deng nas bzung ste byang chub dag /'thob kyi bar du mi bya 'o/ /tshangs par spyod pa spyad bya zhing / /sdig dang 'dod pa spang bar bya/ /tshul khrims sdom pa la dga' bas/ /sangs rgyas rjes su bslab par bya/ /bdag nyid myur ba'i tshul gyis ni/ /byang chub thob par mi spro zhing / /sems can gcig gi rgyu yis ni/ /phyi ma'i mu mthar gnas par bya/ /tshad med bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /zhing dag rnam par sbyang bar bya/ /ming nas bzung ba byas pa dang / /phyogs bcu dag tu rnam par gnas/ /bdag gis lus dang ngag gi las/ /thams cad du ni dag par bya/ /yid kyi las kyang dag bya ste/ /mi dge'i las rnams mi

26 dpal mar me mdzad ye shes/bya 'o/ /rang gi lus ngag sems ni rnam dag rgyu/ /'jug pa'i sems kyis bdag nyid 〈snam gnas pas/ /tshul khrims bslab pa gsum la legs bslabs na/ /tshul khrims bslab pa gsum la gus cher 'gyur/ /de bas rnam dag rdzogs byang chub/ /sems dpa'i sdom pa'i sdom dag ni/ /'bad par byas pas rdzogs byang chub/ /tshogs ni yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur/ /bsod nams ye shes rang bzhin gyi/ /tshogs ni yongs su rdzogs pa yi/ /rgyu ni sangs rgyas thams cad dag /mngon shes bskyed pa nyid du bzhed/ /ji ltar 'dab gshog ma rgyas pa'i/ /bya ni mkha' la 'phur mi nus/ /de bzhin mngon shes stobs bral bas/ /sems can don byed nus pa min/ /mngon shes ldan pas nyin mtshan gyi/ /bsod nams dag ni gang yin de/ /mngon shes dag dang bral gyur la/ /skye ba brgyar yang yod ma yin/ /myur du rdzogs pa'i byang chub tshogs/ /yongs su rdzogs par 'dod gyur pa/ /des ni 'bad byas mngon shes dag /'grub par 'gyur gyi le los min/ /zhi gnas grub pa ma yin pas/ /mngon shes 'byung bar mi 'gyur la/ /de phyir zhi gnas bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /yang nas yang du 'bad par bya/ /zhi gnas yan lag rnams nyams pas/ /rab tu 'bad de bsgoms byas kyang / /lo ni stong phrag dag gis kyang / /ting 'dzin 'grub par mi 'gyur ro/ /de phyir ting 'dzin tshogs le'u las/ /gsungs pa'i yan lag la legs gnas/ /dmigs pa gang rung gcig dag la/ /yid ni dge la gzhag par bya/ /rnal 'byor zhi gnas grub gyur na/ /mngon shes dag kyang 'grub par 'gyur/ /shes rab pha rol phyin sbyor dang / /bral bas sgrib pa zad mi 'gyur/ /de phyir nyon mongs shes bya yi/ /sgrib pa ma lus spang ba'i phyir/ /shes rab pha rol phyin rnal 'byor/ /rtag tu thabs bcas bsgom par bya/ /thabs dang bral ba'i shes

byang chub lam gyi sgron ma/ 27 rab dang / /shes rab bral ba'i thabs dag kyang / /gang phyir 'ching ba zhes gsungs pa/ /de bas gnyis ka spang mi bya/ /shes rab gang dang thabs gang zhes/ /the tshom dag ni spang ba'i phyir/ /thabs rnams dang ni shes rab kyi/ /yang dag dbye ba gsal bar bya/ /shes rab pha rol phyin spangs pa'i/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin la sogs/ /dge ba'i chos rnams thams cad dag /rgyal ba rnams kyis thabs su bshad/ /thabs goms dbang gis bdag nyid kyis/ /gang zhig shes rab rnam sgom pa/ /des ni byang chub myur du thob/ /bdag med gcig pu sgom pas min/ /phung po khams dang skye mched rnams/ /skye ba med par rtogs gyur pa'i/ /rang bzhin stong nyid shes pa ni/ /shes rab ces ni yongs su bshad/ /yod pa skye ba rigs min te/ /med pa'ang nam mkha'i me tog bzhin/ /nyes pa gnyis kar thal 'gyur phyir/ /gnyis ka dag kyang 'byung ba min/ /dngos po rang las mi skye zhing / /gzhan dang gnyis ka las kyang min/ /rgyu med las min de yi phyir/ /ngo bo nyid kyis rang bzhin med/ /yang na chos rnams thams cad dag /gcig dang du mas rnam dpyad na/ /ngo bo nyid ni mi dmigs pas/ /rang bzhin med pa nyid du nges/ /stong nyid bdun cu'i rigs pa dang / /dbu ma rtsa ba sogs las kyang / /dngos po rnams kyi rang bzhin ni/ /stong pa nyid du grub bshad pa/ /gang phyir gzhung ni mang gyur pas/ /de phyir 'dir ni ma spros la/ /grub pa'i grub mtha' tsam zhig tu/ /bsgom pa'i don du rab tu bshad/ /de bas chos rnams ma lus pa'i/ /rang bzhin dag ni mi dmigs pas/ /bdag med pa ni sgom gang nyid/ /'di ni shes rab sgom pa yin/ /shes rab kyis ni chos rnams kun/ /gang gi rang bzhin ma mthong bzhin/ /shes rab de nyid rigs dpyad pa/ /rnam rtog med par de bsgom bya/ /rnam rtog las byung srid pa

28 dpal mar me mdzad ye shes/'di/ /rnam par rtog pa'i bdag nyid de/ /de phyir ma lus rtog spangs pa/ /mya ngan 'das pa mchog yin no/ /de ltar yang ni bcom ldan gyis/ /rnam rtog ma rig chen po ste/ /'bor ba'i rgya mtshor lhung bar byed/ /rtog med ting 'dzin la gnas pa/ /nam mkha' bzhin du rtog med gsal/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rnam par mi rtog pa la 'jug pa'i gzungs las kyang / /dam chos 'di la rgyal ba'i sras/ /rnam par mi rtog bsam gyur na/ /rnam rtog bgrod dka' rnams 'das te/ /rim gyis mi rtog 'thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /lung dang rigs pa dag gis ni/ /chos rnams thams cad skye med pa'i/ /rang bzhin med par nges byas nas/ /rnam par rtog med bsgom par bya/ /de ltar de nyid bsgoms byas na/ /rim gyis drod sogs thob byas nas/ /rab dga' la sogs 'thob 'gyur te/ /sangs rgyas byang chub yun mi ring / /sngags mthu nyid las grub pa yi/ /zhi dang rgyas sogs las rnams kyis/ /bum pa bzang grub la sogs pa'i/ /grub chen brgyad sogs stobs kyis kyang / /bde ba yis ni byang chub tshogs/ /yongs su rdzogs par 'dod pa dang / /bya ba spyod sogs rgyud gsungs pa'i/ /gal te gsang sngags spyod 'dod na/ /de tshe slob dpon dbang bskur phyir/ /bsnyen bkur rinachen sogs sbyin dang / /bka' bsgrub la sogs thams cad kyis/ /bla ma dam pa mnyes par bya/ /bla ma mnyes par gyur pa yis/ /yongs rdzogs slob dpon dbang bskur bas/ /sdig kun rnam dag bdag nyid ni/ /dngos grub bsgrub pa'i skal ldan 'gyur/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas rgyud chen las/ /rab tu 'bad pas bkag pa'i phyir/ /gsang ba shes rab dbang bskur ni/ /tshangs par spyod pas blang mi bya/ /gal te dbang bskur de 'dzin na/ /tshangs spyod dka' thub la gnas pas/ /bkag pa spyad par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ /dka' thub sdom pa de

byang chub lam gyi sgron ma/ 29nyams te/ /brtul zhugs can der pham pa yi/ /lhung ba dag ni 'byung 'gyur zhing / /de ni ngan song nges ltung bas/ /grub pa nam yang yod ma yin/ /rgyud kun nyan dang 'chad pa dang / /sbyin sreg mchod sbyin sogs byed pa/ /slob dpon dbang bskur brnyes gyur cing / /de nyid rig la nyes pa med/ /gnas brtan mar me mdzad dpal gyis/ /mdo sogs chos las bshad mthong ba/ /byang chub 'od kyis gsol btab nas/ /byang chub lam bshad mdor bsdus byas/ /byang chub lam gyi sgron ma slob dpon chen po dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //

byang chub lam gyi sgron ma'i 'grel pa snying por bsdus pa byang chub lam gyi snang ba rab tu gsal ba/༄7/ /bla ma shākya'i rgyal po'i zhabs la gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsod nams brgya ldan mtshan gyi me tog dpe byad mdzes pa'i ze'u 'bru chags/ /yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs kyi rnga sgras rigs gsum gdul byar thar lam ston/ /ye shes nam mkha'i me long ngos su shes bya'i gzugs brnyan ma 'dres gsal/ /bdag cag ston mchog bka' drin mnyam med snying nas dran no thugs rjes skyongs/ /sems mchog bskyedanas rgyun gyi mtha' bar lam zhugs sa la gnas rnams dang / /de dag gang las 'byung ba'i gnas gyur sems kyi dam pa rin chen te/ /de nyid ston byed dge ba gsum ldan legs gsung nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor la/ /dad cing mos pa'i yid kyi 'dab brgya yang srid kun tu grol gyur cig /mtha' yas sgyu 'phrul kha ba can ljongs su/ /thar lam ma nor ston mdzad rgyal ba'i sras/ / sa gsum grags pa'i rgyal mtshan mngon mtho ba/ /mgon po a ti sha la phyag bgyi'o/ /gang de'i brgyud 'dzin bka' rnams gdams ngag tu/ /ston pa'i ring lugs gsar rnying mu tig phreng / /

32 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/rnam thar gser gyi skud par brgyus de rnams/ /yid ches dad pas gtsug gi rgyan du bcings/ /thos pa tsam gyis srid las nges par 'byin/ / nyams su blangs pas gtan gyi 'dun ma 'grub/ /dri med be+eḍār+ya mtshungs rnam dag gzhung / /gangs can skye dgu'i spyi nor 'di ko rmad/ /yongs grags nyi zla lta bu'i bka' srol nyid/ /dam pa du mas shin tu gsal mdzad mod/ /rang mnyam blo gros bum chung 'geng sla ba'i/ /tshig 'grel bdud rtsi'i nying khu cung zad spel/ /'dir rgyal ba'i gsung rab thams cad kyi gnad bsdus pa/ shing rta chen po klu sgrub dang thogs med gnyis kyi lam srol/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sar 'gro ba'i skye bo mchog gi chos lugs/ skyes bu gsum gyis nyams su blang ba'i rim pa thams cad ma tshang ba med par bsdus pa byang chub lam gyi sgron ma 'chad pa la gnyis/bshad bya'i yan lag dang / gdams pa dngos kyi don no/ /dang po ni/ bi kra ma shī la'i mkhas pa rnams kyis chos khungs btsun par bstan pa'i phyir mdzad pa po'i che ba bstan pa/ gdams ngag la gus pa bskyed pa'i phyir chos kyi che ba bstan pa/ che ba gnyis dang ldan pa'i chos la nyan bshad ji ltar bya ba dang gsum sngon du gal che bar bzhed pa ltar 'dir yang cung zad bshad na/ dang

byang chub lam sgron gyi 'grel pa/ 33po gzhung 'di mdzad pa po ni/ bskal pa bzang po'i byang chub sems dpa' bsam bzhin du za hor gyi yul du rgyal rigs chen por sku zhabrungs shing sde snod gsum mang du mkhyen pa/ lung gi yon tan dang de tshul bzhin du bsgrubs pas rtogs pa'i yon tan mtha' dag brnyes nas/ rdo rje gdan byang chub chen po'i pho brang du mu stegs kyi smra ba ngan pa lan gsum du chos kyis pham par mdzad pa sogs rgya bod gnyis su sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bya ba rgya chen po mdzad cing / khyad par bod du phebs nas zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo mtha' yas pa bskor zhing /gzhung 'di nyid mdzad pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa'i srol nub pa rnams gsar du btsugs/ srol cung zad yod pa rnams gsal bar mdzad pas kun kyang mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi lam ma nor ba la dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas 'khrid par mdzad pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha zhes bya ba ste/ nag tsho lo tsā ba'i bstod pa brgyad cu pa las/jo bo bod du ma byon na/ /thams cad long ba bzhin du 'gyur/ /mkhyen pa rgyas pa khyod byon pas / /bod du ye shes nyi ma shar/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa chos kyi che ba ni/ sa gsum gyi sgron me gcig pu thub pa'i gsung rab thams cad kyi bcud bsdus pa/ shing rta chen po gnyis kyi lam srol/ brgyud pa'i chu bo gsum 'dres kyi man ngag mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi lam chen/ mdo dang

34 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/dgongs 'grel mtha' dag gi lde mig rgya bod kyi mkhas grub thams cad kyi gshegs shul/ skyes bu gsum gyis nyams su blang bya ma tshang ba med par ston pa'i gzhung byang chub lam gyi sgron ma zhes bya ba ste/ mdo sngags gnyis ka'i gnad bsdus pas brjod bya yongs su rdzogs pa dang / sems can 'dul ba'i rim pa gtso bor ston pas lag tu blang bde ba/ shing rta chen po gnyis kyi lugs la mkhas pa'i bla ma gnyis kyi gdams pas brgyan pas lugs gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa che ba gnyis dang ldan pa'i chos la nyan bshad ji ltar bya ba'i tshul ni/nyan pa'i tshul/ bshad pa'i tshul/ mjug tu thun mong du ji ltar bya ba'i tshul rnams te rgyas pa byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i khrid yig rnams las gsungs pa ltar shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa gdams pa dngos kyi don la gsum/ mtshan gyi don/ 'gyur gyi phyagagazhung gi don no/ /dang po r+ṣatshan gyi don )ni/gyogar skad du/ bo dhiwātha bra dī paṃ/ bodaskad du/ byang chub lam gyi sgron ma/zhes bya ba ste/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul na skad rigs chen po bzhi yod pa las legs sbyar skad du/ gzhung 'di'i mtshan la bo dhi patha pra di paṃ zhes pa/ bod kyi skad du/ byang chub lam gyi sgron ma zhes bya bar bsgyur la/ de yang bo dhi ni byang chub/patha ni lam/ pra dī paṃ ni sgron ma zhes bya ba'o/ /de la spangs rtogs mthar phyin pa'i bdag nyid can gyi sangs rgyas kyi ye shes ni sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa

byang chub lam sgron gyi 'grel pa/ 35ma lus pa byang zhing ji lta ji snyed kyi chos thams cad ma lus pa chub pas byang chub dang / der bgrod pa'i lam gyi gegs ma rtogs pa dang log par rtog pa dang the tshom gyi mun pa ma lus pa bsal nas sa bcu lam lnga'i rang bzhin gsal bar byed pa'i bstan bcos yin pas sgron ma zhes bya'o/ /de ltar bstan bcos bsgyur ba'i thog mar rgya skad smos pa ni chos khungs btsun par shes pa dang / lo paṇa rgyal blon rnams la byas shes drin gzo skye ba dang / saṃ skṛ ta'i skad la bag chags 'jog pa sogs kyi ched yin no/ /gnyis pa 'gyur phyag ni/byapachub semagadapa' 'jam dpal gzhon nurarnaṇa pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bya ba ste/ lo tsā bas 'gyur mdzad pa'i snga logs su byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo zhes bstan bcos 'di spyir rgyal ba'i bka' mtha' dag gi dgongs 'grel yin kyang gtso bor theg pa chen por mngon par shes pa dang / 'gyur mthar phyin pa sogs kyi ched du bkod pa'o/ /gsum pa gzhung gi don la bzhi/ mchod par brjod cing bshad par dam bca' ba/ gzhung dngos bshad pa/ rgyu gang la brten nas brtsams pa/ mjug gi don no/ /dang po (mchod par brjod cing bshad par dam bca' ba )ni/dusagasumargyal ba thamasacad dag dathade yi chos/ /dge 'dun rnamasal gusab chen posaphyag byasate/ /slob ma bzang po byang chub 'od kyisabaskul gyuraspras/ /byathachub lam gyi sgron ma rab skyogasal bar bya /

36 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/zhes bya ba ste/ bstan bcos rtsom pa'i thog mar gang la phyag bya ba'i yul phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rgyu sdig pa'i chos bcom zhing sdig 'bras bdud kyi g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba thams cad pa dag dang / de'i chos te rgyal ba de rnams kyis gsungs pa'i chos gsung rab lung gi tshogs dang / de nyams su len pa sgrub pa'i chos dang / de mngon du gyur pa rtogs pa'i chos rnams dang skyabs gnas dang dge ba la shes nas dad pa thob pas/ de dag la 'dun zhing dbye bar ma nus pas na dge 'dun te zhugs gnas brgyad dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sa la gnas pa ste/ yul de rnams la skyabs gnas kyi yon tan mthong ba'i thugs kyis drangs pa'i lus ngag gis gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal lo zhes phyag mdzad pas/ bgegs dang bar chad zhi nas rtsom pa mthar phyin pa dang / ya rabs dam pa'i spyod pa dang mthun pa dang / 'o skol rjes 'jug rnams la lag len du bslab pa'i ched yin no / /de ltar phyag byas te ci bya zhe na/ bya ba khyad par can byed pa yin te/ de yang bod thams cad kyi bstan pa'i bdag por chos rgyal byang chub sems dpa'i rigs su zhakhrungs shing / rten dge slong / dkon mchog la mi phyed pa'i dad pa can/ mdo rgyud la shes rab kyi spyan yangs pa'i jo bo dka' ba du mas spyan drangs te/ thugs la babs pa'i dngos po mtha' dag gis mnyes par mdzad pa'i rang gi slob ma lhag pa'i thugs bskyed bzang po dang ldan pa lha bla ma byang chub 'od kyis/ bod du bstan pa la 'dra mi 'dra'i bab col mang po byung bas da lta bstan pa spyi la ci phan zhig dgos tshul sogs snyan du gsol nas/ theg pa chen po ma lus pa'i don tshig nyung la don 'dus pa bla ma nyid kyis ji ltar thugs nyams su bzhes pa'i bstan

byang chub lam sgron gyi 'grel pa/ 37bcos shig mdzad par zhu zhes bskul bar gyur pas/ bla na med pa'i byang chub thob pa'i lam gyi snang ba kun tu ston par byed pa'i sgron ma lta bu'i bstan bcos rab tu gsal bar bya'o/ /de ltar bstan pa'i sgron me 'di bshad par dam bca' mdzad pa ni rtsom pa mthar phyin pa'i ched yin no/ /gnyis pa gzhung don dngos bshad pa la gnyis/ skyes bu gsum gyi rnam gzhag mdor bstan pa dang / de dag gi lam gyi mtshan nyid so sor bshad pa'o/ /dang po (skyes bu gsum gyi rnam gzhag mdor bstan pa )ni/chung ngu 'bringadabamachog rgyunayas/ /skyesabugasum du shesapar bya/ /de dag mtshan nyid rabagasal ba'i/ /the( so'i dbye batha(:khribar bya/ /zhes bya ba ste/ gong du byang chub lam gyi sgron ma rab tu gsal bar bya zhes bshad pa'i byang chub kyi lam de ji lta bu zhe na/ spyir skyes bu zhes pa sems can yin no cog la 'jug kyang / 'dir skyes bu'i skad dod pu ru ṣa zhes pa don byed pa'am nus pa la 'jug pasi/ 'jig rten phyi ma phan chad kyi don sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan pas skyes bu zhes bya zhing phyi ma phan chad kyi blang dor la dpyod pa'i yid ches che bas mi zhes kyang bya'i/ tshe 'di pa tsam don du gnyer ba la 'dir bstan gyi mi'am skyes bu zhes mi bya ste/ be'u bum las/phyi mar ngan song 'jigs pas sdig spong / /'khor ba'i skyon dran thar pa 'dod pas/ /

38 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/ bden bzhi'i tshul gyis bslab pa gsum 'jug /theg dman 'jigs pas byang chub sems sbyong / /de lta bu ni mi yi spyod pa/ /gzhan du na ni ci zhig mi yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /bla med byang chub tu bgrod pa'i lam de la chung ngu mngon mtho'i lam dang / 'bring nges legs thun mong ba'i lam dang / mchog tu gyur pa sangs rgyas nyid kyi lam gsum yod pas/ skyes bu gsum gyi lam de yang gsum nyid du shes par bya zhing / de dag kyang rang gi ngo bo mtshon par byed pa'i mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas rab tu gsal ba ste go sla bar/ lam gsum so so'i ngo bo dang khyad par ston tshul mi 'dra ba'i sgo nas dbye ba bri bar bya'o/ /'dir 'phros don gyi tshul du lam spyi'i rnam bzhag mdor bsdus tsam bshad na/sangs rgyas kyis thog mar thugs bskyed pa dang / bar du tshogs bsags pa dang /mthar mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa thams cad sems can kho na'i don du yin pas/ chos gsungs pa thams cad kyang sems can gyi don kho na sgrub par byed la/ de ltar na bsgrub bya sems can gyi don ni gnyis te/ gnas skabs mngon mtho dang mthar thug nges legs so/ /de yang dang po sgrub pa las brtsams te ji snyed gsungs pa thams cad ni skyes bu chung ngu dang thun mong ba'i chos skor du 'du ste/skyes bu chung ngu khyad par can ni tshe 'di la ched cher mi byed par tshe phyi ma'i mtho ris kyi phun tshogs don du gnyer zhing de'i rgyu rnams la 'jug pa'i phyir ro/ /nges legs la gnyis te/ 'khor ba las grol ba tsam gyi thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen

byang chub lam sgron gyi 'grel pa/ 39pa'o/ /de la nyan rang gi theg pa las brtsams te ji snyed gsungs pa thams cad ni skyes bu 'bring dngos sam/ de dang thun mong ba'i chos skor du 'du ste/ skyes bu 'bring ni srid pa mtha' dag la skyo ba skyes nas srid pa las grol ba'i thar pa rang gi don du thob byar byas te/ de'i thabs bslab pa gsum la 'jug pas so/ /rnam mkhyen sgrub pa'i thabs ni gnyis te/ phar phyin dang / sngags kyi theg chen no/ /de gnyis ni skyes bu chen po'i chos skor du 'du ste/ skyes bu chen po ni snying rje chen po'i gzhan dbang du gyur pas sems can gyi sdug bsngal thams cad zad par bya ba'i phyir du sangs rgyas thob byar byas te/ phyin drug dang rim gnyis sogs la slob pa yin pas so/ /de yang rang gzhung las/gang zhig thabs ni gang dag gis/ /'khor ba'i bde ba tsam dag la/ /rang nyid don du gnyer byed pa/ /de ni skyes bu tha mar shes/ /zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs shing skyes bu de rnams kyi lam gyi go rim las phar phyin dang sngags gnyis ka 'og nas gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /skyes bu gsum gyi tha snyad ni gtan la dbab pa bsdu ba dang mdzod 'grel sogs mang por gsungs so/ /skyes bu chung ngu la tshe 'di lhur len pa dang phyi ma lhur len pa gnyis yod pa las 'dir ni phyi ma ste/ de yang mngon mtho'i thabs ma nor ba la zhugs pa bzung ngo / /de ltar skyes bu gsum du bshad kyang skyes bu chen po'i lam du gzhan gnyis kyi lam yang 'du bas/ de gnyis theg chen lam gyi yan lag yin par slob dpon

40 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/rta dbyangs kyis gsungs so/ /des na 'dir srid pa'i bde ba tsam thob byar byed pa skyes bu chung ngu dang / rang don du 'khor ba las thar pa tsam thob byar byed pa skyes bu 'bring gi lam gnyis dang thun mong ba'i lam 'ga' zhig skyes bu chen po'i lam gyi sngon 'gro byas nas/ skyes bu chen po'i lam sbyong ba'i yan lag tu byed pa yin no/ /de'i rgyu mtshan yang theg chen du 'jug pa'i sgo ni byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa nyid yin te/ spyod 'jug las/byang chub sems skyes gyur na skad cig gis/ /'khor ba'i btson rar bsdams pa'i nyam thag rnams/ /bde gshegs rnams kyi sras zhes brjod bya zhing / /'jig rten lha mir bcas pa'i phyag byar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sems de rgyud la skyes na byang chub sems dpa' zhes pa'i ming thob nas rten de la theg chen par tshud la/ de nyams na theg chen pa'i gseb nas thon par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /des na theg chen du 'jug par 'dod pa rnams kyis ni sems de sgo du ma nas 'bad de bskyed dgos la/ de bskyed pa la ni sngon du sems de bskyed pa'i phan yon bsgoms nas phan yon la spro shugs 'phel ba zhig dang / yan lag bdun pa skyabs 'gro dang bcas pa dgos par bslab btus dang spyod 'jug las gsungs so/ /de ltar gsungs pa'i phan yon yang bsdu na gnyis/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan yon no/ /dang po la yang ngan 'gror mi lhung ba dang bde 'gror skye ba gnyis te/ sems de skyes na ngan song gi rgyu sngar bsags 'dag pa dang phyis

byang chub lam sgron gyi 'grel pa/ 41gsog rgyun chad la/ bde 'gro'i rgyu sngar bsags rnams sems des zin pas rgya cher 'phel ba dang / gsar du byed pa rnams kyang des kun nas slong bas zad pa'i mtha' med do/ /mthar thug gi don thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa rnams kyang sems de la brten nas bde blag tu 'grub la/ sngon du gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan yon la thob 'dod bcos ma min pa zhig med na/ phan yon de rnams sems bskyed las 'byung bas sems bskyed la 'bad par bya'o zhes smras kyang tshig tsam du zad do/ /de la sngon du mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi phan yon gnyis po de thob 'dod skyed pa la/ skyes bu chung 'bring dang thun mong ba'i bsam pa skyong dgos so/ /de ltar phan yon gnyis la thob 'dod bskyed nas phan yon can gyi sems sgom pa na sems de'i rtsa ba byams pa dang snying rje bskyed dgos la/ de yang rang bde bas phongs shing sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba'i 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshul bsams pa na ba spu g.yo 'gul med pa zhig la sems can gzhan bde bas phongs shing sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba la mi bzod pa med do/ /spyod 'jug las/sems can de dag nyid la sngon/ /rang gi don du 'di 'dra'i sems/ /rmi lam du yang ma rmis na/ /gzhan gyi don du ga la skye/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de'i phyir skyes bu chung ngu'i skabs su rang la ngan song gi sdug bsngal gyis gnod pa'i tshul dang / 'bring gi skabs su mtho ris na yang sdug bsngal zhing bde ba med pa'i tshul la bsams nas/ de nas gnyen du gyur pa'i

42 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/sems can rnams la yang rang nyams la dpag nas bsgoms pas byams dang snying rje skye ba'i rgyur 'gyur zhing / de las byang chub kyi sems skye bas chung 'bring dang thun mong ba'i bsam pa sbyong pa ni/ byang chub kyi sems bcos ma min pa skye ba'i thabs yin no/ /de bzhin du de gnyis kyi skabs su skyabs 'gro dang las 'bras bsams pa sogs kyi sgo nas bsag sbyang gi sgo du ma la 'bad pa ni/ byang chub sems kyi sngon 'gro rgyud sbyong ba'i thabs yan lag bdun pa skyabs 'gro dang bcas pa rnams kyi rigs su 'gyur bas/ de dag kyang sems de skye ba'i skabs su go bar bya'o/ /'dir chung 'bring gi chos skor rnams byang chub kyi sems skye ba'i yan lag tu 'gro lugs rnams shes pa gal che ste/ de ltar ma shes na skyes bu chen po'i lam dang lam so so ba 'brel med du 'gyur bas so/ /de ltar na byang chub kyi sems bcos ma ma yin pa rgyud la ci skye bya/ de nas sems de brtan par bya ba'i phyir du skyabs 'gro thun mong ma yin pa sngon du btang nas smon pa'i cho ga bya/ smon pa cho gas bzung nas de'i bslab pa rnams la bslab/ de nas spyod pa phyin drug dang bsdu bzhi sogs la slob par 'dod pa'i blo sbyong la/ snying thag pa nas slob 'dod byung ba na 'jug sdom rnam dag cig blang / de nas rtsa lhung gis ma gos pa la srog bsdos bya/zag pa chung 'bring dang nyes byas rnams kyis kyang ma gos pa la 'bad cing / ci ste gos na'ang lhung ba phyir bcos ji ltar gsungs pa'i sgo nas legs par sbyang / de nas phyin drug spyi la bslab cing / khyad par du sems dge ba'i dmigs pa la ji ltar 'dod 'dod bkol du rung bar bya ba'i phyir zhi gnas kyi ngo bo bsam gtan la bslab bo/ /gzhung 'dir mngon shes bskyed pa'i phyir du zhi gnas la bslab par gsungs pa ni mtshon pa tsam ste/ jo bo nyid kyis skabs gzhan du lhag mthong

byang chub lam sgron gyi 'grel pa/ 43bskyed pa'i phyir du yang gsungs pas de'i phyir du zhi gnas bsgrub bo/ /de nas bdag gnyis su 'dzin pa'i 'ching ba gcad pa'i phyir du stong nyid kyi lta bas thag chod par byas la sgom tshul ma nor bar bskyangs nas shes rab kyi ngo bo lhag mthong bsgrub par bya'o/ /de ltar na zhi lhag sgrub pa ma gtogs pa'i 'jug sdom gyi bslab bya la slob pa man chad tshul khrims kyi bslab pa dang / zhi gnas ni sems kyi bslab pa dang / lhag mthong ni shes rab kyi bslab par 'grel par gsungs so/ /gzhan yang zhi gnas man chad thabs dang bsod nams kyi tshogs dang kun rjestob bden pa la brten pa'i lam dang rgya che ba'i lam rim yin la/ shes rab khyad par can gsum skyed pa na shes rab dang ye shes kyi tshogs dang don dam bden pa da nga zab mo'i lam rim yin pas/ de dag gi go rim dang grangs nges pa dang thabs shes ya bral gyis byang chub mi 'grub pa la nges pa chen po bskyed par bya'o/ /de ltar lam thun mong bas rgyud sbyangs nas ni nges par sngags la 'jug dgos te/ de la zhugs na myur du tshogs gnyis rdzogs par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /gal te de tsam las mi lcogs pa'am rigs nus chung bas mi spro na lam rim de nyid je rgyas su gtong ba tsam bya'o/ /sngags la 'jug na ni spyir theg pa thams cad dang khyad par sngags nas gsungs pa'i bshes gnyen bsten tshul khyad par du gyur pa zhig bya/ de nas rgyud sde rnam dag nas 'byung ba'i dbang gis rgyud smin par byas nas/ de'i dus su thob pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa srog bsdos byas te bsrung / khyad par rtsa lhung phog na slar blang du yod kyang rgyud chud zos te yon tan skye dka' bas des ma gos par byed/ yan lag gi lhung ba rnams kyis ma gos par byed cing gos na'ang ji mi snyam par mi 'jog par bshags sdom gyis dag par bya'o/ /de nas

44 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/rgyud sde 'og ma ltar na mtshan bcas dang gong ma ltar na bskyed rim gyi rnal 'byor gang rung zhig la 'khrid/ de brtan nas rgyud sde 'og ma ltar na mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor dang gong ma ltar na rdzogs rim gyi rnal 'byor gang rung la bslab bo/ /de ltar blo rim gyis bskyed dgos pa ni/ gzungs kyi dbang phyug rgyal pos zhus pa las nor bu mkhan mkhas pas nor bu rim gyis sbyang ba'i dpe don du sbyar nas bka' bstsal to/ /mgon po klu sgrub kyis kyang /dang por mngon par mtho ba'i chos/ /phyis ni nges par legs 'byung ba/ /gang phyir mngon par mtho thob nas/ /rim gyis nges par legs pa'o/ /zhes mngon mtho nges legs kyi lam la rim pa can du 'khrid par gsungs pa dang /'phab/thaṭa pa 'ukhribasdo spru/nga /sems can dang stu1'i las can rnams/ /dam pa'i don la 'jug pa la/ /thabs 'di rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /skas kyi rim pa lta bur gsungs/ /zhes rbedu/ /gnyis pa de dag gi lam gyi mtshan nyid so sor bshad pa la gsum/ skyes bu chung ngu'i mtshan nyid/ 'bring gi mtshan nyid/ chen po'i mtshan nyid bstan pa'o/ /

byang chub lam sgron gyi 'grel pa/ 45dang po (skyes bu chung ngu'i mtshan nyid )ni/gang zhig thabasanigang dgagis/ /'khoraba'ibade ba tsamadagal/ /rang nyid don du gnyer byed pa/ / de nisnyesabu tha mar shes/ /zhes bya ba ste/ tshe 'di la ma chags par gtso bor phyi ma phan chad kyi don sgrub nus kyi skyes bu gang zhig thabs ni las rgyu 'bras la yid ches kyi dad pa sngon du song ba'i sgo nas mi dge bcu 〈snang gi tshul khrims dang / zag bcas kyi bsam gtan dang gzugs med kyi snyoms 'jug sogs lha'i theg pa dang tshangs pa'i theg pa zhes bshad pa gang dag gis/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i mthar thug pa'i mi'i bde ba dang /brgya byin nas gzugs med pa'i bar gyi 'khor ba'i bde ba tsam dag la ched du bya ba gang zag rang nyid kyis thob pa'i don du gnyer bar byed pa gang yin pa'i skyes bu de ni/ srid pa don du gnyer zhing gzhan don la rgyab kyis phyogs pas 'bring dang chen po las dman pa'i phyir/ 'dir bstan gyi skyes bu tha mar shes par bya'o/ /spyir ni skyes bu chung ngu la tshe 'di don du gnyer ba tsam yang yod kyang / 'di ni mngon mtho'i thabs ma nor pa la zhugs dgos pas 'dir bstan gyi skyes bu chung ngu la gcig nyid las dbye ba gzhan mi byed do/ /skyes bu gsum gyi lam mtha' dag gi rtsa ba bshes gnyen bsten tshul yin te/ des mnyes par byas na dal 'byor la snying po len 'dod skye zhing / dal ba'i rten la snying po len 'dod dam chos sgrub 'dod kyi blo ma skyes par skyes bu gsum gyi lam gang yang nyams su len pa mi 'ong

46 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/bas/ bshes gnyen bsten pa dang dal 'byor gyi chos skor gnyis gsum ga'i sngon 'gro yin pas/ khrid nyams su len pa na bshes gnyes bsten tshul sogs go rim nges can du bya'o/ /de yang skyes bu chung ngu'i bsam pa skye ba la/ mi rtag pa dang ngan song gsum gyi nyes dmigs bsam pa dang / sbyor ba sgrub pa la/ skyabs 'gro dang las 'bras bsams nas mi dge bcu spong gi tshul khrims la bslab dgos pas/'dir bstan gyi skyes bu chung ngu'i lam gyi dngos gzhi la dmigs skor bzhi yod do/ /gnyis pa skyes bu 'bring gi mtshan nyid ni/srid pa'i bde la rgyab phyogasashing / /sdig ba'i 'chogalasaldogabadag nyid/ /gang zhig rang zhi tsam don gnyer/ /skyegabude ni'abring zhesabya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mnar med nas srid rtse'i bar gyi 'khor ba mtha' dag gi sdug bsngal rgyu mtshan du ma'i sgo nas bsams pas 'khor los sgyur rgyal sogs kyi bde ba la'ang rmi lam du yang 'dod pa med pas/ srid pa'i bde ba mtha' dag la rgyab kyis phyogs shing zhen pa log pa bsam pa'i khyad par/ bsam pa des kun nas bslangs te sgo gsum sdig pa mi dge ba'i las las ldog pa'i bdag nyid can gyi so thar ris bdun gang rung gi brtul zhugs la yang dag par gnas pa sbyor ba'i khyad par/ bsam sbyor de gnyis dang ldan pa'i rten gyi gang zag gang zhig rang nyid kyi sdug kun nye bar zhi ba'i myang 'das tsam don du gnyer ba 'bras bu'i khyad

byang chub lam sgron gyi 'grel pa/ 47par ste/ khyad par de gsum dang ldan pa ni dam chos ma nor bar grub pa'i lam la zhugs pas 'dir bstan gyi skyes bu yin zhing / srid pa mtha' dag las yid 'byung bas chung ngu las khyad par 'phags pa dang 'gro ba'i don gyi khur 'khur ba'i lhag bsam dang mi ldan pas chen po las dman pa'i phyir/ de la ni 'bring zhes brjod par bya ba yin no/ /'dir dngos su bstan pa'i skyes bu 'bring la dbye na theg pa'i sgo nas nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa la zhugs pa gnyis/ bsgom bya'i sgo nas 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dang rten 'bre la yan lag bcu gnyis lugs 'byung ldog tu bsgom pa gnyis/ nang tshan gyi sgo nas rang don du thar pa don gnyer gyi blos dge bcu'i tshul khrims la slob pa ni skyes bu 'bring gi chung ngu / bsam pa de ldan gyis 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi bsgom pa 'bring gi 'bring / bsam pa de dang ldan pa gang zhig gnyis stong gi bdag med bsgom pa 'bring gi chen po yin no/ /de ltar na 'phags mchog klu sgrub dang dpal ldan zla ba'i rjes su 'brangs pas ni bsgom bya bdag med gsum gyi sgo nas kyang gsum du dbyer yod de/ gang zag rdzas yod kyis stong pa tsam gyi bdag med dang / rdul phran cha med bsags pa'i phyi rol don gyis stong pa gzung ba chos kyi bdag med dang / gang zag dang chos rtog pas btags pa tsam las rang bzhin gyis grub pas stong pa'i bdag med phra mo rtogs shing sgom pa'i theg dman gyi gang zag gsum gzhag dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /skyes bu 'bring gi lam gyi dngos gzhi ni/ srid pa'i bde la rgyab phyogs shing zhes pas sdug bden dang / sdig pa'i las las zhes pas kun 'byung dang / rang zhi tsam don gnyer zhes pas 'gog bden dang / ldog bdag nyid ces pas lam bden bstan

48 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/ces sha ra bas gsungs pa ltar/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi'i lam ni thar 'dod rnams kyis bsgom bya'i gtso bo dang skyes bu 'bring gi lam gyi gzhung shing yin te/rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis kyang de nyid du 'dus pa'i phyir/ de yang thar pa don gnyer gyis gtan la dbab bya kun byang gnyis su nges te/ dang po la rgyu 'ching byed kun 'byung dang 'bras bu bcings pa sdug bden gnyis su nges shing / phyi ma la 'thob bya 'gog bden dang thob byed lam bden gnyis su nges pa'i phyir/ go rim yang sdug bden thog mar gsungs pa ltar/ thar 'dod rnams kyis dang por 'khor ba spyi dang so so'i nyes dmigs legs par bsams te thar 'dod kyi blo bcos min bskyed/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsam pas yid skyo ba na/ 'khor ba 'di ci'i rgyu can yin snyam du bsams pas nyon mongs pa dang zag bcas kyi las las 'khor ba 'grub par mthong nas kun 'byung sbong 'dod skye bas/ de'i 'og tu kun 'byung 'khor ba'i 'jug rim sgom/ kun 'byung gi gtso bo ma rig pa ni yul gyi gnas tshul la phyin ci log tu zhugs pa'i blo yin pas de sbong nus su shes pa na/'gog pa mngon du bya nus su mthong bas de'i 'og tu 'og sa bstan pa yin la/ de yang lam la rag las par mthong bas de nas lam bden bstan pa yin te/ rje btsun byam/sa pas/nad ni shes bya nad kyi rgyu ni spang bya la/ /bde gnas 'thob bya sman ni bsten par bya ba ltar/ /sdug bsngal rgyu dang de 'gog pa dang de yi lam/ /shes bya spang bya rig par bya zhing bsten par bya/ /

byang chub lam sgron gyi 'grel pa/ 49zhes gsungs pas so/ /gsum pa skyes bu chen po'i mtshan nyid bstan pa la gnyis/ mdor bstan pa dang / rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po (pador bstan pa )ni/za9pa thre/da gastaṇ+ḍakathabapa'i sdub/rnga5sdil gyis/ /gang :྅ka ska6ltan lha) lja/ba/balngal na/na/ /yardzadagazad par kun nathasa'adod/ /smrethasabu de ni macagi yin no/ /zhes bya ba ste/ de ltar skyes bu chung 'bring gi lam la blo legs par sbyangs shing byung ba'i gang zag gis rang gi rgyud du gtogs pa'i 'khor ba'i sdu/ga bsngal gyis thog mtha' bar gsum du gdung bar mthong ba na/ de dang mthun par srid mtshor 'khyams pa gang zhig mar gyur sems can gzhan kun gyi sdu/ga bsngal la bsams te de dag thams cad kyang rang dang 'dra bar sdug bsngal thams cad kyi me 'bar bas bsregs pa la mi bzod pa'i snying rjes kun nas bslangs te/ de rnams kyi sdug bsngal thams cad dang de'i rgyu sgrib gnyi sa bag chags dang bcas pa ma lus pa kun yang dag par slar ldog pa med par zad par kun nas 'dod pa'i gzhan don don gnyer gyi 'dod pa dang mtshungs ldan gyi thob bya byang chub la don du gnyer ba'i sems rin po che dang / des kun nas bslangs pa'i rgyal ba'i sras kyi spyod pa ci rigs la gnas pa'i skyes bu de ni/ theg chen sgrub pa'i thabs ma nor ba la zhugs pas 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i skyes bu mchog gam chen po'i mtshan nyid

50 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/can yin no/ /de la dbye na lta ba'i sgo nas dbu sems gnyis/ theg pa'i sgo nas mdo sngags gnyis/ lam myur bul gyi sgo nas phyugs kyi shing rtas bgrod pa sogs lngar dbye ba yod do/ /gnyis pa skyes bu chen po'i lam rgyas par bshad pa la gnyis/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam rgyas par bshad pa dang / sngags la 'jug pa'i tshul phyogs tsam bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ lam gyi rnam gzhag dang / 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ bshad par dam bca' ba dang / lam yang dag pa nyid bshad pa'o/ /dang po (bshad par dam bca' ba )ni/semasacan dam pa byang chub mchog /'dod par rgyun pa de dag la/ /bla marnamasakyisabastan pa yin/ /yang dgathabs bshad par bya/ /zhes bya ba ste/ bshad par bya zhes pa bshad pa'i gzhir bzhag ste/ gang bshad na/bla na med pa'i byang chub sgrub pa la med du mi rung ba'i thabs ni'o/ /gang la na/sems can dam pa theg pa chen po'i rigs sad cing gzhan don du byang chub mchog gi go 'phang thob par 'dod pa'i lhag bsam rnam par dag pa dang ldan par gyur pa de dag la'o/ /tshul ji ltar na/ rang bzo ma yin te/ jo bo gser gling pa la sogs pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyis ji ltar bstan pa yi gsung gi rjes su 'brang zhing lung rigs dang ldan pas yang dag par ro/ /de la sems can dam pa zhes

byang chub lam sgron gyi 'grel pa/ 51rkang pa gnyis kyis chos 'di gang la bshad pa'i snod ngos bzung / bla ma rnams kyis bstan pa yi/ /zhes pa gnyis kyis bdud rtsi lta bu'i chos ngos bzung ba'o/ /de dag las yang dag thabs ni zhes pas brjod bya dang / bshad par bya zhes pas dgos pa dang / bla ma rnams kyis bstan pa yi zhes pas rjod byed kyi khyad par dang /byang chub mchog ces pas nying dgos dang / de dag kyang gcig la gcig brten pa ni 'brel ba ste go sla'o/ /'o na byang chub lam gyi sgron ma rab tu gsal bar bya zhes pa dang / de dag mtshan nyid rab gsal ba/ /so so'i dbye ba bri bar bya/ /zhes pa dang / 'dir yang dag thabs ni bshad par bya zhes pa thams cad bshad par dam bca' ba yin na zlos par 'gyur ro zhe na skyon med de/ dang pos gzhung spyi'i rtsom par dam bca' ba dang / gnyis pas skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi dbye ba so sor 'chad ces pa dang / gsum pas theg chen gyi rigs can la bla med byang chub sgrub pa'i thabs ma nor bar 'chad ces ston tshul tha dad pa'i phyir ro/ /des na sems can dam pa zhes sogs sh+lau ka 'di gzhung 'og ma rnams kyi mdor bstan du'ang bzung ngo / / gnyis pa lam yang dag pa bshad pa la gnyis/ 11na pa bslab bya dang bcas pa dang / 'jug pa bslab bya dang bcas pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ mjug bslab bya la sterdzob tshul 'o1/ /dang po la gsum/ tshogs gsog pa/skyabs 'gro khyad par can bya ba/ sems gsum la blo sbyong ba'o/ /dang po (tshogs gsog pa )ni/ rdzogasasangagabrisaXskyi la sogasadang / /mchoderten dam chosamangon phyogasanas/ /

52 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/me rtete/ ngadogag 11'a(da11bltarngo1 dag /ci 0〈rnar pa yi'(mchod par bya/ /zhes bya ba ste/ yul gang gi mdun du mchod pa ji ltar bya na/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa ri mor bris pa'i sku dang / 'bur du brkos pa dang / lugs su blugs pa la sogs pa sku'i rten/ dang / ring bsrel gyi snyi/nga po can gyi mchod rten thuṭa kyi rten dang / gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis sogs dam pa'i chos kyi po ti gsung gi rten rnams mngon sum du bzhugs pa la phyogs pa'i mdun nas mchod pa bya'o / /sha ra bas nas zhes pas phyag 'tshal ba'ang bstan pa yin gsungs/ dngos po gang gis mchod na/ me tog dang / bdug spos dang / mar me dang / dri dang / zhal zas te nyer spyod kyi dngos po dag gis/ de yang rang gang 'bul 'dod pa tsam gyis mchod dam zhe na/ rang la ci 'byor zhing yod pa lha/ga ma ma lus pa yis mchod pa bya dgos te/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ 'bras dkar mo khal gcig bdog po/ yo btang /byang chub kyi sems bzang po mchi/ yo ma btang / byang chub kyi sems bzang po mi mchi gsungs skad/ de dag ni rdzas bshams pas mngon sum du mchod pa yin no/ /po to ba'i zhal nas/ mchod pa ni grogs po snying zhog zhog pa/ chig pa za tsag tsag pa gshom dgos pa yin no gsungs/ yid kyis mchod pa'i tshul yang /kun bzang spyod las gsungs pa yi/ /mchodi pa rnam pa bdun dab/ku9pa/ /zhes bya ba ste/ kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa'i smon lam las gsungs pa yi phyag

byang chub lam sgron gyi 'grel pa/ 53'tshal/ mchod 'bul/ sdig bshags/ yi rang / skul ba/ gsol gdab/ bsngo ba ste/ mchod pa rnam pa bdun po dag kyang bya ba yin no/ /de dag la mchod pa zhes bya ste/ mchod pa'i don ni yul mnyes par byed pa yin la/ bdun po des kyang yul khyad par can rnams dgyes par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ / gnyis pa skyabs 'gro khyad par can bya ba ni/byadzopheb snyingapo'i mthar thag bar/ /mi shesag pa yi sgamabazhidag gir+sā/ /dkon malhur+sha/gabum la rab dad citha/ /puthas36) lhawā thayon nga5snrokatha'inas/ /thal smro smyar bar byastsozhamini/ /dang po spyobatha'i'arkyu1 lan bstisnyoglu bya/ /zhes bya ba ste/ dus khyad par can byang chub snying po'i mthar thug pa ste chos kyi sku mngon du ma byas kyi bar du'o/ /byang chub snying po ni gnyis te/ gnas byang chub snying po dang rtogs pa byang chub snying po'o/ dang po la gnyis te/ rdo rje gdan lta bu sprul sku'i dang / 'og min stu/ga po bkodatshopa lta/ bu longs sku'i gnas byang chub snying po'o/ / gnyis pa ni bla na med pa'i ye shes kyi sku'o zhes bu ston gyis gsungs pa ltar ro/ /kun slong khyad par can sems can thams cad la dmis/sa pa'i snying rje chen pos dkon mchog gsum skyabs su 'dzin pa las nam ya nga mi ldog pa yi sems shin tu brtan pa dag gis/ yul khyad par can spang rtogs mthar phyin gyi sangs rgyas dang /lung dang rtogs pa'i chos dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i dge 'dun byang sems

54 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/'phags pa phyir mi ldog pa ste dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la/ bsam pa khyad par can so so'i yon tan thos pa na rab tu dang ba'i dad pa shugs drag po bskyed cing spro ba ldan par byas te/ lus kyi kun spyod rkang pa gnyis kyi pus mo'i lha nga sar btsugs nas sam tsog pur 'dug kyang rung / bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar/ lag gnyis thal mo sbyar ba byas nas ni/ gnas skabs smon pa sems bskyed kyi cho ga byed pa'i dang por skyabs 'gro dag gi dngos gzhi'i cho ga lan gsum mam brjod pa gsum du bya ste/ gsum pa'i tshe skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa thob pa yin pa'i phyir/ sha ra ba'i zhal nas/ nyan thos la skyabs su mi 'gro ba de byin rlabs chung ba ma yin gyi/ lam mi mthun pa grogs por 'thu mi btub pa dang 'dra ba yin gsungs/ de yang mdo sde rgyan las/'tshe ba dag ni thams cad dang / /ngan song dang ni thabs min dang / /'jig 31gas theg pa dman dag las/ /skyob phyir skyabs kyi dam pa'o/ /zhes tshe 'di'i 'tshe ba dang phyi ma'i ngan song dang thabs min pa lam log pa las skyob pa'i phyir skyabs su 'gro ba skyes bu chung ngu'i dang / 'jig tshogs zag bcas kyi phung po 'du byed kyi rang bzhin can gyi 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las rang nyid thar ba'i skyabs su 'gro ba 'bring gi dang / theg dman la 'jigs nas sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i phyir thun mong ma yin pa'i dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba theg chen gyi skyabs 'gror gsungs so/ /

byang chub lam sgron gyi 'grel pa/ 55'o na skyabs 'gro khyad par can dang smon pa la khyad par yod dam med ce na/ po to bas smon pa ni sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas 'thob par 'dod cing / sangs rgyas thob nas sems can sgrol ba tshong dpon rang stobs kyis skyel ma byed pa dang 'dra/ skyabs 'akro khyad par can ni/ sems can sdug bsngal las grol bar 'dod pas de'i nus pa mnga' ba dkon mchog gsum la zhus nas tshong dpon khas drag po gzhan la brten nas skyel ma byed pa lta bu yin gsungs so/ /mdo sde rgyan las ni/'di ni de dngos 'dod pas khas len de yang snying brtse las rig bya/ /zhes sangs rgyas 'dod pas khas len pa'ang gsungs so/ /'dir skyabs 'gro'i rgyu dang / yul dang / ngo bo dang / bslab bya dang / phan yon rnams ni gzhan las shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa sems gsum la blo sbyong ba ni/de nasasemagacan thamasacad la/ /byamasapalisemasanisngon 'gro bas/ /ngan songagasum dang skye sogasadang / /'chi 'pho sogasakyibazhirdzugabasngal ba'i/ /'gro ba ma lusal bltasate/ /sdug bsngal gyisanisdugabasngal ba/ /sdug bsngal sduga'isngal rgyu mtshan las/ /'gro ba thar bar 'dod pa yis/ /zhes bya ba ste/ tshogs gsog sngon du song ba'i skyabs 'gro khyad par can byas zin pa de nas/ mar gyur sems can thams cad la dmigs pa'i byams pa'i sems ni

56 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/rgyu 'bras yan lag bdun gyi nang tshan gyi snying rje'i rgyur nges pas sngon du 'gro dgos la/ de bas na sems can thams cad la mar shes drin dran drin gzo'i sgo nas snying du sdug cing gces pa'i blo dung dung ba byung na snying rje sgom ste/ dmigs pa ngan song gsum na sdug bsngal drag cing rgyun ring ba ci yod dang / mi la skye rga na 'chi sogs kyi sdug bsngal dang / 'dod lha drug na 'chi 'pho ba dang 'og tu lhung ba'i sdug bsngal dang / sogs khong nas bstan pa khams gong ma gnyis na ting nge 'dzin gyis myos nas chos kyi blo med cing gnas pa la rang dbang ma thob pa'i sdug bsngal te/ mdor na sdug bsngal gsum gyis ci rigs par sdug bsngal ba'i 'gro ba ma lus pa la thugs rje'i spyan gyis bltas te/ ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal gyis ni sdug bsngal ba dang / mi dang 'dod lha'i 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal dang / khams gong ma'i 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal dang / de rnams bskyed pa'i rtsa ba kun 'byung las dang nyon mongs pa'i rgyu mtshan la bsams nas/ de las 'gro ba mtha' dag thar bar 'dod pa'i snying rje dang / de yis drangs pa'i byang chub chen po thob 'dod kyi blo sbyang ba la nan tan bya dgos te/ mdo las/ byang chub sems dpa' chos mang po la bslab par mi bya'o/ /chos gcig la bslab par bya ste/ gang zhe na/ snying rje chen po'o zhes gsungs pas so/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ldog pa med par dam bca' ba'i /byabachub semasani bskyed par bya/ /zhes bya ba ste/ de ltar byams pa dang snying rje'i dmigs rnam legs par sbyangs nas

byang chub lam sgron gyi 'grel pa/ 57byang chub kyi sems rin po che las dus nam yang phyir ldog pa med par dam bca' ba'i sgo nas/ byang chub kyi sems rin po che ni bskyed par bya'o/ /de yang byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skad cig gcig kyang mi gtong ba'i sems kyis smon sems cho gas blangs nas/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i bslab bya lnga po la nges par slob dgos so/ /smon sems cho gas len pa dngos ni gzhan las shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa mjug bslab byar slob tshul la lnga/ phan yon dran pa la bslab pa/byang chub kyi sems sbyang ba la bslab pa/ tshogs gnyis bsag pa la bslab pa/sems can blos mi spang ba la bslab pa/ dkar nag chos brgyad blang dor byed tshul la bslab pa'o/ /dang po (pan yon dran pa la bslab pa )ni/de ltar 11na ba:rno thesdema'akhodaga3de/ /ngasdospyod pa'i 81natsotan garngukuyin pa/ /de ni spyordong 11 ban da pa nyug/ /mastordo 'dzisabyamatha/pathaga'adzinasnarnya ngadzind/ /ces bya ba ste/ sngar bshad pa de ltar byang chub smon pa'i sems dag ni/ cho gas bskyed pa'i yon tan nam phan yon dpag tu med pa gang yin pa de ni 'phags pa sdong po bkod pa yi mdo las/ rigs kyi bu byang chub kyi sems ni sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyi sa bon lta bu'o/ /'gro ba thams cad kyi chos dkar po rnam par 'phel bar byed pa'i zhing sa lta bu'o/ /zhes sogs dpe nyis brgya lhag tsam gyi sgo nas byang chub sems dpa' nor bzang la rgyal tshab byams pas rab tu rgyas par bshad do/ /

8 'jam mgon kong sprul yon na rgya mtsho/gnyis pa (byang chub kyi sems sbyang ba la bslab pa )ni/de yisamado klog pa'am bla ma lasamanyanaste//rdzogasapa'i byang tso semasakyi yon to 4'a med pa//rnam r+sāshesawobyasalade//sargyu ma'adu//de ltar ṭ+wāṃthak+tamung du sem tshod par bya//da~X' na sazhusamado dgalas//de zloshādanamasar+pā lhan pa//gang gsakaud /suṭ+wāṃ tsam du//mdor bsdusapa 'ar bya//byangatso semasakyibasokā ṭāgagang //de lagadī tegazubasnasam na//nasna mkha kham kun bkang ste//de ṭ+wāṃ balhasag para'aji//gaṅgā bye marwasprongathagasnyed /gi/snangasargyasazhi/rnamasami gang sa//'a/ chen dag sakun bkang ste//snarten mgon la phurnyi babs//gangasathasna mo sbyar bsate//byangatso tudi ṭ+wāṃmasagasan//mchod pa 'a khyad par 'phags//de la mtha' ni ma mchisaso//

byang chub lam sgron gyi 'grel pa/ 59zhes bya ba ste/ de ltar smon sems cho gas blangs pa'i byang sems de yis/ mdo dang bstan bcos rnams rang nyid kyis klog pa'am yang na bla ma las legs par mnyan te/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dmigs pa'i smon sems kyi yon tan nam phan yon mtha' las 'das shing dpag tu med pa theg chen gyi mdo sde la sogs pa rnams las ji skad gsungs pa dag rnam par mtha' chod par shes par byas nas/dgos pa rang rgyud la sems de gnas shing mi nyams par 'phel ba'i rgyu mtshan nam rgyu rkyen du de ltar yang dang yang du tha na nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum gsum du byang chub kyi sems de ni bskyed par bya'o/ /de yang cho ga rgyas pa ma grub na'ang /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ /zhes pa sogs kyi tshigs bcad jo bo nyid kyi gzhung las 'byung ba de ltar bya'o/ /'o na byang chub sems kyi yon tan mtha' med pa de gang las bshad ce na/ khyim bdag dpal sbyin gyis zhus pa'i mdo sde dag las byang chub kyi sems 'di yi bsod nams phan yon rgya cher rab tu bstan pa gang gi tshe na/ de dag las tshigs bcad gsum tsam du mdor bsdus nas gsungs pas na/ de ni gzhung 'dir yang bri bar bya'o/ /'o na de ji lta bu zhe na/byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa nyid kyi bsod nams gang yin pa de gzugs su ma grub mod kyi/ de la gal te gzugs shig mchis na phyogs bcu'i nam mkha'i khams ni ma lus pa kun phyur bur bkang ste gtams na'ang / phan yon de ni nam mkha' de bas kyang lhag par 'gyur te mi shong ba yin no/ /gzhan yang snod kyi khyad par chu bo gaṅgā'i 'gram gyi bye ma'i grangs sam/ chu nyid rdul du phye ba'i phye ma ji snyed pa de snyed kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams rnams/ rten dad pa dang ldan pa'i mi gang gis/ mchod rdzas kyi khyad par lha'i rin chen dbang gi rgyal po dag gis kun tu

60 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/bkang ste/ yul khyad par can 'jig rten gyi mgon po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la 'bul ba phu' ba bas/ rten gyi gang zag theg chen gyi rigs can gang gis dkon mchog gam bla ma'i drung du dad pas thal mo sbyar ba bgyis te bla na med pa'i byang chub mchog tu sems btung/ pa ste bskyed na/ byang chub tu serma/sa bskyed pa'i mchod pa 'di ni snga ma las khyad par du 'phags shing mchog tu gyur pa yin pa'i phyir/ byang chub kyi sems de la bsod nams kyi mtha' ni ma mchis so/ /gsum pa /snatshogs gnyis bsag pa la bslab pa ri/ni/byabachub smon pa'i semasadag bskyedanasani/ /'bad pa mdz+waposakun tu spel bya zhing / /zhes bya ba ste/ phan yon dran pa dang / dus drug tu sbyong ba gnyis kyi sgo nas byang chub smon pa'i sems dag bskyed par byas nas ni/ dkon mchog la mchod pa/dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur/ 'byung po la gtor ma/ phongs pa la sbyin pa sogs bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa la 'bad pa mang pos sems de kun tu spel bar bya dgos te/ tshogs kyi gtam las/bdag gis de ring bsod nams dang / /ye shes tshogs ni gang zhig gis/ /gzhan la phan pa gang bya zhes/ /byang chub sems dpas yang yang bsam/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /zhing zhes pa 'og ma sdud pa'i tshig go /

byang chub lam sgron gyi 'grel pa/ 61bzhi pa (sems can blos mi spang ba la bslab pa )ni/'alha ni rnyu bahā/zhan du'ang dran sgyurdon du/ /zhes pa ni gang gi sgras bstan par zhang ram pas bzhed do/ /de yang gang gi sgras tshe 'dir sems bskyed mi nyams pa'i rgyud la bslab par bstan cing / sems can blos spang gis sems bskyed gtong bas so snyam du dgongs pas shin tu legs zhes dam pa kha cig 'chad do/ /lnga pa 6kar nag chos brgyad blang dor byed tshul la bslab pa )ni/jirnad bshad pa'ingabaslab pa'ang yongathasasu ngayi/rdza/ /zhes bya ba ste/ 'dir bstan smon sems cho gas bzung ba 'di la ni sngar bshad pa'i bslab bya bzhi'i sgo nas tshe 'dir mi nyams pa'i rgyu la bslab pa de tsam gyis chog gam zhe na/ mi chog ste skye ba phyi ma tshe rabs gzhan du'ang sems de mi brjed cing dran par bya ba'i don du/ 'od srungs kyis zhus pa'i mdo las ji skad bshad pa'i bslab pa bzhi tshan gnyis po yongs su bsrung ba dang bsten par bya ba yin no/ /gnyis pa 'jug pa bslab bya dang bcas pa bshad pa la gsum/ mtshams sbyar te 'jug sdom blang bar bstan pa// ji ltar blang ba'i tshul/ sdom pa blangs nas bslab bya la bslab par bstan pa'o/ /dang po r+ṣatshams sbyar te 'jug sdom blang bar bstan pa )ni/0〈drig sematha(bdab/nyid4lha/ma pa ma gartar+sha/ba'ipar/ /nga dag011na pa 'phel bar 'gyur ma yin/ /

62 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/rdzogagapa'i byang chub sdom pa smrel 'dod pas/ /de phyir 'bad pasa'adiniresapar blang / /zhes bya ba ste/ de ltar byang chub tu sems bskyed kyang rgyal sras kyi spyod pa la ma bslab na 'tshang rgya mi srid cing / byang sdom ma bzung na sbyin sogs la bslab kyang rgyal sras kyi spyod par mi 'gyur bas smon sems cho gas brtan por bzung ba des spyod pa'i rten sdom pa bzung dgos te/ 'jug pa'i sems kyi bdag nyid sdom pa bzung ba ma gtogs par yang dag pa mchog nyid du smon pa yi sems gong nas gong du 'phel bar 'gyur ba ma yin pa'i phyir/ de ltar na dgos pa 'bras ming rgyu la btags pa rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dmigs pa'i sdom pa smon pa'i sems de spel zhing mthar phyin par 'dod pas blang dgos pa yin la/ rgyu mtshan de yi phyir na sgyid lug pa dang zhum pa med par shin tu 'bad pas 'jug pa'i sdom pa 'di ni nges par blang bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa 'jug sdom ji ltar len pa'i tshul la gsum/ gang gis len pa'i rten/ gang las blang pa'i yul/ ji ltar len pa'i cho ga'o/ /dang po (gang gis len pa'i rten )ni/so sor thar pa risabadun gyi/ / rtagatu sdom gzhan ldan pa la/ /byathachub semabaltadapa'i sdom pa yi/ /skal ba yod kyi gzhan du min/ /so sor thar pamirigasabadun du/ /

byang chub lam sgron gyi 'grel pa/ 63de bzhin gzhegaba'ipas94nad pa la//tshangasaspyod dpal ni mchog yin te//dge slong sdom pa dgasgyu bzhed//ces bya ba ste/dge bsnyen nas dge slong gi sdom pa'i bar gyi so sor thar pa'i ris bdun dngos sam/ de dang thun mong ba'i rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba dus rtag tu spong ba'i ji srid 'tsho ba'i sdom pa gzhan de dag dang ldan pa'i rten la byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa yi skal ba yod kyi/ de las gzhan du byang sdom phun sum tshogs pa skye ba min te/ byang sdom ni dngos sam brgyud pa'i sgo nas gzhan la phan 'dogs nus pa gang zhig de las gzhan gcesad gzhi bcas las 'e1ga dbostos pa'i phyir/ gal te so thar gyi sdom pa ni tshe 'phos pas gtong bas 'di'i rten ji ltar rung snyam na/ rnal 'byor pa chen po'i zhal nas/ rgan po langs pa'i rten dbyug pas byed cing / phyis nas dbyug pa mi 'gyel ba rgan pos mgo nas bzung bas byed pa ltar/dang por skye ba'i rten so thar gyis byed la/de nas gzhan gnod gzhi bcas las log pa de byang chub snying po'i bar mi 'chor bar byang sdom gyis byed ces gsungs so/ /so thar ris bdun ci rigs la gnas pa'i rten la bzang ngan gyi khyad par yod dam med ce na/zla ba sgron ma las/gsum las dge slong mchog yin 'bring //zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar ro//'o na so thar sdom ldan gyis byang sdom bzung pa'i tshe gnas 'gyur ram gnyis ldan gang yin zhe na/ nag tsho'i 'grel par/ de gnyis sdom pa gcig gam tha dad ce na/gcig pa'ang yin tha dad pa'ang yin te/'di ltar sdom pa'i tshul khrims bya

64 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/ba la sogs pa gzhan med kyi/ so sor thar pa rigs bdun po gang 'a gnas pa nyid sdom pa'i tshul khrims yin pas na gcig pa'ang yin no/ /tha dad pa'ang yin te/ so sor thar pa rdzas su 'dod pa dang gzhan la gnod pa byed pa las log nas gnod pa mi byed pa dang / byang sems kyi sdom pa rdzas su mi 'dod pa dang / gzhan la phan pa nyid sgrub pas tha dad pa'ang yin zhes bya'o gsungs so/ /gnyis pa gang las blang ba'i yul ni/spyordom pa'i 31 bltal ma9yagadang / /bdan/nyidasku/nga chikhi/〈(ma la gnas/ /11ma pa 'bogab(bzod snying rjer ldan/ /bla ma bzang por shesaparabya/ /zhes bya ba ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa'i cho ga ste/ yang dag par len pa dang / mi nyams par bsrung ba dang / nyams na phyir bcos pa'i thabs la mkhas pa'i shes rab phun sum tshogs pa dang / bdag nyid gang zhig byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa tshul khrims phun sum tshogs pa la gnas pa dang / byang sems kyi sdom pa 'bogs par bzod pa'i nus pa'am spo bas pa phun sum tshogs pa dang /snyi/nga rje dang ldan pa'i bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa ste bzhi po de dag dang ldan pa ni bla ma bzang por shes par bya zhing / de dag gi nang nas snga ma gnyis gtso che bar zhang ram sogs kyis bzhed do/ /gsum pa ji ltar len nga 'i cho ga la gnyis/ bla ma yod pa'i dang / med pa'i cho ga'o/ /

byang chub lam sgron gyi 'grel pa/ 65dang po (bla ma yod pa'i cho ga )ni/byathalhukho sgamaba'idapa'i sadabaskyogi /〈rmir khrimathasalesdomi gasdormi28galhun ga yisī/ /yardzadagamatshan nyid ldan pa yi/ /bla mabazang 'khogasgyu/snusapa blang / /zhes bya ba ste/ 'phags pa thogs med kyis mdzad pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i sa dag gi nang tshan tshul khrims kyi le'u las gsungs pa'i cho ga yis/ yang dag pa'i mtshan nyid phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa yi bla ma bzang po de las 'jug pa'i sdom pa sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang ba'i snyo nas blang ngo / /de'ang gsol gdab/spro bskyed/ tshogs bsag bskul gdab/ bsam pa khyad par can bskyed pa/ bar chad thun mong ba dri ba/ bslab pa mdor bsngu/sa brjod pa dang bdun ni sbyor ba dang /phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i bslab pa lan gsum gyi bar du len pa ni dngos gzhi dang / mkhyen gsol/ ye shes kyi gzigs pa 'jug pa'i phan yon/ sdom pa mnos pa gya tshom du mi bsgrags pa/ bslab pa mdor bsdus brjod pa/ gtang rag gi mchod pa dang lnga ni mjug gi cho ga'o/ /gnyis pa bla ma med pa'i cho ga la gnyis/ spyi dang bye brag gi sgo nas lung bzhin du bshad par dam bca' ba dang / mdo de las 'byung ba'i sems bskyed dang sdom pa bzung tshul ston pa'o/ / dang po (phyi dang bye brag gi sgo nas lung bzhin du bshad par dam bca' ba )ni/de la 'bad pathasa'adi 'dra ba'i/ /

66 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/ gal te bla ma ma rnyed na/ /de lab(gzhan 1rdomalhasad pa yi/ /chog sprung dag bshad par bya/ /de la sngon tshe 'jam palidapal/ /snya ba 21dzar34ra pa yis/ /ji ltar byang chub thugasabaskyed pa/ /'jam dpalagyi ni sangasargyasazhing / /rgyan mimado lasabashad pa ltar/ /de bzhin 'dirani rab gsal bri/ /zhes bya ba ste/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma de 'dra ba la sdom pa blang bar gsungs pa bzhin shin tu 'bad pas btsal kyang yul dus kyi dbang gis 'di 'dra ba'i bla ma gal te gtan nas ma rnyed na ji ltar bya zhe na/ bla ma yod pa de las gzhan dmigs bsal rang nyid kyis blang ba'i tshul yod de/ bla ma med pa'i sdom pa nod pa yi cho ga lung las gsungs pa bzhin 'dir yang yang dag par bshad par bya ba yin pa'i phyir zhes spyir bshad par dam bcas nas/ 'o na lung gang las bshad ce na/ de la sngon bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i dus kyi tshe 'jam pa'i dpal 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po e ba rā dza te rgyal po nam mkha' zhes bya bar gyur pa yis/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'brug sgra'i dbyangs kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba'i drung du ji ltar bla na med pa'i byang chub tu thugs bskyed pa yi tshul/ 'jam dpal gyis ni sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rgyan gyi bkod pa ston pa'i mdo las bshad pa ltar/

byang chub lam sgron gyi 'grel pa/ 67de bzhin du gzhung 'dir ni rab tu gsal bar bri bar bya'o zhes bye brag tu bshad par dam bca' ba'o/ /gnyis pa mdo de las byung ba'i sems bskyed dang sdom pa bzung tshul la gnyis/sems bskyed dang / sdom pa bzung tshul lo/ /dang po (sems bskyed )ni/mgonasho rnamasakyi spyan snga mā /rdzogasapa'i byang chub semasabaskyed cing / /'gro ba thamasacad mgron duganyer/ /de dag 'khor ba 'kha(sgrol lo/ /zhes bya ba ste/ sems can thams cad kyi mgon po sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi spyan snga mā bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed par byed cing / ched du bya ba nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i 'gro ba ma lus pa thams cad mgron du gnyer ba'am de'i don du/ 'gro ba de dag 'bor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi chu bo las ma brgal ba bsgral ba dang / kun 'byung gi 'ching ba las ma grol ba sgrol lo/ /bdag lta'i dbugs ma phyung ba lam bden gyis dbugs dbyung ba dang / rnam rtog gi yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa 'gog bden gyis mya ngan las 'das pa la dgod cing mgron du gnyer ba'o/ /'dis 'jug pa'i sbyor ba dang smon pa'i dngos gzhi bstan par sha ra bas bzhed do/ /gnyis pa sdom pa bzung tshul la gsum/ nyes spyod sdom pa'i/ sems can don byed kyi/ dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims khas len pa'o/ /

68 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/dang po rkyus spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims khas len pa )ni /gnod semagakhroba'i semasanyid dang / /ser sna dpani phrag doganyid/ /deng nasabazung ste byang chub dag /thob kyi bar du mi bya 'o/ /tshangasapar spyod pa spyad bya zhid/ /sdig dardza'alhasad pa ྅9pa bar bya/ /྅ñdzaspru khrimathagalha/ma pa la dga' bas/ /thasangathag/ltas rjethagasdo/ bslab par bya/ /zhes bya ba ste/ kun nas mnar sems pa'i rgyu dgu gang rung la brten nas zhe sdang gis gsod par 'dod pa la sogs pa'i gnod sems dang / gzhan la 'phral du sems 'khrug pa'i khro ba'i sems nyid dang / yo byad gzhan la gtang mi nus pa'i ser sna dang ni/ gzhan gyi phun tshogs la mi bzod pa'i phrag dog nyid de/ bzhi po de dag sdom pa blangs pa'i nyin de nas bzung ste bla na med pa'i byang chub dag ma thob kyi bar de srid du mi bya'o/ /dbang po gnyis sbyor gyi 'khrig pa spangs pa'i tshangs par spyod pa spyad par bya zhing / sdig pa'i las dang / de'i rgyu 'dod pa'i yul la chags pa rnams spang bar bya'o/ /de dag spangs pa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa rnam par dag pa la dga' bas sangs rgyas rnams kyi spyod pa dam pa'i rjes su legs par bslab par bya'o/ /

byang chub 'a ma sgron gyi 'grel pa/ 69gnyis pa 'ams can don byed kyi tshul khrims khas len pa )n-i/spragazhizhag sa 5'i rmyuspyir+sāsinitrībyangargyus thopacapar h+philjo chikho/ /semamican gzhigagi rgyu mistoni/ /phyi ma'i mu mtharaganamipar bya/ /'e/sa bya ba ste/ bdag nyid myur ba'i tshul gyis te sems kyis ni byang chub thob par mi spro zhing dga' ba med par/ sems can gcig gi don bya ba'i rgyu yis ni phyi ma'i mu mthar thug pa med par wor ba ji srid kyi bar de srid du gnas par bgyid do/ /gsum pa 6ge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims khas len pa )ni/tshad med bsi.a gyisami khyab pa'i/ /zhing dgasnam par sbying bar bya/ /mingazhosigazung ba byasib datha/ /phyogasabasko1dkasgyu rnam paraganas/ /bdabakagibaltashrīsmosadangangag gi 'ayos/ /thamasacad duni dgapar bya/ /yid kyi lagaspyang dgabya ste/ /mi dgi'i lasarnamasami bya'o/ /zhes bya ba ste/ de ltar gnas nas ci byed snya/ma na/ grangs tshad gzung du med cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing dag gis ngam grog dang tsher ma sogs

70 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/skyon rnams rnam par sbyang bar bya zhing / 'gro ba rnams kyis bdag gi ming thos nas bzung bar byas pa dang mthong thos dran reg gis kyang sems can rnams la phan gdags par 'dod pas/ phyogs bcu thams cad kyi zhing dag tu bdag gi ming grags shing rnam par gnas par byed pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi 'jig rten yang sbyang zhing smin par bya'o/ /las dang po bas sdom pa'i tshul khrims nyid la gces spras byed dgos pas slar yang zlos te ston pa ni/ bdag gi lus dang ngag gi las dag rnam pa thams cad du ni lhung bas ma gos par dag par bya zhing / yid kyi las kyang lhung bas dag par bya ste/ mdor na sgo gsum gyi mi dge ba'i las rnams rnam pa thams cad du byang chub ma thob kyi bar du nam yang mi bya'o/ /gsum pa ༷rdom pa blangs nas bslab bya la bslab par bstan pa la gsum/tshul khrims kyi/ sems kyi/ shes rab kyi bslab pa la slob tshul lo/ /dang po la gnyis/ dngos dang / de'i che ba'o/ /dang po 9ngos )ni/rangagi lusangag semasanirnam dag rgyu/ /'jug pa'i semasakyisabadag nyid sdomaganasapas/ /tshul khrimasabaslab pa gsum la legs(bslabasan/ /tshul khrimasabaslab pa gsum la gusacher 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba ste/ 'o na sgo gsum dag byed kyi rgyu gang zhe na/ dgos pa byang sems rang gi lus ngag sems gsum po ni lhung bas rnam par dag cing sems can gzhan rnams la mchog tu phan pa'i rgyu yi phyir du theg chen gyi rigs can 'jug pa'i
