byang chub lam sgron gyi 'grel pa/ 71sems kyi bdag nyid sdom pa la gnas pas/ yul tshul khrims kyi bslab pa gsum la tshul dang mthun par legs par 'bad pas bslabs na/ goms stobs kyis phyis nas sngar bshad pa'i tshul khrims kyi bslab pa gsum la gces spras su 'dzin pa'i gus pa je cher 'gyur ro/ /de la legs pa zhes bya ba'i sgra ni dag pa dang /phyir mi ldog pa dang / yongs su rdzogs pa gsum la 'jug pas/ sdom pa'i tshul khrims la bslabs pas skyes bu gzugs legs pa bzhin du dag pa dang / don byed kyi tshul khrims la bslabs pas rdzogs byang las phyir mi ldog cing mi nyams pas rims nad yongs su byang ba bzhin du 'gyur/ chos sdud kyi tshul khrims la bslabs pas bum pa legs par gang ba bzhin du 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' chen po zhes pa'i sgra don yang gsum po de las 'gyur ba yin te/ sdom pa'i tshul khrims kyis skyon thams cad byang / chos sdud kyi tshul khrims kyis yon tan mtha' dag chub/ don byed kyi tshul khrims kyis sems dpa' chen por 'gyur ba'i phyir zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa (de'i che ba )ni/de bsarnam dag rdzogasabyang chub/ /semasadapa'i sdom pa'i sdom dag ni/ /'bad par byasapasardzogasabyang chub/ /tshogs/ ni yongasasu rdzogasapar 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba ste/ tshul khrims gsum la bslabs pas lus ngag yid gsum dag par 'gyur ba de bas na/ spang bya rnam par dag cing gnyen po'i phyogs yongs su rdzogs

72 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/pa ni 'bras bu bla na med pa'i byang chub yin la/ de nyid gzhan don du thob byar dmigs shing sems pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis sdom pa'i tshul khrims gtso bor gyur pa'i tshul khrims gsum gyi sdom pa rnam par dag cing srung ba la ni/dran shes bag yod dang ldan pa'i sgo nas gus pa chen pos nan tan gyis 'bad par byas pas rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi rgyu bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis ni yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ba yin no/ /gnyis pa sems kyi bslab pa la slob tshul la gnyis/ mngon shes 'byung ba'i rgyu'i phyir zhi gnas la bslab pa dang / zhi gnas la ji ltar slob tshul dngos so/ /dang po khaṃngon shes lūng ba'i rgyu'i phyir zhi gnas la bslab pa )ni/bsod namagaye shetha'irang bzhin gyi/ / tshogatha(ni yongabaltasu rdzogathasapa yi/ /rjo/ni thasangabaltargya'(thamathasacad dag /mngon shegabaskyed pa nyid du bzhed/ /ji ltar 'dab gas ga ma rgyasapa'i/ /byani mkha' la 'phur mi nus/ /de bzhin mngon shesastobasabral bas/ /semasacan don byed nusapa min/ /mngon shetha(ldan pa nyin mtshani gyi/ /bsod nam dag nigang yin de/ /mngon shesadagadang bral gyur la/ /

byang chub lam sgron gyi 'grel pa/ 73skye ba brgyar yang yod ma yin/ /myur du rdzogasapa'i byang chub tshogs/ / yongasasu rdzogasapar 'dodasgyur pa/ / debazhi 'bad byasamangon shesadag /'grub par 'gyur gyi le 'o(gamin/ / zhi gnathagalha/ba pa ma yin pas/ /ma11na thegathas05snangawār mi 95spyar la/ /de phyir zhi gnathagangakhri/ba pa'iphyir/ / yangazhothasamang du 'bad par bya/ /zhes bya ba ste/ de ltar bsod nams dang ye shes kyi rang bzhin gyi tshogs gnyis po yongs su rdzogs shing mthar phyin pa'i rgyu khyad par can ni/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad pa dag gis mngon par shes pa drug bskyed pa nyid du bzhed cing /gzhan don rnam dag sgrub pa'ang mngon shes la rag las te/ ji ltar na 'dab gshog yongs su ma rdzogs pa'i bya ni nam mkha' la 'phur bar mi nus pa yin la/dpe de bzhin du mngon par shes pa'i stobs dang bral bas rang skal dang 'tshams par sems can gyi don rgya chen po byed nus pa ma yin pa'i phyir te/ yum las/rab 'byor dper na bya 'dab ma med pa ni nam mkha' la 'phur mi nus so/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpas kyang mngon par shes pa la ma brten par sems can rnams la chos bstan par mi nus te/ lam gol sar zhugs pas sems can rnams lam du gzud par mi nus so zhes so/ /de yang rdzuwīl gyi mngon shes kyis

74 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/sangs rgyas kyi zhing dang gdul bya gar yod pa'i zhing du 'gro/ gzhan sems shes pas khams dang bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du rtogs/ lha'i rna bas de dag gi skad rig sngon gnas shes pas sngon gyi rgyu rtogs/ lha'i mig gis ma 'ongs par ci 'gyur rig zag zad kyis byang grol gyi lam ston pas theg pa gsum la 'dun pa dang smin cing grol bar byed pa yin no/ /gzhan yang rten byang sems mnyam pa la'ang mngon shes dang ldan pa'i byang sems des nyin mtshan phrugs gcig la sbyang ba'i rang bzhin gyi bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa dag ni gang yin pa de mngon shes dang bral bar gyur pa la skye ba brgyar yang yod pa ma yin no/ /'dis ni ye shes kyi tshogs kyang mtshon no/ /rgyu mtshan des na dus myur du rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob pa'i rgyu tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs par 'dod par gyur pa des ni de'i thabs mngon shes bskyed dgos la/ de yang de'i rgyu la brtson 'grus shugs drag gis 'bad pa cher byas pas mngon shes drug po dag 'grub par 'gyur gyi /le lo'i dbang du byas pas 'grub pa min pas brtson 'grus rtsom dgos so/ /'o na de'i rgyu gang la 'bad ce na/ shin sbyangs rnam dag gis zin pa'i zhi gnas tshul bzhin du grub pa ma yin pas sgom stobs las byung ba'i mngon shes khyad par can 'byung bar mi 'gyur la/ rgyu mtshan de yi phyir zhi gnas bsgrub par bya ba'i phyir du sems gnas pa'i thabs dgu la yang dang yang du 'bad par bya'o/ /gnyis pa zhi gnas ji ltar bslab tshul dngos la gsum/ zhi gnas kyi tshogs brten pa/ zhi gnas ji ltar sgom pa'i tshul/ sgom pa'i phan yon no/ /dang po (zhi gnas kyi tshogs brten pa )ni/zhi gnasayan lag rnamasanyamasapas/ /

byang chub lam sgron gyi 'grel pa/ 75rab tu 'bad de sgom byasakyang/ /loni stobaphrag dgagisakyang / /ting 'dzin 'grub par mi 'kha ro/ /de phyirartang 'dzin tshogasale'u las/ /gsungasapa'i man lag la legasaganas/ /zhes bya ba ste/ 'o na brtson 'grus gcig pus zhi gnas 'grub bam zhe na/ ma yin te zhi gnas kyi yan lag rgyu tshogs rnam par nyams pas ni brtson 'grus drag pos rab tu 'bad de yun ring du bsgoms par byas kyang lo ni mang po stong phrag dag gis kyang zhi gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin 'grub par mi 'gyur ro/ /de ltar yan lag nyams na zhi gnas mi 'grub pa de yi phyir/ mdo sde ting nge 'dzin gyi tshogs kyi le'u dang nyan sa la sogs pa las ji skad gsungs pa'i yan lag rnams la legs par gnas shing bsgrubs pas ting nge 'dzin bskyed par bya'o/ /gnyis pa lta'i gnas ji ltar sgom pa'i tshul )ni/dmigagapagang drangagacig dag la/ /yidani dge la gzhag par bya/ /zhes bya ba ste/ de ltar zhi gnas kyi rgyu tshogs la gnas pa des rgyal bas gsungs pa'i bsgom bya'i dmigs pa tshad thub kyi mdo dang bstan bcos las 'byung ba gang yang rung ba gcig dag la/ sgom byed kyi yid ni dge ba la ste gzhan du mi yengs par rtse gcig tu bzhag par bya'o/ /

76 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/gsum pa (zhi gnas sgom pa'i phan yon )ni/rnal 'byor zhiganasaXspyabagyur na / /mngon shesadagakyanga'agrub par 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba ste/ sngar bshad pa ltar ting nge 'dzin la chu bo'i rgyun bzhin brtson pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i zhi gnas grub par gyur pa na/ de sbyangs pa las mngon par shes pa rnams skye bar ma zad/ mi rtog pa'i ye shes dag kyang 'grub par 'gyur te jo bo nyid kyi zhal nas/mngon shes mthu dang ldan byas dang / /zag med lam ni bskyed pa'i phyir/ /dang por zhi gnas bskyed par bya/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa shes rab kyi bslab pa la slob pa'i tshul la gnyis/ thabs shes zung 'brel gyi 'thad pa bstan pa'i sgo nas lhag mthong la bslab par bstan pa dang /lhag mthong la ji ltar slob pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po la gsum/ lhag mthong shes rab la slob dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dang / thabs shes zung 'brel la slob dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ zung du 'brel ba'i lam dngos bshad pa'o/ /dang po (lhag mthong shes rab la slob dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan )ni/shesarab pha rol phyin spyor dang / /bral bsasgrib pa zad mi 'gyur/ /

byang chub lam sgron gyi 'grel pa/ 77de phyir nyon smrorngucigashethagabya yi/ /sgrib pa ma sdormithagasbring ba'i phyir/ /shelhag24pa pha rol ྅smon rnal 'arkyu1ra/ /rtabakatu thabag 2bo stobazlezlom par bya/ /zhes bya ba ste/ 'o na zhi gnas dang / des drangs pa'i mngon shes bskyed pa tsam gyis chog gam snyam na/ 'jig rten pa'i bsam gtan gyis nyon mongs mngon gyur spong na yang de kho na nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sbyor ba'am rnal 'byor dang bral bas sgrib pa gnyis po gang gi yang sa bon zad par mi 'gyur te/ slob dpon chen po tsan+d+ra go sīs/bsam gtan nags mes yang dang yang du ni/ /nyes pa'i tshang tshing mang po bsregs byas kyang / /bdag lta'i rtsa ba brtan po ma phyung na/ /char gyi brlan bzhin mdun nas rab tu bskyed/ /ces so/ /rgyu mtshan de yi phyir na chags sogs nyon mongs pa dang gnyis snang zhabrul ba'i bag chags shes bya'i sgrib pa ma lus pa spang ba'i phyir/ de nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rnal wor dus rtag tu sbyin sogs kyi thabs dang bcas pa'i sgo nas bsgom par bya dgos te/ spyod 'jug las/nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib pa yi/ /mun pa'i gnyen po stong pa nyid/ /

78 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/myur du thams cad mkhyen 'dod pas/ /de ni ji ltar sgom mi byed/ /ces so/ /de la rkang pa snga ma gnyis kyis de kho na nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab dang bral na nyon mongs ci yang sbong mi nus pas nyan rang la'ang stong nyid phra mo rtogs pa yod par bstan/ phyi ma bzhis theg pa che chung lta bas mi 'byed pas theg pa chen po'i bgrod pa rnams kyis thabs rgya chen pos zin pa'i shes rab la slob dgos par bstan to gsungs/gnyis pa (6bas shes zung 'brel la slob dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan )ni/thabagadang bral ba'i shesarab dpa/ /shesarab bral ba'i thabagadag kyang / /gang phyir 'ching ba zhesagasupasapa/ /de bsaganyisaka spang mi bya/ /zhes bya ba ste/ de ltar na thabs dang bral ba'i shes rab kho na dang / shes rab dang bral ba'i thabs gcig pu nyid kyis kyang sangs rgyas mi thob pas/ rdzogs byang don du gnyer ba'i gang zag gis thabs shes zung 'brel gyi lam la slob dgos te/ rgyu mtshan gang gi phyir na bcom ldan 'das kyis dri ma med par grags pas bstan pa'i mdo las/ thabs dang bral ba'i shes rab ni 'ching ba'o/ /shes rab dang bral ba'i thabs ni 'ching ba'o zhes gsungs pa de bas na gnyis ka gang yang spang zhing dor bar mi bya'o/ /

byang chub lam sgron gyi 'grel pa/ 79gsum pa zung 'brel gyi lam dngos bshad pa la gnyis/ mdor bstan pa dang /rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po rkyudor bstan pa )ni/shesarab gang dang thabasagang zhes/ /the tshomi dag ni ྅9paba'i phyir/ /thabasarnamasadangani shesarab kyi/ /mang dgadabye ba gsal bar bya/ /zhes bya ba ste/ 'o na de dag so so'i ngo bo gang yin zhe na/ shes rab ni gang dang /thabs ni gang yin zhes ma rtogs pa dang / log par rtog pa dang / the tshom du gyur pa dag ni spang ba'i phyir/ thabs rnams dang ni shes rab kyi mtshan nyid 'dres pa lta bur snang ba de phyin ci ma log par yang dag pa nyid du so so'i dbye ba'am khyad par ma 'dres par gsal bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la gsum/ thabs ngos bzung ba/ de goms pa'i dgos pa/ shes rab ngos gzung ba'o/ /dang po (thabs ngos gzung ba )ni/shesarab pha rol phyin spangasapa'i/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin la sogs/ /dge ba'i chosarnamasathamasacad dag /rgyal ba rnams kyisathabasasulhag da/ /

80 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/ces bya ba ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa spangs pa'am logs su bkar nas/de las gzhan byang chub sems kyis zin pa'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la sogs pas mtshon pa'i dkar po dge ba'i chos rnams thams cad pa mtha' dag dus gsum gyi rgyal ba rnams kyis thabs kyi phyogs su gtogs pa yin par bshad do/ /gnyis pa de goms pa'i dgos pa )ni/thabatha/thegamathagadabang githasabadag nyid kyis/ /gang :nyan thegabazhurab rnam balha(ma pa/ /detha9ni byang zhes khyur du 'a31ba/ /bdabaskyo:sprod bas:ba/ 〈rgya banywa|ma pathayo:sgon/ /zhes bya ba ste/ mi rtag pa dang las 'bras nas brtsams te sbyin pa la sogs pa'i thabs rnams goms pa shin tu brtan par byas pa'i dbang gis/ byang sems pa dag rang nyid kyis phyi nang gi dngos po gang yang rung ba zhig la dmigs nas mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i dmigs gtad gcod pa'i shes rab rnam par sgom pa nyid sgrib pa sbong ba la nus pa shin tu che bas na/ des ni bla na med pa'i byang chub myur ba nyid du thob par 'gyur gyi/ thabs kyi cha khyad du bsad nas bdag med gcig pu bsgom pas bla med byang chub 'grub pa min no/ /gsum pa 'as rab ngos gzung ba )ni/phung po khamasadang skye mchedarnams/ /skye ba med par rtogagagyur pa'i/ /

byang chub lam sgron gyi 'grel pa/ 81 rangabazhin stong nyid shesapani/ /shesarab cesaniyopasasubashad/ / ces bya ba ste/ phung po lnga dang / khams bco brgyad dang / skye mched bcu gnyis te/chos sum cu rtsa lnga po de rnams ni chos can nam dmigs pa'o/ /de rnams kyi steng du nges bya'i chos sam rnam pa ni rang bzhin gyis skye ba med par rtogs shing shes par bya ba yin te/ 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo ni ji ltar snang ba'i dngos po 'di dag la bden par zhen pa nyid yin la/ bden zhen rnams las kyang rang bzhin gyis skye bar 'dzin pa nyid dngos 'dzin gzhan gyi rten yin pas ldog dgos/de la rang bzhin gyis skye ba med par rtogs dgos pa'i phyir/ de ltar na sngar yod pa zhig phyis med du song ba lta bu'ang ma yin par gzod ma nas stong pa yin pas rang bzhin gyis skye ba med par rtogs par gyur pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong nyid du shes pa ni/ thabs shes gnyis kyi nang nas shes rab ces ni yongs su bshad la shes rab kyi bslab pa'i gtso bo yang de yin no/ /gnyis pa lhag mthong la ji ltar slob pa'i tshul la gnyis/ rgyas par bshad pa dang / mjug bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la gsum/ lhag mthong gi tshogs brten pa/ lhag mthong sgom pa'i tshul/ bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ rigs pa la brten pa bsam byung gi shes rab dang / lung la brten pa thos byung gi shes rab bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ 'bras bu la dpyod pa yod med skye 'gog gi gtan tshigs/ rgyu la dpyod pa rdo rje zegs ma'i gtan tshigs/ ngo bo la dpyod pa gcig du bral gyi gtan tshigs so/ /

82 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/dang po ('bras bu la dpyod pa yod med skye 'gog gi gtan tshigs )ni/yod pa skye ba rigasamin te/ /med ba'ang nam mkha3me rtagabazhin/ /nyesapa gnyisadar thal 'gyur phyir/ /gnyisakadagakyang 'byung ba min/ /zhes bya ba ste/ gong du rang bzhin gyis skye ba med par brtags pa'i blos shes rab tu bstan pa la/ dngos smra ba rnams na re/ mi 'thad de/ dngos po rnams rang bzhin gyis skye 'jig mngon sum du grub pa'i phyir zhe na/ 'o na myu gu rang bzhin gyis skye na rgyu'i dus na yod pa'am med pa'am/ gnyis ka'am/ gnyis ka ma yin pa zhig rang bzhin gyis skye bar brtag grang / dang po ltar na myu gu chos can/ rgyu yi dus su yod pa skye ba rigs pa min te/ yod pa grub zin pas skye ba dgos pa med pa'i phyir dang /grub zin skye na skye ba thug med du 'gyur ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ltar na/ rgyu'i dus su med pa'ang rang bzhin gyis skye ba rigs pa ma yin te/ rgyu nus pa ri ltar che yang rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i myu gu bskyed mi nus pa'i phyir/ dper na nam mkha'i me tog bzhin no/ /rgyu'i dus su med na spyir med mi dgos kyang / rang bzhin gyis grub pa zhig rgyu'i dus su med na rnam pa thams cad du med dgos te/ sngon byung da lta med ces pa/ /des na chad par thal bar 'gyur/ /zhes pas bstan pa'i rigs pas so/ /gsum pa ltar na/ sngar bshad pa'i nyes pa gnyis kar thal bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ rgyu'i dus su yod pa dang med pa gnyis ka dag kyang rang bzhin gyis 'byung ba rigs pa min no/ /bzhi pa ltar na yang mi 'thad de/ rgyu'i dus su yod

byang chub lam sgron gyi 'grel pa/ 83pa'ang ma yin med pa'ang ma yin pa'i dngos po phung gsum pa de 'dra mi srid pa'i phyir/ de ltar na myu gu chos can/ rang bzhin gyis skye ba med de/ yod pa dang / med pa dang / gnyis ka dang / gnyis ka ma yin pa rang bzhin gyis mi skye ba'i phyir zhes pas shes rab kyi yul skye med rigs pas sgrub pa min te/ stong nyid bdun cu pa 95thaṭa/yod pa yod phyir skye ma yin/ /med pa med phyir skye ma yin/ /chos mi mthun phyir gnyis chos min/ /skye ba med phyir gnas 'gag min/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa (rgyu la dpyod pa rdo rje zegs ma'i gtan tshigs )ni/dngosapo rangalasami skye zhing / /gzhan dang gnyisaka'akha(kyangamin/ /rgyu med lasamin de yi phyir/ /ngobo nyid kyisarang bzhin med/ /ces bya ba ste/ phyi nang gi dngos po rnams chos can/ rang las mi skye ste/ de ltar na skye ba don med dang thug med du 'gyur zhing / rgyu dang 'bras bu gcig nyid na/ /bskyed bya skyed byed gcig tu 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i gnod byed kyang 'jug pa'i phyir/ngo bo nyid kyis gzhan las kyang mi skye ste/ ngo bo nyid kyis gzhan yin na phan

84 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/gdags bya 'dogs byed 'brel med du 'gyur/ de ltar na thams cad las thams cad skye bar 'gyur ba'i phyir dang / rgyu dang 'bras bu gzhan nyid na/ /rgyu dang rgyu min mtshungs par 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i rigs pas gnod pa'i phyir/ 'di ni gcig du bral gyi rigs pa'i snying po can yang yin te/ bdag skye 'gog pa'i gcig dang /gzhan skye 'gog pa'i rang bzhin gyis tha dad yin pa 'gog pa'i phyir/ bdag gzhan gnyis ka las kyang skye ba min te/ bdag gzhan re re ba las skye ba khegs pa'i phyir/ rgyu med las kyang skye ba min te/ de ltar na 'jig rten pa rnams 'bras bu ston thog 'byung ba'i phyir zhing las la 'bad pa'ang don med pa'i phyir dang / rgyu med gzhan la mi ltos phyir/ /rtag tu yod pa'am med par 'gyur/ /zhes pas gnod byed thog tu 'bab pa'i phyir/ de ltar mtha' bzhi las skye ba mi 'thad pa de yi phyir dngos po rnams ngo bo nyid kyis rang bzhin med do/ /gsum pa lta'o bo la dpyod pa gcig du bral gyi gtan tshigs )ni/yangan cho ltarnamasathamasacad dag /gcig dang du masarnamadabyadan/ / ngosngon nyid ni mi dmigatha'ipas/ /rangabazhin med pa nyid du nges/ /zhes bya ba ste/ sngar bshad pa las yang na rigs pa'i rnam grangs gzhan phyi nang gi chos rnams thams cad pa dag ni chos can/ rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i gcig dang de ltar grub pa'i du mas rnam par dpyad na yul steng nas grub pa'i ngo bo nyid ni rdul tsam yang mi dmigs pas na/ rang bzhin gyis grub pa med pa nyid du nges te /

byang chub lam sgron gyi 'grel pa/ 85dper na me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin no/ /gnyis pa lung la brten nas thos byung gi shes rab bstan pa ni/stong nyid bdun cu'irigabaltapa datha/ /dbu ma rtsa ba sogasalab(kyang / /dngogapo rnamasakyi rangabazhin ni/ /stong pa nyid du grub bshad pa/ /gang phyir gzhud ni mapasdo/riwās/ /de phyir 'dir ni ma sprosal/ /grub pamigrub mtha' tsam zhigasgyu/ /bsgom pa'i don du rab skyobashad/ /ces bya ba ste/ blo gros dang ldan pa rnams kyis stong nyid zab mo la nges pa yang dag par drang ba'i phyir stong nyid nges don gyi lung gis sgrub pa mdo kun las btus pa dang / rigs pas sgrub pa stong nyid bdun cu pa'i gzhung las byung ba'i rigs pa dang / stong nyid zab mo rigs pa'i rnam grangs mtha' yas pa'i sgo nas gtan la 'bebs pa dbu ma rtsa ba la sogs pa'i rigs pa'i tshogs rnams dang / lhag par 'phags pa'i dgongs pa 'grel ba'i mchog sangs rgyas bskyangs dang zla ba'i zhabs/ zhi ba lha'i gzhung rnams las kyang dngos po rnams kyi rang bzhin nam gnas tshul nyid gdod ma nas stong pa nyid du grub par bshad pa la rgya cher blta zhing lta ba'i phu thag chod par bya'o/ /'o na lung dang rigs pa rgya chen po de dag rgyu mtshan gang gi phyir 'dir mi 'god ce na/ de dag 'dir bkod na gzhung ni shin tu

86 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/mang bar 'gyur gyi dogs nas rgyu mtshan de yi phyir 'dir ni de dag ma spros la/'on kyang lung rigs kyis grub pa'i grub mtha' tsam zhig tu cung zad bstan pa ni/bdag med sgom pa'i don du rab tu bsdus te bshad pa yin no/ /de yang / stong nyid bdun cu'i rigs pa dang / /zhes pa 'dis rten 'brel chen po'i gtan tshigs bstan par bzhed pa ltar na/ blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa las/ gang rnams rten cing 'brel bar 'byung / /de rnams ngo bo nyid kyis med/ /ces rten 'byung gi rtags kyis rang bzhin gyis grub pa 'gog pa gsal bar gsungs shing / ma dros pas sdokyis pa las kyang /gang zhig rkyen las skyes pa de ma skyes/ /de la skye ba'i rang bzhin yod ma yin/ /rkyen la rag las gang de stong pa ste/ /gang gis stong nyid shes de bag yod yin/ /zhes gsal bar gsungs te/ de yang rkang pa dang pos ma skyes zhes gsungs pa'i don ni/ rkang pa gnyis pas de la skye ba'i rang bzhin yod ma yin zhes bshad pas skye ba 'gog pa la dgag bya'i khyad par sbyar ba yin no/ /rkang pa gsum pas rkyen tshogs pa'i rten 'brel la rag las pa gang yin pa de ni stong pa'i don du gsungs te/ de'ang rang bzhin gyis grub pas stong pa rten 'byung gi don yin gyi skye tsam bkag pa'i snang tsam du don byed pas stong pa min par bstan to/ /rtsa shes las kyang /rten cing 'byung ba gang yin pa/ /de ni ngo bo nyid kyis zhi/ /

byang chub lam sgron gyi 'grel pa/ 87zhes brten nas 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis ngo bo nyid kyis grub pas zhi ba'am stong par gsungs so/ /de 'dra ba'i rten 'byung gi gtan tshigs la shin tu bsngags te ma ༷dus pas zhus pa las/mkhas pas rten 'byung chos rnams rtogs 'gyur te/ /mthar lta ba la brten par yong mi byed/ /ces rten 'byung ji bzhin du rtogs pas mthar 'dzin gyi lta ba la mi brten par gsungs te/ 'di ni bdag nyid chen po klu sgrub yab sras kyi khyad chos bla na med pa'o/ /de yang 'di ltar lta ba rnam dag gi gegs dang gol sa'i gtso bo ni gnyis te/ chos rnams la bden par 'dzin pa'i bden 'dzin gyi dmigs gtad can gyi rtag lta sgro 'dogs kyi lta ba dang / rgyu 'bras rten 'byung gi nges pa rang lugs la drang du med par song nas 'di yin dang min gyi ngos bzung bya sa med pa chad lta skur 'debs kyi lta ba'o/ /de gnyis ni rgyu rkyen 'di las 'bras bu 'di 'byung la nges pa drangs pa'i gtan tshigs la brten nas rang bzhin gyis grub pa bkag pa na ma lus pa spong ba yin te/ gtan tshigs kyi don nges pas chad lta dang / dam bcas pa'i don nges pas ni rtag lta rtsa ba nas sun 'byin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na myu gu la sogs pa phyi dang 'du byed la sogs pa nang gi dngos po rnams/ rim pa bzhin du sa bon log pa dang ma rig pa la sogs pa la brten nas 'byung la/ de lta yin na de dag la rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pa mi 'thad de/ rang gi ngo bo nyid kyis grub na ni rang la dbang ba'i tshugs thub kyi rang bzhin grub dgos pas rgyu rkyen la rag las pa 'gal ba'i phyir/ 'dis ni gang zag dang bum pa sogs kyang rang gi

88 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/tshogs par brten nas btags pa yin pas rang bzhin med par shes par bya'o/ /brten nas skyes pa dang brten nas btags pa yin na gang la brten pa de dang ngo bo nyid kyis grub pa'i gcig tu med do/ /gcig tu yod na bya byed thams cad gcig tu 'gyur ro/ /de gnyis ngo bo nyid du grub pa'i gzhan du'ang med de/ yod na 'brel ba 'gog nus pas de la ltos pa 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /rtsa shes las kyang /gang la brten te gang 'byung ba/ /de ni re zhig de nyid min/ /de las gzhan pa'ang ma yin te/ /de phyir chad min rtag ma yin/ /zhes so/ /de ltar mtshan 'dzin gyi dmigs gtad mtha' dag gis stong pa'i stong nyid kyi nges pa drangs nas las 'bras kyi 'brel ba'i nges pa mi 'dor bas 'dor len bsten pa la shin tu bsngags te/ byang chub sems 'grel las/chos rnams stong pa 'di shes nas / /las dang 'bras bu bsten pa gang / /ngo mtshar bas kyang 'di ngo mtshar/ /rmad byung bas kyang 'di rmad byung / /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar 'ong ba la ni rang bzhin gyis yod pa dang / yod tsam dang / rang gi mtshan nyid kyis med pa dang / med pa'i khyad par phyed dgos te/'jug 'grel las/ gzugs brnyan rang bzhin med pa'i rgyu dang 'bras bu'i rnam

byang chub lam sgron gyi 'grel pa/ 89par gzhag pa yang shes bzhin du/ mkhas pa su zhig gzugs dang tshor ba la sogs pa rgyu dang 'bras bu las tha dad med par gnas pa rnams yod pa tsam zhig tu dmigs pas rang bzhin dang bcas par nges par byed/ de'i phyir yod par dmigs kyang rang bzhin gyis skye ba med do zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de dag ma phyed na dngos po yod phyin chad rang gi ngo bos yod pa dang / rang gi ngo bos med phyin chad ye med du song nas sgro 'dogs dang skur 'debs kyi mtha' gnyis las mi 'da' bar gsungs so/ /des na rang gi ngo bos med pas yod mtha' thams cad dang / de nyid la rang bzhin med pa'i rgyu 'bras 'jog nus pas med mtha' thams cad las grol lo/ /mdor na chos rnams bden par 'dzin pa dang / cir yang ma grub pa dang yod pa min par 'dzin pa ni/ yang dag pa'i don gyi ldog phyogs kyi rtag chad kyi mthar lhung ba yin gyi/ chos rnams don dam par med pa dang las 'bras sogs tha snyad du yod par 'dzin pa sogs ni mthar 'dzin min te/ gzung ba ltar du yul de snang tsam du de ltar gnas pa'i phyir te/ stong nyid bdun cu pa las/'di rten 'di 'byung zhes bya ba'i/ /'jig rten tshul 'di 'gog mi mdzad/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa lhag mthong sgom tshul ni/1sno tshabathas:rgyas(rnabya/thagaglu/ sdormikhragab:)/ /tho9pa ba:ston dab/ni :spro da:sgob/jigapathab/ /bdabakyimed pa ni sne(glusaskang nyid/ /

90 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/'dini shesarab sgom payin/ / shesarab kyiganichosarnamagakun/ /gangagi rangabazhin ma mthong bzhin/ /shesarab de nyid rigasadabyad pa/ /rnam rtog med par de bsgom bya/ /zhes bya ba ste/ phung khams skye mched kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad bden med du gtan la phab pa de bas na/ gang zag dang phung po sogs kyi chos rnams lhag ma ma lus pa'i rang bzhin dag ni yod na lung dang rigs pas btsal ba'i tshe rnyed dgos pa las rdul tsam yang mi dmigs pas na/ gang zag dang chos la ngo bos grub pa'i bdag med pa nyid ni yin no/ /zhes rigs pas rnam par dpyad cing sgom pa gang nyid yin pa de nyid shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgom pa yin te/ sgom rim bar ma las/ shes rab kyis dngos po mtha' dag gi ngo bo nyid la so sor brtags nas gang gi phyir mi dmigs par bsam gtan byed pa de'i phyir/ shes rab mchog gi bsam gtan pa zhes bya ste zhes gsungs pas so/ /'o na de ltar rtogs mkhan gyi shes rab nyid la 'dzin pa ji ltar spong zhe na/ so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis ni gang zag dang chos rnams kun la dpyad pa'i tshe/ gang gi yang rang bzhin bden grub tu ma mthong ba bzhin du shes rab de nyid kyang rigs pas rnam par dpyad pa na rang bzhin gyis bden grub tu med de/ bden pa'i gcig dang bden pa'i du ma dang bral ba'i phyir/de ltar yul can skye med du rtogs pa gang yin pa de nyid rnam par rtog pa med par gnas pa mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi rgyur nges pas de bsgom par bya'o/ /

byang chub lam sgron gyi 'grel pa/'igasurnyi pa lhag mthodā bsgom pa'i 'bras bu la gnyis/dngos kyi don dang /de nyad luX ḍi bsgrugā dzo/)'i/dang pa dngos kya dan na/rnam rtog lasabyuji lhad bzlodi//rnarnyi par rtogapabadagatsāde//de ra ma lusartog spang/kha//mya ga 'dasapa mchog na no//zhes bya ba ste/'ibyāden 'aspyo gyi rnama'i par rtog pa las byung spying de'i ti can gyi khams gsum tram̐ srad ༷ 'ardzur ba ༷da'i thatram̐s cad rnam drir rtag pa~X sgra baphrigs nas ༷zhag pa' bdaganyadad/ /daya phyar na ma lus ṭ+wāṃng lusapa 'id pa' rnam par rtag pa bag dzogardzu dangh+ru bcas pa kun spaḍisbya pa na/ gnas pa' mya zlon rdzus 'das zlo thar /sa sprachag thaṅgi pa rang gzha/ sa dan thams cad 'grub pa yan na//gnyas pa da nyad lung sa bsgrub pa na/de ltar yabani bcom ldan gyis//rnam rtog ma rig ོbo ste// ltorab//ma྾ yi r+sā byed//rtog med /sdonalaganasapa//nam mkhaṭ+wāṃb durtogamed//sal//ge'akhongasaso//rnam par /ga pa la ༷/gawāgazungasalasakyang /dam chosa' la rgyal ba sras//

92 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/rnam par mi rtog bsam gyuran/ /rnam rtog bgrod dka'arnamasa'adasate/ /rimagyisami rtog thob par 'gyur/ /pokhasungasaso/ /zhes bya ba ste/ 'o na 'khor ba rnam rtog las byung ba dang bdag med bsgom pas de nyid spong nus pa'i khungs ji ltar yin zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis sam+bu ṭa'i rgyud las/ dngos por 'dzin pa'i rnam par rtog pa 'di ni srid pa'i rtsa bar gyur pa'i ma rig pa chen por zhes bya ste/ gting mtha' med pa'i 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor lhung bar byed pa po yin pa'i phyir/ bden 'dzin gyi rnam rtog gi gnyen por bdag med pa'i don rigs pas dpyad de nges pa rnyed pa'i tshe/ dpyad mthar rnam rtog dang bral ba'i rtog med kyi ting nge 'dzin la gnas shing goms par byas pas goms pa rab kyi mthar phyin pa na/ ston dus kyi sprin dang bral ba'i nam mkha' bzhin du rtog pa med pa'i sems kyi chos nyid gsal bar mngon sum du mthong ba yin no zhes gsungs te/ ji skad du/rnam rtog ma rig chen po ste/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor lhung bar byed/ /rtog med ting 'dzin la gnas na/ /nam mkha' bzhin tu therteg med gsal/ /zhes so/ /gzhan yang rnam par mi shertog pa la 'jug pa'i gzungs las kyang / theg pa chen po'i dam pa'i chos zab mo 'di la thos bsam gyi shes rab sngon du 'gro ba'i rgyal

byang chub lam sgron gyi 'grel pa/ 93ba'i sras pos mtshan 'dzin gyi yid byed dang 'gal ba'i mi mthun phyogs ni rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin yin la/ de bsams shing goms par gyur na mtshan ma la spyod pa'i rnam rtog gi dra ba bgrod par dka' ba rnams las rnam par 'das te/ rim gyis rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes thob par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs te/dam chos 'di la rgyal ba'i sras/ /rnam par mi rtog bsams gyur na/ /rnam rtog bgrod dka' rnams 'das te/ /rim gyis mi rtog thob par stir/ /zhes mdo rgyud gnyis kyi lung gis bsgrubs par mdzad do/ /gnyis pa mjug bsdu ba ni/sdorming dang :rdogathagab dab/8)thagani/ /33garnamathagathamalhagacad snye med pa'i/ /'dzipa4ba:sngon med 268 ngethagabyathazhinas/ /rnam par shertog med nga ltom par bya/ /zhes bya ba ste/ de ltar nges don gyi lung dang dri ma med pa'i rigs pa'i tshogs dag gis ni/ gang zag dang phung po sogs kyis bsdus pa'i chos rnams thams cad bden par skye ba med pa'am skye ba'i rang bzhin med par nges shing sgro 'dogs chod par byas nas/ yin lugs kyi don la mtshan 'dzin gyi rnam par rtog pa med par rtse gcig tu bsgom par bya ste/ thos pa'i rjes 'jug sgrub pa snying por bya/ /skye ba'i

94 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/rdzong las tshegs chung thar bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag bshad pa ni/de ltar de nyid bsgom byasan/ /rimagyisadrod sogasathob byasanas/ /rab dga' la sogasathob 'gyur te/ /sangasargyasabyang chub kun mi ripa/ /zhes bya ba ste/ de ltar skyabs 'gro thun mong ba nas bzung ste/ skyes bu chung 'bring gi lam la blo legs par sbyangs nas/ smon 'jug gi sems gnyis bskyed de thabs rgya chen pos zin pa'i sgo nas zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gi de kho na nyid bsgom par byas na/ tshogs lam chung 'bring chen po gsum legs par bgrod de/ rim gyis drod la sogs pa nges par 'byed pa'i cha dang mthun pa bzhi thob par byas nas/ sa dang po rab tu dga' ba dang gnyis pa dri ma med pa la sogs pa nas bzung ste bcu pa'i rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin bar gyi gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu 'thob par gyur te/ de las mthar thug gi 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi byang chub chen po sku gsum ye shes lnga ldan kyi go 'phang yang yun mi ring bar myur ba nyid du thob nas/ skal ba dang ldan pa'i 'gro ba mtha' yas pa smin cing grol bar byed pa'i phrin las lhun gyis grub pa dang rgyun mi chad par 'khor ba ji srid du 'byung ba yin te/ de bzhin 'bor ba ji srid du/ /las ni rgyun mi chad par 'dod/ /ces gsungs so/ /gnyis pa sngags la 'jug pa'i tshul mdo tsam bstan pa la gsum/ rdo rje theg pa la ‘༄cag pas dbang thob dgos par bstan pa/ rten gyi khyad par gyis dbang

byang chub lam sgron gyi 'grel pa/gong ma 3nyisabyar rung ṭ+wāṃ rung gi tshul/ོdbang sdod ma gnyis ma thob n+d+ra rgyud nyan bshada'i sag/sa gīr rung rung dpyad pa'//dang gā la gsum/rtespya gya gang zag de la sman /je kya ḍibang bskudi ḍi/dbang bskur ba' che ba bstan pa'//dang po na gya gang zag na/sngagasamathu nyid lasagrubasprayikyi//zhi dang rgyasasogasalasarnamaga'is//bumasprabazang grub la sogagapa//grub chen brgyad sogasastobasakyisakyang //bde ba yisanibyang chub tshogs//yopasasu rdzogasapar 'dodawā daṭ+wāṃ//byab spyod sogasargyudagasungasapa//gal te gsangasngagasaspyod 'dod na//zhes byā ba ste/ de ltarapharaphyinathegapa'i lugasna kyi phyin drug bsni bzhi'i nyaXs lespya gyas san ༵sa su sdigs par wīr ba ban sni rdo rje snrog pa' sa lam sngis ༷grad r+sha' rten ltar dgakyi na/ spragardzu bzlas pa' mthu dzodu las gruḍi pa yan no/ / ba dang rgyardzu pa la sags ༷'a phran lasashaṃ ma pa bzha pa rnams kyadī daX /'dad dguX khyung bsdo ṣ+ṭṛm pa drozang pa grub pa lda sags pa dang 'i/ sdib pa 'in pa brgyaspya la ༷saṭ+wāṃpa'3 bas sdig kyangs lam bad ba dung myur ba yas na rang ga gīng chub na pa' gas kyings su sdogs shadā /gzhan dan thams rjod sgrub par 'das+t+ri pa dang / bya ba dang spyad pa la sags pa' rgyud sde rnams las skad gsungs pa'

96 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/gsang sngags kyi spyod pa thams cad gal te tshul bzhin du nyams su blang bar 'dod pa dang ldan na/ de nyid gsang sngags kyi rten du rung bar rig par bya'o/ /gnyis pa (di la smin byed kyi dbang bskur ba )ni/de tshe slob dpon dbang bskur phyir/ /bsnyen bkun rin chen sogatha9nin dang / /bka'251ba la sogasathamasacad kyis/ /bla ma dam pa mnyekhegapar bya/ /bla ma mnyeblogapar /smir pa yis /skyesangatha/:rdogathag11ba da21na dbang balha/ra bas/ /zhes bya ba ste/ rdo rje theg pa'i lam rten gyi gang zag de nyid gsang sngags la 'jug par 'dod pa de'i tshe/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma dam pa mnyes par bya ste/dgos pa gang gi don du na/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang bskur thob pa'i phyir du'o/ /'dis ni mchog dbang gong ma gsum yang mtshon no/ /tshul ji ltar na/ lus ngag gis bsnyen bkur ba dang / rin chen dang / bgo ba dang / bza' btung dang / rkang bran la sogs pa ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin gyi yo byad sbyin pa dang / bka' bstsa la dang du blangs nas tshul bzhin du bsgrub pa la sogs pa sgo gsum gyi dngos po thams cad kyis bla ma dam pa de nyid mnyes par bya ba yin te/ bkur sti rnyed pa dag dang rim gro dang / /sgrub pa'i sgo nas bshes gnyen bsten par bya/ /zhes pa lta/ra ro/ /de ltar bla ma mnyes par gyur pa na/ slob ma de yis dbang don du gsol ba btab nas/ mtha' rten rjes gnang dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i rdo rje slob dpon

byang chub lam sgron gyi 'grel pa/ 7gyi dbang bskuḍi bas slob ma radā ṭ+wāṃd gsang sngak+ṣiṃ'i kyi snod rung du bya'o//gsum pa dbang bskur ba' ba bstan pa na/sdiṭ+wāṃ kun rnam dgabaṭ+wāṃgar+sāni//dasagrub bsgrub paskal ldan 'gyur//zhes bya zlo tram̐/'igong du bshad pa ltar dbang bzhi rdzogs par bsdir bso/ sgo gsum kyā sngi sgraX sag chagardzu dadā baXs pa kun rnam par dag caḍi / slab ma bdag nyad na thuspya mang dang mchag ga dngas grub thams cad sgrub pa' skal ba dang rtanin payi/pa khun/spyabye/zenga'i// 'i bsgo 'i :sku 8) 'iganyas pa na gya khyad par gyas dbang gang ma gnyas byar rung rung tshul na/dngatsho4sargyasargyud chesprak+ṣiṃ//rabatul/dpagabakagapa sna//garnab ṭ+wāṃrab dbang ṭ+wāṃskur//tshak+tapar daspras/kā bya//gal k+tabababaskur na na//r+sāsad dka' tso la gaspraṭ+wāṃpas//bkag pa sbyahūṃ wo k+ṣiṃrabater//dka' thubam ba denyamasayi/ /gal zhug/rdzun pham ba ṣ+ka//lhungab dag 'byunga'agyur //

98 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/de ningan songaresartsapabs/ /grub panam mthayod ma yin/ /zhes bya ba ste/ 'o na dbang bskur de dag dngos grub 'dod pa'i gang zag thams cad kyis blang ba yin nam zhe na/ dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'bor lo'i rtsa ba'i rgyud chen po las/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rab tu 'bad pas bkag pa chen po mdzad pa'i phyir gsang ba dang shes rab ye shes kyi dbang / gzhan la bskur ba tshangs par spyod pa'i dge bsnyen dang rab byung sde lnga gang rung gi tshul khrims la gnas pas mi bya zhing / rang nyid kyis kyang dngos su blang bar mi bya'o/ /'o na skyon ci zhig gzigs nas dbang de gnyis tshangs spyod sogs la bkag ce na/ gal te dbang bskur ba gnyis po de dag gang zag de rnams kyis dngos su 'dzin cing blang ba sogs byas na/tshangs spyod kyi dka' thub dang rab byung gi sdom pa la gnas pas ni ston pas bkag pa spyad par 'gyur ba'i phyir tshangs spyod kyi dka' thub dang rab byung gi sdom pa de nyams par 'khru/ra te/ tshul khrims kyi brtul zhugs can de dag la pham pa dang pham pa 'dra ba yi rtsa ba'i lhung ba dag ni 'byung bar 'gyur zhing / lhung bas nyams pa'i gang zag de dag ni ngan song gsum du nges par lhung bar 'gyur bas na dngos grub 'grub pa yang dus nam yang yong ba ma yin te/ jo bo nyid kyi zhal nas/ gsang ba dang shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ni tshangs par spyod pa grol ba'i lam pas mi bskur zhing slob mas kyang mi blang ngo / des ni tshangs par spyod pa zad par byed pa dang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nub par byed pas/ sems can dmyal bar slob dpon de dang slob ma gnyis the tshom med par 'gro bar 'gyur ro zhes gsungs so/ /

byang chub lam sgron gyi 'grel pa/ 99gsum pa dbang gong ma gnyis ma thob na rgyud bshad nyan sogs byar rung mi rung gi dogs pa spang ba ni/rgyud kun nyan dang 'chad pa dang / /sbyin sreg mchod sbyin sogasabyedaya/ /slobadapon dbangabaskur balhagagyur cing / /de nyid rig la nyesapa med/ /ces bya ba ste/ gal te tshangs par spyod pas dbang de gnyis dngos su blang du mi rung na gsang sngags spyod pa'i skal ba med par 'gyur ro zhe na/ skyon med de/ bya ba la sogs pa'i rgyud sde bzhi po kun la slob mas nyan pa dang / slob dpon gyis 'chad pa dang / thun mong du gnyis kas spyin sreg dang mchod spyin dang rab gnas dbang bskur la sogs pa byed pa la/ slob dpon gyis dbang bskur ba rjes 'brang dang bcas pa brnyes pa'am thob par 'gyur zhing de kho na nyid bcu rig pa'i gang zag dag la nyes pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa rgyu gang la brten nas brtsams pa ni/gnasabartan mar me mdzad dpal gyis/ /mawas the(gatha(snar+shag da mthongab/ /byapachub 'od kyisagasol btabanas/ /byapachub lam bshad mdor bsdusabyas/ /zhes bya ba ste/ sde pa bco brgyad po thams cad kyi gtsug gi nor bu/ bsnyen par

100 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/rdzogs nas sdom rgyun rnam dag bar ma chad par lo sum cu lhag tsam pa zhes pas gnas brtan chen po mar me mdzad dpal gyi mdo dang / sogs khongs nas rgyud dang man ngag gi bstan bcos te dam pa'i chos rnams las bshad pa ji lta ba bzhin mthong bas bod yul gyi bstan pa'i khur bzhes pa'i lha rigs dge slong byang chub 'od kyis/ bstan pa spyi khyab kyi don du theg pa chen po'i shing rtar gyur pa'i gzhung zhig cis kyang gnang dgos zhes gsol ba btab pa la brten nas/ las dang po ba'i sa nas byang chub mchog gi bar du bgrod pa'i theg pa chen po'i lam rnam par bshad pa 'di yang /tshe 'di yun thung shes bya'i rnam pa mang / /tshe yi tshad kyang ci tsam mi shes pas/ /ngang pas chu las 'o ma len pa ltar/ /rang gi 'dod pa dang du blang na legs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dgag sgrub kyi spros pa rgya chen po dor nas/ thams cad mkhyen pa don gnyer gyi nyams len ma tshang ba med pa bsgrub pa'i cha rkyen du 'gyur pa tsam zhig tshig mdor bsdus nas byas so/ /bzhi pa mjug gi don la gnyis/ gang gis mdzad pa dang / sus bsgyur ba'o/ /dang po (gang gis mdzad pa )ni /byang chub lam gyi sgron ma slob dpon chen po dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyisamadzad ba rdzogasaso/ /

byang chub lam sgron gyi 'grel pa/ 101zhes bya ba ste/ byang chub lam gyi sgron ma zhes bya ba'i gzhung 'di ni lnga brgya ba rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bur gyur pa slob dpon mkhas pa chen po dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis/ skal ldan gyi gdul bya bgrang ba las 'das pa'i don du thugs brtse ba chen pos mdzad pa rdzogs so zhes pa'o/ /gnyis pa (sus bsgyur ba )ni/rgyagar gyi mkhan po dīpaṃ skar shrī dzñān dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong dge ba'i blo grogakyisabasgyur cing zhusategatan la phab pa'i chosa'adi nizhang zhung sgotho lingagatsug lag khang du mdzadado/ /zhes bya ba ste/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dīpaṃ kar shrī dzñā na dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba 'jig rten gyi mig dge slong dge ba'i blo gros kyis rgya skad las bod skad du bsgyur cing tshig don gyi zhu chen bgyis nas 'chad nyan mdzad pa'o/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal kun bde bar gshegs pa'i shul/ /byang sems rnams kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam/ /bstan pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i gzhung bzang 'di/ /thar 'dod skye bos snying gi bcud du longs/ /skye kun dge ba'i bshes kyis rjes su bzung / /rnam dag legs pa'i lam bzang 'dir zhugs nas/ /byang chub sems mchog skyes brtan gong du 'phel/ /bzang po spyod pa rgya mtsho yongs rdzogs shog /

102 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/dpal ldan mar me mdzad kyi thugs bskyed dang / /smon lam stobs kyis byang chub lam gyi rim/ /bdag sogs rgyud la dka' ba med par rdzogs/ /tshe 'dir don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub gyur cig /yongs su grags pa'i gzhung lugs chen po 'di la 'grel zin gyi zhabs tog 'di lta bgyis na legs zhes rje btsun bla ma kun mkhyen brtse ba chen pos bka' gnang ba ltar/ thub bstan ris su ma chad pa'i rjes su slob cing rgyal ba'i sras po'i rtags tsam 'dzin pa blo gros mtha' yas kyis dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa rnams kyi gsung gi bcud phyung ste bkod pa dge legs 'phel// //

lam gces rnam gan+da/ma/༄7/ /rje btsun bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab kun gyi snying po'i don/ /rgyal sras dam pa rnams kyis bsngags pa'i lam/ /skal ldan thar 'dod rnams kyi 'jug ngogs de/ /ji ltar nus bzhin bdag gis bshad par bya/ /gang dag srid pa'i bde la ma chags shing / /dal 'byor don yod bya phyir brtson pa yis/ /rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam la yid rton pa'i/ /skal ldan de dag dang ba'i yid kyis nyon/ /rnam dag nges 'byung med par srid mtsho yi/ /bde 'bras don gnyer zhi ba'i thabs med la/ /srid la brkam pa yis kyang lus can rnams/ /kun nas 'ching phyir thog mar nges 'byung btsal/ /dal 'byor rnyed dka' che la long med pa/ /yid la goms pas tshe 'di'i snang shas ldog /las 'bras mi bslu 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rnams/ /yang yang bsam na phyi ma'i snang shas ldog /de ltar goms pas 'khor ba'i phun tshogs la/ /yid smon skad cig tsam yang mi skye zhing / /nyin mtshan kun tu thar pa don gnyer blo/ /byung na de tshe nges 'byung skyes pa lags/ /nges 'byung de yang rnam dag sems bskyed kyis/ /zin pa med na bla med byang chub kyi/ /phun tshogs bde ba'i rgyu ru mi 'gyur bas/ /blo ldan rnams kyis byang chub sems mchog bskyed/ khri/gas drag chu bo bzhi yi rgyun gyis khyer/ /bzlog dka' las kyi 'ching ba dam pos bsdams/ /bdag 'dzin lcags kyi dra ba'i sbubs su tshud/ /ma rig mun pa 'i smag chen kun nas 'thibs/ /mu med srid par skye zhing skye ba n+da/ /sdug bsngal gsum gyis rgyun chad med par mnar/ /gnas skabs 'di 'drar gyur pa'i ma rnams kyi/ /ngang tshul bsams nas sems mchog bskyed par

104 rje blo bzang grags pa/mdzod/ /gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes rab mi ldan na/ /nges 'byung byang chub sems la goms byas kyang / /srid pa'i rtsa ba gcod par mi nus pas/ /de phyir rten 'brel rtogs pa'i thabs la 'bad/ /gang zhig 'khor 'das chos rnams thams cad kyi/ /rgyu 'bras nam yang bslu ba med mthong zhing / /dmigs pa'i gtad so gang yin kun zhig na/ /de ni sangs rgyas dgyes pa'i lam la zhugs/ /snang ba rten 'brel bslu ba med pa dang / /stong pa khas len bral ba'i go ba gnyis/ /ji srid so sor snang ba de srid du/ /da dung thub pa'i dgongs pa rtogs pa med/ /nam zhig res 'jog med par cig car du/ /rten 'brel mi bslur mthong ba tsam nyid nas/ /nges shes yul gyi 'dzin stangs kun 'jig na/ /de tshe lta ba'i dpyad pa rdzogs pa lags/ /gzhan yang snang bas yod mtha' sel ba dang / /stong pas med mtha' sel zhing stong pa nyid/ /rgyu dang 'bras bur 'char ba'i tshul shes na/ /mthar 'dzin lta bas 'phrog par mi 'gyur ro/ /de ltar lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum gyi/ /gnad rnams rang gis ji bzhin rtogs pa'i tshe/ /dben pa brten te brtson 'grus stobs bskyed nas/ /gtan gyi mdun ma myur du sgrubs shig bu/ /zhes pa 'di ni mang du thos pa'i dge slong blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyis tsha kho dbon po ngag dbang grags pa la gdams pa'o// //

lam gtso rnam gsum gyi tshig 'grel mdor bsdus pa skal bzang thar pa'i 'jug ngogs/༄༅/ /na moḥ shākya mu na ye/nges par 'byung bas srid pa'i 'dam las brgal/ /byang chub sems kyis zhi ba'i mthar mi gnas/ /chos nyid mngon sum gzigs pa'i rnam 'dren mchog /thugs rje che ldan shākya'i rgyal por 'dud/ /nges 'byung tshul khrims gser gyi sa gzhi la/ /byang sems ting 'dzin ri gling bkod pas mdzes /rnam dag lta ba'i shes rab snang byed gsal/ /jo bo yab sras brgyud par bcas la bsngags/ /mkhyen gnyis blo gros nam mkha'i khyon ltar yangs/ /mkhas btsun bzang po'i grags pas 'jig rten khyab/ /bstan la ston pa gnyis pa'i phrin las can/ /ngo mtshar skyes chen mchog der gus phyag 'tshal/ /gang des gzhan dring mi 'jog mkhyen spyod kyis/ /mdo rgyud dgongs pa tshul bzhin thugs chud nas/ /

106 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/brtse bas gzhan la 'doms pa'i legs bshad kyi/ /snying po lam gtso rnam gsum 'di rmad byung / /gang zhig rgyal ba'i gsung rab mtha' dag gi snying por gyur pa/ thar 'dod rnams kyi 'jug ngogs bla na ma mchis pa'i bstan bcos 'di 'chad pa la gnyis/ bstan bcos 'chad pa'i yan lag mtshon tsam smos pa dang / bstan bcos dngos bshad pa'o/ /dang po la lngas bstan te/dang po 'di nyid mdzad pa po su zhe na/ rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras po rnams kyis tshad mar gyur pa'i lung mang pos bstan cing / 'phags bal gangs can rnams su bstan pa gsal bar mdzad pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta 'ga' zhig dang / khyad par bod du mar do lo tsā ba chos kyi dbang phyug rngog lo blo ldan shes rab/ mtsho sna ba shes rab bzang po sogs su skye ba bzhes pa'i mthar dam pa 'di nyid du zhabrungs nas/ rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i stobs kyis mkhyen rab thogs pa med pas mdo rgyud dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa thugs su chub nas gang la'ang 'jigs pa med pa'i spobs pa thob/ khyad par 'phags pa klu sgrub yab sras kyi bzhed pa'i dbu ma'i lta ba mthar thug pa dang / dpal ldan mar me mdzad kyi bka' gdams rin po che'i bslab spyod zung du 'brel ba'i shing rta'i lam srol chen po btsugs te mkhas btsun bzang po'i mthar phyin pa'i slob ma brgya phrag mang pos rgyal ba'i bstan pa sa chen po'i khongs su khyab par spel/ khyad par 'phags pa'i mdzad chen bzhir grags pa sogs rlabs po che'i rnam thar dang phrin las mtha' yas/ rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor mthar phyin pas grub pa'i rnam thar thun

lam gtso rnam gsum gyi tshig 'grel/ 107mong ma yin pa mnga' bas dpal gsang ba'i bdag pos kyang che ba'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab par bsngags pa mdzad pa dang / sku tshe de'i phyi mar dga' ldan du rgyal ba byams pa'i spyan sngar byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal snying por 'khrungs pa sogs sprul pa du mar ston cing / bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas bcu gcig pa spyan legs su 'tshang rgya ba sogs lung bstan brnyes pa'i gang zag de nyid kyis so/ /gnyis pa su zhig gi don du mdzad ce na/ rigs can gsum gyi gdul bya thar pa don gnyer gyi skal pa bzang po dad pa ldan pa spyi dang / bye brag slob ma rnams kyi mchog tshe rabs mang por theg pa chen po la blo sbyangs pa'i las 'phro can tsha kho dbon po ngag dbang grags pas zhus pa'i ched du'o/ /gsum pa lung gang nas btus zhe na/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhal nas gsungs pa'i mdo sngags dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa'i zab don snying po bsdus pa yin mod kyi/ khyad par nges 'byung 'khor lo dang po dang / byang sems dang lta ba gnyis 'bor lo bar mtha' gnyis kyi gnad don snying po bsdus pa'o/ /bzhi pa phyogs gang du gtogs na/ mdo sngags gang gi sgor zhugs kyang lam 'di gsum gzhi dang snying po dang srog lta bu yin pas med du mi rung ba'i phyir na theg pa che chung gnyis ka'i phyogs su gtogs pa'o/ /lnga pa dbu zhabs bsdus pa'i don ni/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab kun gyi brjod bya ma tha 'a dag skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim par 'du ba rgyal tshab byams pa dang 'phags pa thogs med kyis gsungs/ de gsum yang skyes bu chung 'bring gnyis kyi lam nges 'byung du 'du/ chen po'i lam byang chub sems su 'du/ yang dag pa'i lta

108 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/ba ni theg pa che chung gnyis kar med du mi rung ba'i thun mong ba ste/ skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa mtha' dag gnad kyi snying po gsum gyis bsdus pa'o/ /gnyis pa tshad mar gyur pa'i bstan bcos dngos nyid bshad pa la gsum/klad kyi don/ gzhung gi don/ mjug gi don no/ /dang po la gsum/ mchod par brjod pa/ brtsam par dam bca' ba/ mnyan par bskul ba'o/ /dang po r+ṣachod par brjod pa )ni/rje btsun bla ma rnamasal phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas ston/ de la rje btsun ni/ bha ṭ+wā ra zhes pa'i sgra dang sgrol ces 'gyur bas rang nyid la dad pa'i gdul bya rnams 'khor ba spyi bye brag dang dman lam las sgrol ba'am/ yang na swā mi dang brnye zhes pa rje dang btsun pa la 'jug pa ltar 'gro ba lha dang bcas pa'i gtsug gi nor bur gyur pas na rje/ sgo gsum nyes spyod mtha' dag las sdom pas na btsun zhes brjod pa yin cing / bla ma'i skad dod gu ru lci ba sogs kyi don la 'jug pas rgyud yon tan gyis gang zhing rang la bka' drin lci ba dang / bod skad ltar na lha dang mi rnams kyi bla'am gong na bzhugs pa'i don yin cing / yul de lta bu ni rje rang nyid la thun mong ma yin par rjes su bzung ba'i bla ma rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs dang / thun mong ba dbu ma pa red mda' pa/ lho brag grub chen/ chos skyabs bzang po la sogs pa rnams la sgo gsum gus pa chen pos btud pa'i phyag mdzad pa'o/ /de'i dgos pa'ang rang nyid sngon gyi lo pan skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi spyod pa dang mthun zhing phyi rabs kyi gdul bya rnams la yang mig ltos bzang po gzhag pa dang / bstan bcos rtsom pa'i bar chad zhi

lam gtso rnam gsum gyi tshig 'grel/ 109nas rtsom pa mthar phyin par 'gyur ba sogs mdor na gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bzhed don thams cad bde blag tu 'grub pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa rtsom par dam bca' ba ni/rgyal ba'i gsuparab kun misnying po'i don/ /rgyas srasadam pa rnamasakyiba'ibasngags(pa'i lam /skal ldan thar 'dod rnamasami'ajugangogasade/ /ji ltar nusabazhin bdag gisabashad par bya/ /zhes gsungs te/ rgyal ba thub pa'i dbang po'i theg pa che chung gi gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa kun gyi brjod bya'i snying po'i gnad don mtha' dag ma tshang ba med par bsdus pa/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang shing rta chen po klu sgrub dang thogs med la sogs pa rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' lam dang lam ma yin pa 'byed pa la phra zhing mdzangs pa'i blo gros dang ldan pa'i dam pa rnams kyis lan du mar bsngags shing bstod pa'i lam srol/ skal ba dang ldan pa'i gang zag thar pa dang thams cad ma/byen pa thob par 'dod pa rnams kyi 'jug ngogs te 'jug pa'i sgo gcig pur gyur pa'i lam gyi gtso bo bsdus na rnam pa gsum ste/de'ang gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis sogs rgyud kun gyi dgos don 'gro ba rnams gnas skabs mngon mtho dang mthar thug nges legs thob pa'i thabs sha stag yin cing / de la thog mtha' bar gsum du dgos pa'i snying po'i don nges 'byung gi bsam pa dang / byang chub kyi sems dang / yang dag pa'i lta ba bcas rnam pa gsum po de ni/ ra nga gi blos ji ltar dpog par nus pa bzhin du snod ldan gyi

110 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/ slob ma ngag dbang grags pa khyod la/ blo bzang grags pa bdag gis lan dang rnam par smin pa la mi re bar brtse ba'i sems kyis bshad par bya'o zhes pa'o/ /gsum pa mnyan par bskul ba ni/gang dag srid pa'i bde la ma chagasashing/ /dal 'byor don yod bya phyir brtson pa yis/ /rgyal ba dgyesapa'i lam la yid rton pa'i/ /skal ldan de dag dbaba'i yid kyisanyon/ /ces gsungs te/ dus der gdams pa'i snod mchog tu gyur pa'i slob ma ngag dbang grags pas mtshon skal bzang gdul bya gang dag lha mi la sogs pa srid pa 'khor ba'i bde ba thams cad 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal du mthong nas/ de la ma chags shing ma zhen par dal ba brgyad dang 'byor ba bcu tshang ba'i chos sgrub pa'i lus rten khyad par can lan gcig tsam thob pa de don med stong log tu mi gtang bar don yod par bya ba'i phyir du brtson 'grus drag po brtsams pa yis/ phyi rol mu stegs pa dang / kla klo la sogs pa phyi nang gang du'ang ma gtogs pa dang / nang par rlom yang thabs shes phyogs re bas 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pa'i lam ltar snang dge ba'i blo ma btang bar/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad dgyes par bskyed pa'i lam nges 'byung / byang sems/ yang dag pa'i lta ba ste bstan pa'i gnad thams cad rdzogs pa'i gdams pa 'di nyid la yid shin tu rton par byed pa'i skal pa dang ldan pa'i gzur gnas blo ldan gyi gdul bya de dag snod kyi skyon gsum spangs shing 'du shes drug bsten la dang ba chen po'i yid kyis nyon cig

lam gtso rnam gsum gyi tshig 'grel/ 111ces pa'o/ /yang na srid bde la ma chags pas nges 'byung dang / dal 'byor don yod byed pa byang sems dang / rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam yang dag pa'i lta ba ste de gsum nyon cig par bskul bar bshad kyang rung ngo / /gnyis pa gzhung gi don la gsum/ nges 'byung bshad pa/ byang chub kyi sems bshad pa/ yang dag pa'i lta ba bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ nges 'byung 'tshol dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ nges 'byung bskyed pa'i thabs/ nges 'byung skyes pa'i tshad bshad pa'o/ /dang po (nis 'byung 'tshol dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan )ni/rnam dgangesa'agyuramed par lhad mtsho yi/ /bde 'brasadon gnyer ṣ+kaba'i thabasamed la/ /lhad la brkam pa yisakyangalusacan rnams/ /kun nasa'aching phyir thog mar ngesa'abyung btsal/ /ces gsungs te/ thar 'dod rnams kyis nyams su blang bya'i chos kyi rnam grangs ches mang yang snying nas sangs rgyas bsgrub pa la thog mar nges 'byung rnam par dag pa zhig rgyud la skye ba dgos te/ de'ang ngan song gsum las thar 'dod tsam ma yin par 'khor ba spyi las brgal 'dod rnam par dag pa'i nges 'byung gi bsam pa shugs drag po rang rgyud la skyes pa zhig med par gyur na/ srid pa 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po yi nang du yang dag pa'i bde ba med mod/ zag bcas kyi bde ba'i 'bras bu tsam la mi gtsang dri la dga' ba'i sbrang bu ltar chags shing don du gnyer ba'i phyin ci log gi blo ngan 'di gang gis kyang zhi ba ste ldog

112 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/pa'i thabs med la/ de ma ldog par srid pa'i bde ba spu gri'i sor chags pa'i sbrang rtsi lta bu la brkam pa ste sred pa'i zhags pa yis kyang rigs drug tu 'khyams pa'i lus can rnams 'khor bar kun nas dam du 'ching bar byed pa'i phyir na/ thar 'dod rnams kyis thog mar kho nar srid pa'i bde 'byor ji snyed pa kun kyang sdug bsngal gyi 'byung gnas su rig nas de las yid nges par 'byung bar 'dod pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa btsal dgos so zhes pa'o/ /sred pas 'khor bar 'ching ba'i tshul ni/ rnam 'grel las/mi shes srid pa'i rgyu yin yang / /ma brjod sred pa nyid bshad pas/ /rgyun ni 'phen par byed phyir dang / /de ma thag phyir las kyang min/ /de yod na yod med phyir ro/ /zhes dang / sred pa ni/ yod na slar yang 'byung phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/'di ni rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis/ dang po 'khor ba mtha' dag la yid 'byung ba'i skyo shas shig med na/ thos bsam sgom gsum sogs ci byas thams cad 'khor ba dang ngan song gi rgyu las mi 'da' bas bskyed rdzogs sogs zab pa'ang re zhig bzhag nas nges 'byung ma skyes bar du 'bad dgos/ nges 'byung la dran shes brten pa'i dmigs rnam goms par ma byas na/ dge ba thams cad snang shas kyis dbang byas nas 'khor ba 'ba' zhig gi rgyu byed pa yin no/ /des na sngags la rber+shags pa'i gdams ngag gang zab zer ba rnams bzhag nas/ thog mar

lam gtso rnam gsum gyi tshig 'grel/ 113nges 'byung dang / byang sems la myong ba thon pa re bya dgos zhes rje rin po ches tsha kho dbon po nyid la gdams pa'i dgos pa'o/ /des na 'bor ba mtha' dag la nges par 'byung ba'i blo rnam par dag pa zhig med na/ tshangs spyod tshul bzhin du bsrung ba dang / thos bsam sgom gsum la blo sbyong ba dang / gsang sngags gnyan po'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing dbang bskur sgrub mchod bskyed rdzogs bsgom pa sogs gang byas kyang thar pa'i sa bon grung por mi 'gyur te zag bcas kyi bde 'bras tsam la yid rton pa'i phyir/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ sdom pa gsum la gnas shing dag kyang khams gsum 'khor ba las blo yid ma phyung na slar 'khor ba'i rgyu byed/ nyin mtshan du sgo gsum dge ba la 'bad kyang rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ma shes na phyin ci log gi rtog pa 'ba' zhig gis 'phen/ mkhas btsun ston sgom du yod kyang 'jig rten chos brgyad la blo ma log na ci byas tshe 'di'i 'dun mar song nas phyi ma'i lam mi rnyed gsung / yang jo bo sku gshegs khar rnal 'byor pa chag khri mchog gis/ jo bo natagags pa na bdag gis sgom par zhu zhus pas/ bya ba ngan pa yin bor la thongs gsung / 'o na 'chad par zhu zhus pas kyang de skad gsung / 'o na res bshad res sgom mam zhus pas kyang de skad gsung / 'o na ci bgyi zhus pas/ tshe 'di blos thongs gsung / 'brom ston pa sogs brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad kyis kyang de kho na gsungs shing phyag len la btab pas don gnyis mthar phyin par byung ngo / /gnyis pa nges 'byung skyed pa'i thabs la gnyis/ tshe 'di'i snang shas ldog thabs dang / phyi ma'i snang shas ldog thabs so/ /

114 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/dang po (6 'di'i snang shas ldog thabs )ni/dal 'byor rnyed dka' tshe la long med pa/ /yid la gomasapasatshe 'di'i snang shasaldog /ces gsungs te/ 'gal rkyen phyi nang gi mi khom pa brgyad dang bral nas chos byas pa'i long yod pa'i dal ba brgyad dang / mthun rkyen rang dang gzhan gyi 'byor pa bcu dang ldan pa'i rten 'dis gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde ba phun sum tshogs pa ma lus pa bsgrub nus pas na don che tshul dang / rgyu dang grangs dang dpe rnams kyi sgo nas rnyed par dka' tshul dang / lan gcig tsam rnyed pa'i rten de yang tshe la snon pa med cing 'brid byed bar ma chad du yod pas 'jig rten 'dir yun ring bsdad long med par nges par myur du 'chi zhing / nam 'chi la yang nges pa med pa dang / 'chi ba'i tshe chos rnam dag byas pa ma gtogs rnyed bkur snyan grags sogs 'jig rten chos brgyad bsgrub pa'i phyir du dka' spyad drag pos 'bad kyang phan pa med pa ma zad / tshe 'dir ngal zhing dub la phyi mar sdug bsngal ba'i rgyu byed pa'i tshul rnams yid la yang yang bsam zhing goms pas tshe 'dir yun ring sdod pa'i grabs byas pa la dgos pa med pa shes nas/ sngar tshe 'di'i bde skyid 'dod pa'i 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi snang ba shas cher yod pa de go ldog nas phyi ma don gnyer gyi blo shugs drag skye'o zhes pa'o/ /de'ang gzhi dal 'byor rnyed dka' bsam pa la/ dal 'byor gyi ngo bo ni mi khom pa brgyad las log pa yin la/ mi khom pa brgyad ni/ bshes springs las/

lam gce sarnam gsum gyi tshig 'grel/ 115log par lta ba 'dzin dang dud 'gro dang / /yi dwags nyid dang dmyal bar skyes pa dang / /rgyal ba'i bka' med pa dang mtha' 'khob tu/ /kla klor skyes dang glen zhing lkugs pa nyid/ /tshe ring lha nyid gang yang rung bar ni/ /skye ba zhes bgyi mi khom skyon brgyad po/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ ngan song gsum dang lha tshe ring po ste mi ma yin pa'i mi khom pa bzhi dang / mi'i mi khom pa ni mi yin kyang rgyal ba'i bka' med sar skyes pa/'khor rnam bzhi mi rgyu ba'i mtha' 'khob tu skyes pa/ yul dbus su skyes kyang dbang po ma tshang ba/ dbang po tshang yang mu stegs sogs log lta can du skyes pa bzhi yin cing / 'byor pa bcu la/ rang 'byor lnga ni/ mi yin pa/ sa tshigs sam chos tshigs gang rung gi sgo nas yul dbus su skyes pa/ dbang po tshang ba/ sde snod gsum dang de'i brjod bya las 'bras la dad cing yid ches pa dang lnga/ gzhan 'byor lnga ni/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon pa/ des chos ston pa/ chos bstan pa de gnas pa/ chos bstan pa nyams su blangs pas lam gyi rtogs pa mngon du byas pa'i rjes su 'jug pa/ sbyin bdag la sogs pas chos gos sogs dad pas ster ba dang / chos 'chad pa pos snying brtse bas chos ston pa rnams te/ de lta bu'i dal ba brgyad dang 'byor pa bcu tshang ba'i rten khyad par can thob pa 'di don shin tu che ste/ 'di la brten nas mngon mtho lha mi'i go 'phang dang / nges legs thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyu sbyin pa tshul khrims bzod pa brtson 'grus sogs kyang

116 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/bsgrub nus shing / 'khor ba ngan song gi sdug bsngal shin tu bzod par dka' zhing yun ring por myong nges pa'i las stobs ldan rnams kyang / bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig bsten cing stobs bzhi'i sgor zhugs nas 'bad pas sbyang na phal cher che 'di nyid la sbyong nus pas don shin tu che/ dper na chu bo chen po brgal ba la gru yod tsa na brgal dgos gru med na brgal thabs med/ de bzhin du 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las brgal ba la yang dal 'byor gyi gru yod pa la brgal dgos/ de med na brgal thabs med/ spyod 'jug las/mi yi gru la brten nas ni/ /sdug bsngal chu bo che las 11la/ /gru 'di phyis nas rnyed dka' bas/ /rmongs pa dus su gnyid ma log /ces gsungs/ dal 'byor 'di rgyu'i sgo nas rnyed dka' ba'i tshul/ 'jug pa las/so so skye bo rnams dang gsung skyes dang / /rang byang chub la bdag nyid nges rnams dang / /rgyal sras rnams kyi nges par legs pa dang / /mngon mtho'i rgyu ni tshul khrims las gzhan med/ /ces pas/ spyir bde 'gro tsam thob pa la yang tshul khrims la sogs pa dge ba sna re dgos shing / khyad par dal 'byor tshang ba'i rten khyad par can thob pa la/ tshul khrims rnam par dag pas gzhi bzung / sbyin sogs kyis grogs byas/ smon lam

lam gtso rnam gsum gyi tshig 'grel/ 117dri ma med pas mtshams sbyar ba sogs dgos pa las/ rgyu de lta bu bsgrubs pa dkon pas 'bras bu dal 'byor tshang ba'i rten khyad par can thob pa dkon te/spyod 'jug las/bdag gi spyod pa 'di 'dras ni/ /mi yi lus kyang 'thob mi 'gyur/ /mi lus thob par ma gyur na/ /sdig pa 'ba' zhig dge ba med/ /gang che dge spyad skal ldan yang / /dge ba bdag gis ma byas na/ /ngan song sdug bsngal kun rmongs pa/ /de tshe bdag gis ci byar yod/ /dge ba dag kyang ma byas la/ /sdig pa dag kyang nyer bsags na/ /bskal pa bye ba brgyar yang ni/ /bde 'gro'i sgra yang thos mi 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar 'gro ba rnams phal cher mi dge ba la spyod pa'i rgyus 'bras bu ngan 'gro las ma 'das pas dal 'byor lta ci mngon mtho tsam yang rnyed par dka'o/ /de bzhin du ngo bo'i sgo nas rnyed par dka' ba ni/ dpe chos las/ 'o skol mi lus thob pa ni nyin mo'i skar ma tsam yin la/ dud 'gro ni nub mo'i skar ma tsam/yang dud 'gro ni nyin skar tsam/ yi dwags ni nub mo'i skar ma tsam/ yang yi dwags

118 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/ni nyin skar tsam/ dmyal ba ni nub mo'i skar ma tsam yin/ zhes byung ba ltar sa 'dom gang gru bzhi tsam gyi rgyar dbyar dus su sa tshi gu bgrang bar dka' na'ang mi bcu las mi rbesgong ba mngon sum gyis grub cing / lung bzhi las kyang / ngan 'gro dang bde 'gro nas shi 'phos te ngan 'gror 'gro ba ni sa chen po dang / de nas bde 'gror 'gro ba ni phyag sen gyi rtse mos bzhes pa'i rdul dang 'dra bar gsungs pas kyang shes nus so/ /dpe'i sgo nas rnyed dka' ba ni/ shel gyi khang pa'i logs la sran ma gtor na chags pa dang / khab rtser nyung dkar chags pa dkon pa las dud 'gro lta bu nas dal 'byor thob pa dkon pa yin no/ /dal 'byor thob kyang tshe la long med par nges par 'chi ste/ bzhes springs las/tshe ni gnod mang rlung gis btab pa yi/ /chu yi chu lhar bas kyang mi rtag na/ /dbugs dbyung dbugs rngub gnyid kyis log pa las/ /sad khom gang lags de ni ngo mtshar che /zhes 'tsho ba'i rkyen nyung zhing 'chi ba'i rkyen mang bas rlung gis btab pa'i chu'i lha ba bzhin 'jig par shin tu sla ba do nub gnyid log nas nangs par sad rgyu yod pa ngo mtshar ba'i gnas su gsungs pa dang / spyod 'jug las/nyin mtshan sdod pa yongs med par/ /tshe 'di rtag tu god 'gyur zhing / /

lam gtso rnam gsum gyi tshig 'grel/ 119snon pa gud nas 'ong med na/ /bdag lta 'chi bar cis mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar zhag gcig song gnyis song / zan kham gcig kham gnyis zos tsa na/ btung ba chub gcig hub gnyis btung gin 'chi ba la je nyer song nas myur du 'chi bas tshe la long med/ 'chi ba'i tshe chos ma gtogs gzhan gang gis kyang phan pa med pas chos gcig bya/ de yang myur du bya zhing 'chi la nges pa mi 'dug pas/ lus dang longs spyod gnyen grogs gang gi'ang dbang du mi gtong bar da lta rang nas chos gtsang sing nge ba bya ste/ tshoms las/sang dang 'jig rten phyi ma gnyis/ /sngon du gang snga gtol med pas/ /sang gi tshis la mi 'bad par/ /phyi ma'i don la 'bad par bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de la tshe blos thongs pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo 'chi ba mi rtag pa dran pa kho na yin te/ rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ 'chi ba dran pa ma sgom pa'i nyes dmigs ni/ da gzod mthar 'chi ba zhig 'ong snyam pa kun la yod kyang / nyi ma re re bzhin de ring mi 'chi/ de ring yang mi 'chi snyam du blos mi 'chi ba'i phyogs 'dzin pa 'chi kha tshun chad la 'byung ngo / /de'i gnyen po yid la ma byas na/ de lta bu'i blo des bsgribs nas tshe 'dir sdod pa'i blo skyes nas 'di dang 'di dgos so zhes tshe 'di tsam gyi bde ba bsgrub pa dang sdug bsngal sel thabs 'ba' zhig sems sems

120 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/nas/ tshe phyi ma dang tha ra pa thams cad mkhyen pa sogs don chen po la spyod pa'i blo mi skye bas chos la 'jug tu mi ster la/ brgya la thos bsam sgom pa sogs la zhugs kyang tshe 'di pa tsam gyi ched du song nas dge ba ci byas pa mthu chung zhing nyes spyod sdig lhung dang 'brel bar 'jug pas ngan 'gro'i rgyu dang ma 'dres pa dkon na/gal te 'jig rten phyi ma la dmigs nas sgrub tu chug kyang phyi nas bsgrub bo snyam pa'i phyi bshol gyi le lo 'gog mi nus shing / gnyid rmugs dang / pra mo'i gtam dang / bza' btung sogs kyi rnam g.yeng gis dus 'da' bas brtson pa chen pos tshul bzhin du sgrub pa mi 'ong / tshul bzhin du sgrub pa mi 'ong ba de tsam du ma zad tshe 'di'i phun tshogs lhur blangs pas nyon mongs pa dang des drangs pa'i nyes spyod rnams je rgyas su song nas/ chos kyi bdud rtsi las rgyab kyis phyogs te ngan song du 'khrid par byed pas de las ma rung ba ci zhig yod/ bzhi brgya pa las/gang la 'jig rten gsum mnga' bdag /rang nyid 'chi bdag byed po med/ /yod des rnal zhing gnyid log na/ /de las ma rung gzhan ci yod/ /ces bya ba dang / spyod 'jug las/thams cad bor te 'chi dgos par/ /bdag gis de ltar ma shes nas/ /mdza' dang mi mdzare don gyi phyir/ /sdig pa rnam pa sna 31gas byas/ /

lam gtso rnam gsum gyi tshig 'grel/ 121zhes rber+sha/ /'chi ba dran pa sgom pa'i phan yon ni/ 'chi ba dran pa sgom pa'i blo rnal ma zhig skyes na/ dper na de ring sang gnangs 'chi bar thag chod pa na chos kyi go ba mthar thug yod pa yan chad la gnyen la sogs pa dang 'grogs su med pa mthong nas de la sred pa ldog cing gtong ba la sogs pa'i sgo nas snying po len 'dod phal cher la ngang gis 'byung ba ltar/ rnyed bkur sogs 'jig rten gyi chos kyi 'bad pa thams cad snying po med par mthong nas nyes spyod las ldog cing / skyabs 'gro dang tshul khrims la sogs pa'i las bzang po gsog pas go 'phang dam par rang nyid 'dzegs te 'gro ba rnams kyang der khrid pas de las don che ba ci zhig yod/ de'i phyir dpe du mas kyang bsngags te mya ngan 'das chen las/ zhing rmo pa rnams kyi nang nas ston gyi lo mchog go rjes thams cad kyi nang na ba glang gi rjes mchog go 'du shes thams cad kyi nang na mi rtag pa dang 'chi ba'i 'du shes mchog yin te/ 'di dag gis ni khams gsum gyi 'dod pa dang ma rig pa dang nga rgyal thams cad sel lo zhes dang / de bzhin du nyon mongs pa thams cad cig car 'joms pa'i tho ba/ dge legs thams cad cig car bsgrub pa'i sgor gyur pa la sogs pas bsngags pa'o/ /mdor na skyes bu'i don bsgrub pa'i dus ni rten khyad par can thob pa'i dus 'di kho na yin la/ 'o skol phal cher ngan 'gror bsdad cing bde 'gror lan re tsam 'ongs kyang mi khom pa'i gnas su shas che bas de ra chos bsgrub pa'i skabs ma rnyed la/ sgrub chog pa'i rten re rnyed pa na'ang chos tshul bzhin du mi sgrub pa ni da dung mi 'chi snyam pa 'di la thug 'dug pas na blos mi 'chi ba'i phyogs 'dzin pa ni

122 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/ rgud pa kun gyi sgo dang / 'chi ba dran pa ni phun tshogs thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /de'i phyir 'di las chos zab mo gzhan bsgom rgyu med pa rnams kyis nyams su len no snyam pa dang / bsgom bya yin kyang dang por cung zad sgom gyi rgyun du nyams len du mi 'os so snyam du mi bzung bar thog mtha' bar gsum du dgos 'dug la nges par snying thag pa nas bskyed de bsgom par bya'o gsungs/gnyis pa phyi ma'i snang shas ldog thabs ni/'kha('brasami bsru 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rnams/ /sprung yang bsam na phyi ma'i snabashasaldog /ces gsungs te/ dper na nas 'bras gro sran sogs sa bon tha dad pa btab pa'i myu gu'ang so sor ma 'chol bar skye ba ltar/ las dkar nag gi 'bras bu'ang bde sdug so sor ma 'chol bar rkyen dang 'phrad tshe 'byin pas na mi bslu ba sogs/mdor na las nges pa 'phel che ba ma byas pa dang mi 'phrad pa byas pa chud mi za ba'i tshul dang / sdug bsngal brgya dang drug dang gsum la sogs pa 'khor ba spyi dang bye brag gi sdug bsngal rnams blo kha nang du phyogs nas yang nas yang du zhib par bsam pa na sngar phyi ma phan chad du lha mi'i dpal 'byor don du gnyer ba'i snang ba shas cher yod pa de go sa ldog nas thar pa don gnyer gyi blo shugs drag skye'o zhes pa'o/ /'di la las 'bras bsam pa dang / 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam pa gnyis las/ dang po la las kyi lam bcur gsungs te/ srog gcod/ ma byin len/ log g.yem ste lus kyi las gsum/ rdzun/ phra ma/ tshig rtsub/ ngag 'khyal te ngag gi

lam gtso rnam gsum gyi tshig 'grel/ 123las bzhi/ brnab sems/ gnod sems/ log lta ste yid kyi las gsum rnams bsdoms pas bcu po nag po'i las bcu ste/ de las ldog pa dkar po'i las lam bcur dge mi dge'i las thams cad bsdus pa yin la/de'ang las nges pa ni/ sa bon dkar nag so so las 'bras bu dkar nag mi 'chol bar 'byung ba bzhin/ las mi dge ba spyad na 'bras bu sdug bsngal kho na 'byung bar nges la/ las dge ba spyad na 'bras bu bde ba 'byung bar nges te/'phags pa des pas zhus pa'i mdo las/sa bon tsha ba rnams kyis ni / / 'bras bu tsha ba skye bar 'gyur/ /sa bon mngar ba rnams kyis ni/ /'bras bu mngar ba skye bar 'gyur/ /dpe zlar bya ba 'di yis ni/ /sdig pa'i rnam smin tsha ba dang / /dkar po'i 'bras bu mngar ba yang / /mkhas pa rnams kyis shes par bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /las 'phel che ba ni/ sdig pa'i las che chung gang yin kyang bshags pa sogs gnyen pos ma bcos na zhag re bzhin skyed de 'phel ba dang rjes su yi rang na lhag par 'phel che zhing / dge ba'i las rnams kyang ngom pa dang 'gyod pas ma zad na de bzhin du 'phel zhing / bsngo bas rgyas thebs na de las kyang 'phel che bas rgyu

124 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/las kyi dus chung ngu las med kyang 'bras bu rgya cher smin par 'gyur te/ tshoms 95rngaṭa/sdig pa chung ngu byas pas kyang / /'jig rten pha rol 'jigs chen 'gyur/ /phung khrol chen po byed 'gyur te/ /khong par song ba'i dug bzhin no / /bsod nams chung ngu byas pas kyang / /'jig rten pha rol bde chen 'dren/ /don chen dag kyang byed 'gyur te/ /'o/gra rnams phun chosags smin pa bzhin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /las ma byas pa dang mi 'phrad pa ni/ rang gis byas pa'i las dge sdig che chung gang yin kyang 'bras bu bde sdug mi 'chol bar 'gyur gyi ma byas pa dang 'phrad mi srid de/ mdo las/ lhas byin nyid kyis byas pa'i las rnam par smin pa ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la sogs pa la mi smin gyi de nyid kyis zin pa'i phung po sogs la smin par 'gyur bar gsungs pas mtshon no/ /las chud mi za ba ni/ mdo las/lus can dag gi las rnams ni/ /bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za/ /

lam gtso rnam gsum gyi tshig 'grel/ 125tshogs shing dus la babs pa na/ /'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur/ /zhes sems can rnams kyis bsags pa'i dkar nag gi las ni nam yang med par mi 'gyur bar bskal pa sogs dus yun ring dag gis chod na'ang zhing sa skam po la sa bon yod pa gsher dang 'phrad pa bzhin las gang yin pa de la gsos btab pa de'i tshe bde sdug gi 'bras bu smin par 'gyur ba ste/ mdo 'dul las byung ba'i gtam rgyud rnams las rtogs par byas na nges shes 'drongs par 'gyur/ des na dang por nag po'i las 'bras bsam/ de nas dkar po'i las 'bras bsams nas spro ba'i sems kyis dge ba chung ngu la'ang ma brnyas par bsgrub par bya'o/ /gnyis pa 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsam pa ni/ rgyal tshab byams pas/mi gtsang ba la dri zhim med ltar 'gro lnga dag na bde ba med/ /de yi sdu/ga bsngal rtag tu kha ba rgya tshwa la sogs reg skyes bzhin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar 'khor ba'i gnas ris mtho dman gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gsum gyi rang bzhin las nam yang ma 'das te/ shin tu bzod par dka' ba ngan song gsum ni/ dmyal ba tsha grang / yi dwags bkres skom/ dud 'gro glen lkugs bkol spyod kyis nyam thag pa 'bras tsha ba'i steng du phol mig byung ba ltar sdug bsngal gyis sdug bsngal ba ni/ bshes springs las/dmyal ba bris pa mthong dang thos pa dang / /

126 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/dran dang bklags dang gzugs su bgyis rnams kyang / /'jigs par bskyed par 'gyur na mi bzad pa'i/ /rnam smin nyams su myong rnams smos ci 'tshal /ces sogs gsungs pa ltar bzod pa'i glags med la/ bde 'gror skyes nas sprin bar gyi nyi ma lta bur gnas skabs lus sems kyi bde ba cung zad myong rung rtag mi thub pa 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal can yin pa dang / zhi ba lhas/bde 'gror yang dang yang 'ongs te/ /bde ba mang po spyad spyad nas/ /shi nas ngan song sdug bsngal ni/ /yun ring mi bzad rnams su lhung / /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bde 'gror skyes kyang mi la skye rga na 'chi sogs sdug bsngal brgyad dang / lha min la 'thab rtsod/ lha la 'chi 'pho lhung byed sogs sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyis gzir bar ma zad btson rar chud pa'i mi zhig de nas thon kyang slar btson khang gzhan du mi 'jug pa'i nges pa med pa bzhin bde 'gro nas ngan 'gror mi 'gro ba'i gdeng tshad ma rnyed pa'i phyir na/ 'khor ba las mthar phyin sdug bsngal gyi zug rngu dang nam yang mi 'bral la/ de'i rtsa ba yang 'dod yon lnga la chags pa kho na'i skyon las byung ba ni/ dper na/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis/ri dwags nyid ni sgra tsam gyis/ /reg pas glang po brlag par 'gyur/ /

lam gtso rnam gsum gyi tshig 'grel/ 127gzugs nyid kyis ni phye leb ste/ /ro yis nya nyid rnam par brlag /bung ba dri la chags pas te/ /'di dag rgyu ni re re yin/ /skyes bu dag ni gcig la yang / /lnga po 'di dag rtag ldan zhing / /nyin mtshan du ni rab tu 'joms/ /bde gnas ji ltar thob par 'gyu ra/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ po to ba'i zhal nas/ 'o skol 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga'i rjes su snyeg snyeg nas/ 'khor ba 'di thog ma med pa nas gting mtha' med par 'khyams te phung tshabs dang brlag tshabs 'di las che ba med gsungs so/ /des na rtag tu 'dod yon la blo ldog cing 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal spyi dang / khyad par 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal bsam pa gal che ste/ ji skad du/'khor ba'i nyes brgya sems dpa'i tshul/ /mang yang sdug bsngal sdug bsngal gyis/ /'jigs nas thar 'dod phyugs la'ang yod/ /zag bcas tshor ba bde ba las/ /yid 'byung phyi rol pa la'ang mchis/ /des na 'du byed rang bzhin gyi/ /zag bcas nyer len phung po 'di/ /

128 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/sdug bsngal 'grub dang grub pa'i snod/ /nad dang 'bras dang zug rngu ltar/ /dmigs nas bsgom na byings g.yo lags/ /zhes bshad pa ltar ro/ /gsum pa nges 'byung skyes pa'i tshad bshad pa ni/de ltar gomasapasa'akhor ba'i phun tshogasal/ /yid smon skad cig tsam yang mi skye zhing / /nyin mtshan kun tu thar pa don gnyer blo/ /byung na de tshe ngesa'abyung skyesapa lags/ /zhes gsungs te/ de ltar 'khor ba spyi bye brag gi sdug bsngal rang rgyud la bskor nas yang yang goms par byas pa la brten nas lha mi'i gtso bo rnams kyi bde bas mtshon srid pa 'bor ba'i phun sum tshogs pa gang la'ang skyugs nad can gyis zan mthong ba ltar 'di lta bu thob na snyam pa'i yid la smon pa skad cig tsam yang rgyud la mi skye zhing / nyin mtshan gyi dus kun tu zag bcas nyer len gyi phung pos bsdus pa'i yid rton med pa'i 'khor ba las grol ba'i thar pa myang 'das kyi bde ba zhig da lta nyid du thob na snyam du don du gnyer ba'i blo gzhan rkyen gyis ldog mi nus pa'i shugs drag la rgyun ring ba rtsol med du skye ba byung ba na/ dus de'i che thar pa cha mthun gyi dge ba bcos ma ma yin pa'i nges 'byung gi bsam pa rnam par dag pa rang rgyud la skyes pa lags so zhes pa'o/ /rgya ma ba blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis kyang de

lam gtso rnam gsum gyi tshig 'grel/ 129ltar bsam pas tshe 'di'i 'dod pa thams cad la zhen pa log de 'phel bas 'khor ba mtha' dag la zhen pa log pa zhig byung na/ de tsa na thar pa'i lam sna zin pa zhes kyang bya ste/ de med na ci yod kyang thar pa'i lam sna mi zin/ de byung na gzod chos pa'i khyur tshud pa lags so zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa byang chub kyi sems bshad pa la gnyis/ byang chub kyi sems bskyed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dang / byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa'i thabs so dang po (byang chub kyi sems bskyed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan )ni/ngesa'abyung de mang rnam dag semasabaskyed kyis/ /zin pa med na bla med byabachub kyi/ /phun tshogasabade ba'i rgyu ru mi 'gyur bas/ /blo ldan rnamasakyisabyang chub semasamachog bskyed/ /ces gsungs te/ gong du bshad pa'i skyes bu chung 'bring dang thun mong ba'i lam srid pa'i phun tshogs las yid nges par 'byung ba tsam gyi bsam pa de yang /mkha' mnyam gyi sems can rnams kyi ched du rnam par dag pa'i sems bskyed kyi rtsis zin pa med na bden pa bzhi dang / rten 'brel bcu gnyis dang / phar phyin drug la sogs pa yun ring por nyams su blangs pa rnams kyang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyis rang gzhan gnyis ka'i don phun sum tshogs pa 'grub pa'i gtan gyi bde ba mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i rgyu ru mi 'gyur te/ rang don yid byed dman pa'i lam du gol ba'i skyon yod pa'i phyir/ de bas na rang don gtso bor don du mi gnyer bar gzhan don rgya chen po bsgrub par

130 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/ bya'o snyam pa'i theg chen gyi rigs sad pa'i blo gros kyi rtsal dang ldan pa'i dbang rnon skyes bu mchog gi rigs can rnams kyis/ rgyu 'bras man ngag bdun dang bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i sgo nas theg chen gyi lam gyi gzhung shing lta bu smon pa dang 'jug pa'i bdag nyid can gyi byang chub kyi sems mchog tu bskyed par bya'o zhes pa'o/ /de'ang bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas 'thob byed kyi rgyu ni byang chub kyi sems rin po che las gzhan ci'ang yod pa ma yin te/ dper na/ nas kyi sa bon ni nas kyi myu gu'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyu yin pas/ de yod na nas myug gi thun mong ba'i rgyu chu lud drod gsher rnams kyang nas myug gi rgyur 'gyur gyi/ nas kyi sa bon med na chu lud sogs yod kyang nas myug skyed par mi nus pa bzhin yin te/rin chen phreng ba las/bdag nyid dang ni 'jig rten 'dis/ /bla med byang chub thob 'dod na/ /de yi rtsa ba byang chub sems/ /ri dbang rgyal po ltar brtan dang / /phyogs mthas gtugs pa'i snying rje dang / /gnyis la mi brten ye shes lags/ /zhes pa dang / rgyud bla ma las/theg mchog la mos sa bon shes rab ni/ /sangs rgyas chos skyed ma dang bsam gtan gyi/ /

lam gtso rnam gsum gyi tshig 'grel/ 131bde ba'i mngal gnas snying rje'i ma ma can/ /gang yin de dag thub pa'i rjes skyes sras/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de yang pha ni bu yi rang gi rigs nges pa'i rgyu yin pas/pha bod la bu bod pa kho na skye yi/ rgya hor gyi rigs can mi skye/ ma ni bu de yi thun mong gi rgyu yin pas/ bod pa dang 'grogs na bod/ rgya hor dang 'grogs na rgya hor gyi rigs can skye ba ltar/ byang chub kyi sems ni/ rang rgyud la ldan pa'i gang zag theg pa chen po bar 'jog pa'i sa bon lta bu dang / yang dag pa'i lta ba ni/ nyan thos kyi byang chub don gnyer gyi bsam pa dang 'grogs na rang rgyud ldan gyi gang zag nyan thos kyi byang chub tu 'khrid par byed/ rang rgyal gyi byang chub don gnyer gyi bsam pa dang 'grogs na rang rgyud ldan gyi gang zag rang rgyal gyi byang chub tu 'khrid par byed/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub don gnyer gyi bsam pa dang 'grogs na rang rgyud ldan gyi gang zag sangs rgyas kyi sar 'khrid par byed pa ste byang chub gsum thun mong gi rgyu yin pas/ sher phyin la bstod pa na yum chen mo shes pa dang / byang chub kyi sems la bstod pa na/ sdong po bkod pa las/ rigs kyi bu byang chub kyi sems ni sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyi sa bon lta bu'o zhes gsungs/ des na rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas yang nas yang du bsngags shing / 'phags pa yab sras dang jo bo a ti sha la sogs pa rnams kyis 'di kho nar gdams pa'i snying por mdzad pa'i lo rgyus dang gsung sgros mtha' yas pa las phyogs tsam mtshon na/ dge bshes smyug rum pa'i zhal nas/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gcig skyer btub na tshogs kho rang gis gsog sgrib pa yang kho rang gis sbyong / bar chad kyang kho rang

132 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/gis sel te gsungs/ 'di gcig med par/ rtsa dang rlung dang thig le dang / lha'i sku dang stong pa nyid la sogs pa bsgoms kyang 'dod par gom pa gang bas phyed kyang mi phyin gsungs/ des na myur du 'tshang rgya ba la byang chub kyi sems sgom pa las gdams ngag lhag pa med pas/ de la nges pa bskyed pa'i phyir nyams len thams cad de'i phyir du dril nas byed pa gal che ste/ lam rim chen mo las/'jig rten na rtswa rnga ba dang zor ba rdor ba'i dpe brjod pa ltar rin po che'i sems 'di gnad du ma song bar yun ci tsam dge sbyor la 'bad blo byas kyang zor ba shin tu rtul bas rtswa rnga ba dang 'dra ste sa bcad pa ci yang med la/ sems 'di nyid gnad du gcig song na re zhig la mi rnga bar zor ba brdar nas rnon por byas te de nas brngas pa na cung zad tsam la'ang mang du brngas zin pa dang 'dra ste/ skad cig re re la'ang sgrib pa sbyong ba dang tshogs sdud pa bde blag tu nus shing dge ba chung ba dang bar skabs su 'dzad pa rnams kyang che ba dang mi zad par byed pa'i phyir zhes pa dang / dge bshes ston pa la dge bshes lhab chung ston pas/ yang dang yang du byang chub kyi sems sbyongs bya ba de bla ma'i gdams ngag bsgoms pas rgyud la ma skyes kyang yang dang yang du bsgom pas skye bya ba lags sam zhus pas/ dge nga5)sa ston pa'i zhal nas jo bo ston pa/ de gcig pus kyang mi 'ong / gtso bor byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems la sbyong ba'i tshul bzhin yid la byed pa de gzhi mar byas/ zhar la tshogs bsag zhar la sgrib pa sbyang / zhar la sdig pa'i grogs po spang zhing / zhar la dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten/ zhar la chos thams cad stong pa nyid du bsgom zhing tshul bzhin yid la byed na 'ong ba yin ces gsungs/ spyir byang chub kyi sems skyes pa tsam la phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab cing mdor bsdu na/
