lam gtso rnam gsum gyi tshig 'grel/ 133spyod 'jug las/ ming don gnas 'gyur ba/ sdig pa'i gnyen po byed pa/ dge ba gong du 'phel ba/ ngan song gi skye sgo gcod pa/ sangs rgyas nges par thob pa dang lngar gsungs so/ /gnyis pa byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa'i thabs ni/shugagadrag chu bo bzhi yisargyun gyisakhyer/ /bzlog dka' lasakyi 'ching ba dam posabasdams/ /bdaga'adzin lcagasakyi dra ba'i sbubasasuchud/ /ma rig mun pa'i smag chen kun nasa'athibs/ /mu med lhad par skye zhing skye ba mā /sdug bsngal gsum gyigargyun chad med par mnar/ /gnasaskabasa'adi'adrar gyur pa'i marnamasakyi/ /ngang tshul bsam nasasemasamachogabaskyed par mdzod/ /ces gsungs te/ ri gzar ngos kyi 'bab chu ltar shugs shin tu drag pa'i skye rga na 'chi'am/ 'dod pa srid pa ma rig pa lta ba ste chu bo chen po bzhi yi rgyun gyi cha bsags pas ngal gso med par sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtshor ni khyer/ sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang rdzu 'phrul gyis kyang bzlog cing grol bar dka' ba'i zag bcas kyi bsod nams dang / bsod nams ma yin pa dang / mi g.yo ba'i gnas su ni bsdams/ gang zag dang chos kyi bdag tu 'jin pa bcas par dka' ba lcags kyi dra ba lta bu'i sbubs su ni chud/ nyes pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba las 'bras dang de kho na nyid sogs bya ba dang bya min gyi gnas tshul mi shes pa'i ma rig pa'i mun pa

134 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/stug po'i smag rum chen po phyogs kun nas chu'i khur gyis non pa'i dbyar gyi char sprin lta bur ni 'thibs/ thog ma dang mtha' ma'i mu mtha' 'di zhes ngos bzung du med pa'i srid pa 'bor ba'i gnas ngan 'di lan gcig gnyis tsam ma yin par skye zhing skye ba ru sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal/ khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal te/ sdug bsngal gsum gyis skad cig kyang rgyun chad pa med par ni mnar ba sogs gnas skabs te ngang tshul chos bzod par dka' ba 'di 'dra bar gyur pa'i 'gro ba 'di thams cad rang gi tshe rabs snga ma'i mar ma gyur pa gcig kyang med cing / de yang lan mang por byas shing byas res kyis gnod pa las bskyabs nas bde ba dpag med sbyin pa'i drin can sha stag yin pas/ ma rgan sems can rnams kyi sdug bsngal ba'i ngang tshul rang nyams la dpags te legs par bsams pa la brten nas/ drin lan du bde ba dang ldan na snyam pa'i byams pa dang / sdug bsngal dang bral na snyam pa'i snying rjes drangs te/ de rnams sdug bsngal las grol ba bdag gis bya'o snyam pa'i lhag bsam gyi khur khyer ba na/da lta ni bdag la de lta bu'i nus pa med/ nus pa su la yod na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyag gcig la yod par shes nas sems can gyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ci nas kyang thob par bya'o snyam du smon pa'i sems dang / de ltar smon pa tsam gyis kyang sangs rgyas mi thob pas/ sangs rgyas thob pa'i phyir de'i rgyu phar phyin drug dang bsdu ba bzhi sogs rgyal sras kyi spyod pa la bslab par bya'o snyam pa'i 'jug pa byang chub kyi sems mchog tu bskyed par mdzod cig ces pa'o /de la thog mar dge ba'i bshes gnyen las sam rten dang dmigs pa'i sgo nas shing rta gnyis kyi ring lugs ltar byang chub tu sems ma skyes pa bskyed/ skyes

lam gtso rnam gsum gyi tshig 'grel/ 135pa mi nyams shing gong du 'phel ba'i bslab bya sems can blos mi sbong ba sogs smon sems dang / spyin sogs phar phyin drug snyan smra sogs bsdu dngos bzhis mtshon pa'i spyod pa rnams ci nus su bsgrub par bya ba yin la/ thams cad kyi rtsa ba byang chub kyi sems sbyong ba la 'bad dgos te/ de'i man ngag jo bo rje nas brgyud pa la lugs gnyis/sha ra ba'i slob ma gtum ston blo gros grags nas brgyud pa la rgyu 'bras rim pa lnga'i sgo nas sgom ste/ bdag sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur byang chub kyi sems dgos par 'dug de'i rgyur snying rje/ de'i rgyur byams pa/ de'i rgyur byas pa shes shing drin gzo ba/ de'i rgyur sems can thams cad pha ma drin can sha stag tu shes dgos/ 'di rnams sdug bsngal dang bral/ bde ba la dgod pa'i phyir bdag nyid sangs rgyas 'thob par byas nas sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi sa la dgod par bya'o snyam du bsam pa dang /bya yul ba'i slob ma gtsang pa rin po che nas brgyud pa la rgyu 'bras man ngag bdun gyis blo sbyong bar gsungs te/ 'thob bya'i sangs rgyas nyid rgyu byang chub kyi sems las skye/ de lhag bsam rnam par dag pa las/ de snying rje chen po/ de byams pa chen po/ de yid du 'ong ba las/ de byas shes drin gzo/ de rtsa ba'i mas phan btags pa ltar sems can thams cad pha mar shes pa las skyes/ des na sems can re re bzhin byams pa dang / snying rje dang / sangs rgyas la 'god 'dod kyi lhag pa'i bsam pa kho na bsgom dgos shing / de'i man ngag khyad par du 'phags pa/ spyod 'jug las/

136 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/gang zhig bdag dang gzhan rnams ni/ /myur du skyob par 'dod pa des/ /bdag dang gzhan du brje bya ba/ /gsang ba'i dam pa spyad par bya/ /zhes dang /bdag bde gzhan gyi sdug bsngal dag /yang dag brje bar ma byas na/ /sangs rgyas nyid du mi 'grub cing / /'khor ba na yang bde ba med/ /ces bdag gzhan mnyam par brje ba'i bde sdug gi gtong len spel mar byed pa ni nyams len gyi gnad 'gag che shos yin pas de'i tshul blo sbyong don bdun ma sogs las shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa yang dag pa'i lta ba bshad pa la gnyis/ yang dag pa'i lta ba 'tshol dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ btsal ba'i lta ba dngos bstan pa'o/ /dang po (yang dag pa'i lta ba 'tshol dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan )ni/gnasalugasartogasapa'i shesarab mi ldan na/ /ngesa'abyung byathachub semasal gomasabyasakyang/ /srid pa'i rtsab gcod par mi nusapas/ /de phyir rten 'brel rtogasapa'ithabasal 'bad/ /

lam gtso rnam gsum gyi tshig 'grel/ 137ces gsungs te/ chos rnams kyi gnas lugs kyi don phyin ci ma log par rtogs par byed pa'i zab mo'i shes rab dang mi ldan na/ sngar bshad pa'i nges 'byung dang /byang chub kyi sems gnyis la yun ring po ci tsam goms par byas pa dang / bsam gtan gzugs med kyi ting nge 'dzin la bskal pa'i bar du gnas nus shing /mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul mtha' yas pa dang ldan par gyur kyang / srid pa 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi rtsa ba mthar thug pa bdag 'dzin lhan skyes kyi zhen yul sun dbyung zhing bcad par ste slar skye mi rung gi chos can du byas te spong bar mi nus pa kho na yin pas/ thar 'dod rnams kyis stong pa nyid kyi don zab mo rten cing 'brel bar 'byung bas 'grub pa'i tshul rtogs pa'i thabs la dka' ba ba rgya phrag du ma'i sgo nas 'bad par bya'o zhes pa'o/ /de'ang nges 'byung dang byang sems sogs kyis srid pa'i rtsa ba gcod mi nus pa'i rgyu mtshan 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi rtsa ba mthar thug pa lhan skyes kyi bdag 'dzin yin la/ de spong ba ni de'i 'dzin stangs kyi zhen yul sun phyung nas de dang 'dzin stangs dngos su 'gal ba zhig gis spang dgos te/ bzhi brgya pa las/yul la bdag med mthong ba ni/ /srid pa'i sa bon 'gag par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ nges 'byung sogs bdag 'dzin dang 'dzin stangs 'gal ba ma yin pas/ rnam 'grel las/ 'di yul sun phyung med par ni/ /de spong ba ni nus ma yin/ /zhes dang / byams sogs rmongs dang 'gal med phyir/ /shin tu nyes pa tshar gcod min/ /zhes gsungs so/ /des na bdag 'dzin sbong byed kyi gnyen po

138 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes pa yin la/ de'ang gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis gang zag gi bdag dang / chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis phung sogs chos la bdag tu 'dzin pa spong bar byed pas na/ gcig du bral la sogs pa'i rigs pa yang dag la brten nas gang zag gi bdag bkag nas bdag med rtogs pa'ang shes rab goms dgos te/ dbu ma la 'i〈cog pa las/nyon mongs skyon rnams ma lus 'jig tshogs la/ /lta las byung ba blo yis mthong gyur cing / /bdag ni 'di yi yul du rtogs byas nas/ /rnal 'byor pa yis bdag ni 'gog par byed/ /ces dang / rnam 'grel las/stong nyid lta bas grol 'gyur gyi/ /sgom pa lhag ma de don yin/ /zhes gan+da/ngas pas rber+sha/ /de'ang gong du smos pa ltar sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i rgyu thun mong ma yin pa byang chub kyi sems yin kyang bu skye ba la pha gcig pus mi 'ong bar pha ma gnyis ka tshogs dgos pa bzhin theg pa gsum ga'i thun mong gi rgyu stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab dang zung du 'brel dgos te/ dpe 'grel las/ dper na skyes bu mig dang ldan pa zhig gis lam sna drangs na dmus long brgya phrag du ma'ang grong khyer la

lam gtso rnam gsum gyi tshig 'grel/ 139sogs pa gang 'dod du 'gro nus pa yin/ dpe de bzhin du shes rab stong pa nyid kyi don rtogs nas nyams su blangs na pha rol tu phyin pa lnga yis kyang pha rol tu phyin pa'i ming thob cing thams cad mkhyen pa'i sa la 'gro bar nus te/pha rol phyin pa lnga yi yon tan ji snyed pa/ /de dag kun kyang shes rab pha rol phyin la brten/ /zhes pa dang /sbyin pa sbyin pa'i sngon du 'gro ba shes rab ste/ /tshul khrims bzod pa brtson 'grus bsam gtan de bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don/ chos rab rnam 'byed kyi shes rab kyis bden par 'dzin pa'i zhen yul sun ma phyung na pha rol tu phyin pa gzhan la rgya cher bslabs kyang bdag med rtogs mi nus/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab gnyis kyi nang nas kyang gang zag gi bdag med gtso bor gsungs te/ lhag mthong chen mo las/ de kho na nyid la ji ltar 'jug pa'i rim pa ni dang por 'bor ba'i nyes skyon bsams nas yid sun te de la 'dod pa mi skyes pa zhig dgos/ de nas de rgyu ma log na mi ldog par mthong nas 'bor ba'i rtsa ba gang yin snyam ste de'i rtsa ba rtsad bcad pas 'jig lta'am ma rig pa 'khor ba'i rtsa bar 'akro lugs la nges pa gting thag pa nas 'drongs nas/ de spong bar 'dod pa bcos ma ma yin pa skyes pa zhig dgos/de nas 'jig lta ldog pa de nges bzung ba'i bdag med par rtogs pa'i shes rab skye ba la rag las par mthong nas bdag de dgag dgos par mthong ste/ bdag

140 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/de yod pa la gnod byed dang med pa'i sgrub byed kyi lung dang rigs pa la brten nas nges pa rnyed pa zhig thar pa don du gnyer na med pa'i thabs med do/ /de ltar bdag dang bdag gi ba la rang bzhin cung zad kyang med par nges pa'i lta ba rnyed nas de'i don goms par byas pas chos kyi sku 'thob par 'gyur ba yin no zhes sogs tshig gsal gyi lung dang bcas rgyas par gsungs la/ de ltar bdag rang bzhin med par rtogs na gzugs nas rnam mkhyen bar gyi phung po lnga sogs chos thams cad la bden par 'dzin pa'ang shugs la ldog par 'gyur te/ dper na shing rta 'tshig na 'khor lo la sogs pa de'i yan lag thams cad lhag ma ma lus pa 'tshig pa lta bu ste/ tshig gsal las/ ji ltar shing rta 'tshig na de'i yan lag dag kyang 'tshig pas mi dmigs pa de bzhin du rnal 'byor pa dag gis gang gi tshe bdag med par rdzogs pa de nyid kyi tshe phung po'i dngos po bdag gi ba yang bdag med par rtogs par 'gyur ro zhes so/ /de ltar rtogs par byed pa la shes rab zab mo dang ldan pa gal che ste/ dpe 'grel las/ zas la lces reg pa tsam gyis zas kyi ro thams cad mod la tshor nas yong la/ gzar bu de zas kyi gseb tu bcug kyang ro mi tshor/ de bzhin du skyes bu shes rab ldan pas chos thams cad kyi don tshegs med du lon nas yong / shes rab med na chos dang rtag tu 'grogs kyang chos kyi don mi lon gsung / des na shes rab gal che bas shes rab 'phel ba'i rgyu la 'bad dgos/ shes rab 'phel ba'i rgyu'i gtso bo thos bsam sgom gsum rang yin pas/ drang nges ji bzhin 'byed pa la mkhas pa sogs mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma dam pa tshul bzhin du bsten nas nges don gyi gsung rab zab mo rnams nyan pa dang / bsag sbyang la 'bad pa dang / bla ma dang yi dam gyi lha

lam gtso rnam gsum gyi tshig 'grel/ 141dbyer med du byas pa la gsol 'debs shugs drag byed pa dang / dbu ma'i gzhung rnams la thos bsam sgom gsum phu thag chod par byed pa dang / ma 'ongs par shes rab che ba'i rgyu khab skud/ snag snyug sogs zang zing dang / theg chen gyi chos sbyin gtong ba'ang gal che bar bshad do/ /gnyis pa btsal ba'i lta ba dngos bstan pa la gsum/ lta ba bstan pa dngos/lta ba rgyud la skyes pa'i tshad/ lta ba'i khyad chos so/ /dang po la gnyis/ snang stong dbyer med du rtogs na rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam la zhugs par bstan pa dang /snang stong so sor 'dzin na rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ma rtogs par bstan pa'o/ /dang po (snang stong dbyer med du rtogs na rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam la zhugs par bstan pa )ni/gang zhig 'khor 'dasachosarnamasathamasacad kyi/ /rgyu 'brasanam sprung bslu ba med mthopazhing / /dmigasapamigatad so gathayin kun zhigan/ /de ni sangasargyasadagyesapa'i lam la zhugs/ /zhes gsungs te/ rnam grol gyi lam don du gnyer ba'i gdul bya gang zhig kun nas nyon mongs phyogs kyi bden pas bsdus pa'i 'khor ba dang / rnam byang phyogs kyi bden pas bsdus pa'i myang 'das kyi chos rnams ma lus pa thams cad kyi rgyu rkyen nyon mongs pa dang las te kun 'byung bden pa la brten nas 'bras bu sdug bsngal bden pa dang / bslab pa gsum rbe1gas lam bden la brten nas 'bras bu 'gog bden chos nyid du 'byung ba sogs rnam par gzhag bya 'jog byed dang /

142 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/bskyed bya skyed byed thams cad dus nam gyi tshe yang bslu ba med par tshad mas grub par mthong zhing / de lta bu'i rgyu 'bras de dag la don dam dpyod byed kyi rigs pas legs par dpyad pa na yan lag tshogs pa la shing rtar btags pa tsam las shing rta dmigs su med pa ltar/ bden grub kyi mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i dmigs pa'i gtad so'i yul gang yin pa kun rang sar zhig nas don dam par rang bzhin gyis grub pa cung zad tsam yang med par rtogs pa na/ de ni dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa thams cad dgyes pa bla na med pa skyed pa'i lam dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i lta ba rtag chad kyi mtha' thams cad dang bral ba de la zhugs pa yin no zhes pa'o/ /de ltar yang rtsa she las/rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba gang / /de ni stong pa nyid du bshad/ /de ni rgyur byas gdags pa ste/ /de ni dbu ma'i lam yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs pa'o/ /chos thams cad btags don btsal na rdul tsam yang bden par grub pa mi rnyed pa'i rang bzhin stong pa nyid du gnas kyang /snang tshul rten 'brel gyi rgyu 'bras bslu med du 'char bas don la bden pa med kyang / 'char tshul bslu med mngon sum pa la 'gog pa med de/ bzhin dang me long tshogs pa'i rten 'brel las gzugs brnyan byad bzhin du bden par med kyang byad bzhin gyi gzugs brnyan gsal bar snang ba bsnyon du med pa dang mtshungs te/yab sras mjal ba las/

lam gtso rnam gsum gyi tshig 'grel/ 143me long shin tu yongs dag la/ /ji ltar rang bzhin med pa yi/ /gzugs brnyan snang ba de bzhin du/ /ljon pa chos rnams shes par gyis/ /zhes so/ /rten 'byung sna tshogs gzugs brnyan ltar snang ba dang de nyid rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa'i stong par shes pa gnyis mi 'gal ba ni sgyu mas sprul pa'i gzugs brnyan mi bden par shes bzhin du snang ngo la 'gog med du 'char ba lta bu ste/ dbu ma la 'arnacog pa las/dngos po stong pa gzugs brnyan la sogs pa/ /tshogs la nyestos pa ma grags pa yang min/ /ji ltar der ni gzugs brnyan sogs stong las/ /shes pa de yi rnam pa skye 'gyur ltar/ /de bzhin dngos po thams cad stong na yang / /stong nyid dag las rab tu skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de'ang bden pa mngon sum du gzigs pa'i 'phags pa'i gang zag rnams la bde sdug gi rnam pa ci shar yang mi bzod pa dang sred zhen gyi rnam pa gang yang mi 'byung mod/ rang re so so skye bo rnams kyis bden pa mngon sum du ma mthong ba'i ring la/ sdug bsngal phra mo tsam yang mi bzod pa da lta myong bas grub pa 'di ka yin pas sdig pa phra zhing phra ba nas spong zhing dge ba phra zhing phra

144 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/ba nas sgrub dgos te/ rmi lam don la mi bden par shes kyang 'brul shes kyi ngor bden par bzung nas dga' sdug nyams su myong ba dang mtshungs pa'i phyir/ jo bo rjes/ rmi lam yul gyi bzang ngan rnams/ /rmi lam blo la bden par snang / /rmi lam bden pas stong na yang / /'khrul shes can de bden par 'khrul/ /de bzhin 'di yul ma lus pa'ang / /bden pas stong yang der 'dzin blos/ /bden pa nyid du mngon par 'khrul/ /zhes dang / 'brom rin po ches/chos thams cad rdzun pa'i snang ba yang / /gzugs med na gzugs brnyan ga las 'byung / /de rgyu song rdzun yang 'bras 'byung bas/ /las khyad du mi gsod nyams len pa'i/ /de lta ba brgyud pa'i bka' gdams yin/ /zhes sogs lung dang rigs pas kyang 'grub pa'i phyir ro/ /'di lta bu ni rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa dgyes pa'i lam ma nor ba yin te/ rgyal bas chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong bka' bstsal pa'i dgos pa 'gro ba rnams gnas skabs mngon mtho

lam gtso rnam gsum gyi tshig 'grel/ 145dang / mthar thug nges legs thob thabs su gsungs pa las gzhan med de/'phags pa r+sha/sa/dang por mngon par mtho ba'i chos/ /phyis ni nges par legs 'byung ba/ /gang phyir mngon par mtho thob pas/ /rim gyis nges par legs pa 'ongs/ /zhes gsungs pa'i mngon mtho'i go 'phang ni lha mi'i theg pa la gnas pa yan chad kyis thob cing / nges legs thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa thob pa la lta ba rnam par dag pa dgos te/ de'ang bye brag tu smra ba rtag gcig rang dbang can gyi bdag gis stong pa'i lta ba/ mdo sde pa gang zag rang rkya thub pa'i rdzas yod kyis grub pas stong pa'i lta ba/ sems tsam pa gzung ba phyi rol don gyis stong pa'i lta ba/ dbu ma rang rgyud pa chos thams cad bden par ma grub cing rang bzhin grub par lta ba'i lta ba sogs mang du yod kyang / mthar thug gi thar pa ni/ dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i lugs chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis grub pa cung zad kyang med par lta ba 'di kho na las gzhan gyis mi 'thob par gsungs te/ slob dpon zla ba grags pas/slob dpon klu sgrub zhabs kyi lam las ni/ /phyi rol gyur la zhi ba'i thabs med do/ /de dag kun rdzob de nyid bden las nyams/ /de las nyams pas thar pa thob yod min / /

146 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa snang stong so sor 'dzin na rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ma rtogs par bstan pa ni/snang ba rten 'brelabargyu ba med pa dab/ /stong pa khayagalen bral bamigo ba gnyis/ /ji lhad rdzosor snang ba de srid du/ /da dung thub pa'i dgongasapa rtogasapa med/ /ces gsungs te/ /drang don gyi snang ba thams cad rgyu med dang mi mthun pa'i rgyu las mi 'byung bar rang rang gi rgyu rkyen dang 'dogs byed kyi rtog pa la brten nas 'byung ba'i rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba bslu ba gtan nas med pa'i mi 'chol ba'i don la gting tshugs pa'i go ba dang / nges don la dpyod pa'i rigs pas btags don btsal ba na rnyed rgyu'i rang bzhin rdul tsam yang med pa'i stong pa nyid la bden grub kyi kun rdzob gang yang khas len rgyu dang bral ba'i don la gting tshugs pa'i go ba gnyis po de/ ji srid du so sor snang zhing tsha grang ltar 'gal bar mthong ba de srid du da dung thub pa'i mthar thug gi dgongs pa klu sgrub kyis bkral ba ji lta ba bzhin rtogs pa'i skabs med do zhes pa'o/ /skabs 'dir stong pa khas len dang bral ba'i go ba zhes pa spyir yin min dang yod med sogs kyi khas len med pa la mi zer gyi/ rigs shes kyis btags don btsal ba'i tshe kun rdzob gang yang khas len dang bral ba la byed pa yin te/ rje btsun red mda' ba'i zhal nas/thal 'gyur ba la khas len gang yang med zer ba'i don gnas lugs la dpyod

lam gtso rnam gsum gyi tshig 'grel/ 147pa'i tshe lkugs pa bzhin du ci yang mi smra bar sdod pa yang min gyi/ gnas lugs nges pa'i tshe rigs ngo der kun rdzob gang yang khas len rgyu med pa la zer gsungs zhes sogs legs bshad snying po las 'byung / gzhan yang / kun rdzob rten 'brel gyi snang ba dang don dam rang bzhin gyis stong pa gnyis ngo bo gcig yin te/myu gu lta bu rang gi don dam ngo bo tha dad yin na/ de rang nyid bden pas stong pa'i stong nyid dang ngo bo tha dad du 'gyur bas de bden grub tu 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ byang chub sems 'grel las/kun rdzob stong pa nyid tu bshad/ /stong nyid kho na kun rdzob yin/ /med na mi 'byung nges pa'i phyir/ /byas dang mi rtag dag bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na gzugs phung rang gi gdags gzhi la brten nas ming dang rtog pas phar btags pa tsam ma gtogs gzugs phung dang po nas rang gi sdod lugs kyi ngos nas grub pas stong pas na/ shes rab snying po las/gzugs stong pa'o zhes gsungs/ gzugs rung de nyid rang ngos nas gzugs su ma grub pas de la gzugs kyi tha snyad shes pa'i phyir du ming dang rtog pas de la gzugs zhes pa'i brda sbyar bas/ tha snyad de'i dbang gis de gzugs su 'thad kyi sgrar mi 'thad pas stong pa nyid gzugs so/ /gzugs las kyang stong pa nyid gzhan ma yin/ stong pa nyid las kyang gzugs gzhan ma yin no/ /zhes zab mo stong pa nyid bzhi sbyor gyis gsungs so zhes so/ /grub mtha' 'og ma rnams kyis

148 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/mthar thug mi 'thob pa'i rgyu mtshan yang / rin chen phreng ba las/ji srid phung por 'dzin yod pa/ /de srid de la ngar 'dzin yod/ /ngar 'dzin yod na yang las te/ /de las yang ni skye ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ phung po rang bzhin gyis grub par 'dzin pa'i bden 'dzin lhan skyes de 'khor ba'i rtsa ba yin pa la de spong ma nus pas so/ /skabs 'dir thal rang gnyis kyis don dam dpyod byed kyi rtags kyi dgag bya la phra rags kyi khyad par yang / thal 'gyur bas chos thams cad rtog pa'i dbang tsam gyis bzhag par 'dod cing rtog pa'i dbang tsam gyis bzhag pa ma yin par dang po nas rang ngos nas grub pa zhig yod na bden grub tu 'gyur bar 'dod/ rang rgyud pa rnams chos rnams rtog pa'i dbang tsam gyis 'jog mi nus pas blo gnod med la snang ba'i dbang gis 'jog cing / de yang bum pa 'jog byed kyi blo gnod med des 'jal rgyu'i bum pa ni/ blo de la ltos med kyi tshul gyis dang po rang nas grub grub pa gcig la 'dod cing / de ltar grub pa de bum pa rang ngos nas grub pa'i don yin zhes bzhed de/ thal 'gyur ba ni bum pa de kho rang 'jal byed kyi tshad ma la ltos med kyis dang po nas ma grub par/ bum pa dang bum pa 'jal byed gyi tshad ma gnyis phan tshun ltos nas grub par bzhed de/ tshig gsal las/ tshad ma dag yod na gzhal bya'i don dag tu 'gyur la/ gzhal bya'i don dag yod na tshad ma'i don dag tu 'gyur gyi/ tshad ma dang gzhal bya gnyis ngo bo nyid kyis grub pa yod pa ma

lam gtso rnam gsum gyi tshig 'grel/ 149yin no zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na chos thams cad dang po nas ma grub pa la/'dogs byed kyi rtog pa'i dbang gis glo bur du grub pa yin te/ jo bo'i zhal nas/rgyus med byis pa glo bur yin/ /don med snang stong dpyad yul min/ /snang tsam ltos la dri ba zhog /tha snyad dpyad na 'jig pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / thal 'gyur ba rnams gang zag gi phung po re re ba gang zag yin nam/ de tshogs pa gang zag yin nam/ de las don gzhan du gyur pa'i gang zag yod snya/ma du dpyad pa na/ gang zag rnyed rgyu cung zad kyang med cing / de ltar ma rnyed pa de gang zag bden par med pa'i don yin gyi/ gang zag gtan nas med pa'i don ma yin par bzhed/ de ltar btsal bas ma rnyed na ma rnyed pa'i ngang la rtse gcig tu bzhag cing / 'dzin stangs shugs chung du song na blo zur zhig gis sngar ltar dpyad nas 'dzin stangs kyi shugs gsos pa na/ dpyad cing dpyad mthar yang cung zad mnyam par 'jog pa yin gyi/ btags don btsal nas ma rnyed pa na da dung de'i steng du rang bzhin gyis grub pa med snyam pa'i dgag bya'i khyad par bsnun nas sgom pa ma yin pa sogs rgyas par byung ngo / /gnyis pa lta ba rgyud la skyes pa'i tshad ni/nam zhigaresa'adzogamed par cig car du/ /rten 'brel mibaslur mthong ba tsam nyid nas/ /

150 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/ngesashesayul gyi 'dzin stangasakun 'jig na/ /de tshe lta bamidabyad pa rdzogasapa lags/ /zhes gsungs te/ sngar bshad pa'i lta ba de nyams su blangs na dus nam zhig gi tshe rgyu la brten nas 'bras bu 'byung ba sogs kun rdzob snang phyogs kyi bya byed thams cad 'thad ldan bslu med du 'char ba'i go ba dang / rgyu 'bras sogs 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis grub pa rdul tsam yang med par sgyu ma'i rta glang dang rmi lam gyi bya byed bzhin/ snang yang ngo bos stong pa'i go ba gnyis rang rgyud la gcig gi go ba rnyed tshe cig shos kyi don phyin ci log tu 'gro ba de/ res mos su 'jog pa med par blo'i yul du snang stong cig car du rten 'brel mi bslu bar gtan tshigs rnam dag gi rig pas mthong ba tsam nyid kyi byed pa la brten nas lta ba la nges shes lhang gis skye zhing / des yul rang bzhin gyis grub par 'dzin pa'i 'dzin stangs kun lhag ma med par 'jig par byed thub pas na/ dus de'i tshe lta ba la thos bsam gyi dpyad pa rdzogs pa ste lta ba rnam dag rgyud la skyes pa lags so zhes pa'o/ /de ltar yang byang chub sems 'grel las/chos rnams stong pa 'di shes nas/ /las dang 'bras bu brten pa gang / /ngo mtshar las kyang 'di ngo mtshar /rmad byung bas kyang 'di rmad byung / /zhes dang / jo bos/

lam gtso rnam gsum gyi tshig 'grel/ 151rnam rtog 'di yis ci yang shes/ /gzhi med mtshan nyid du ma 'god/ /da ni sna tshogs snang gyur kyang / /ci yang med kyi cir ma 'dzin/ /des na bde sdug la sogs pa/ /rnam rtog ci tsam 'dus gyur kyang / /snang ba tsam zhig kho nar zad/ /bden pa srid pa tsam yang ston/ /snang ba de ni nyid du spyod/ /ces sogs mang du 'byung ste/ dbu ma'i lta ba la nges pa rnyed pa'i gang zag gi blo yul du snang ba rten 'brel la snyon med du 'char ba dang stong pa don dam gyi 'dug lugs gnyis cig car du 'char ba mi 'gal ba yang / dper na sgyu ma mkhan gyis rdo shing rta glang du sprul pa'i tshe/ sgyu ma mkhan rang nyid kyi mig shes la rdo shing rta glang du snang ba dang / des rdo shing rta glang gis stong par nges pa mi 'gal ba lta bu yin par gsungs so/ /'di'i tshig rkang gsum pa'i don 'chad pa la 'bru gnyer mang yang / gtso bo bdag 'dzin shags 'debs las/ nges shes yul gyi 'dzin stangs kun 'jig nas/ /rang bzhin grub pa'i 'dzin stangs yin par go /zhes pa ltar nges shes bden 'dzin dang 'dzin stangs de'i 'dzin stangs bshad pa dang /spyan snga blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi lta khrid las/ nged rang la ji ltar snang ba 'di yod na rang gi nges shes kyi 'dzin stangs thams cad dang dmigs pa'i gtad so thams

152 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/cad 'jig pa ji ltar 'ong / des na 'brul ba 'jig thabs med pa'i lung rigs 'dis gnod cing 'di dang 'gal bas so/ /so so skye bo'i mig shes sogs kyang snang yul la 'khrul ba dang de'i gzugs sogs thams cad snang ba ltar ma grub pa dang / de ltar shes na dmigs gtad 'jig pa dang 'dzin stangs thams cad 'jig pa sogs kyi don yang nged rang so skye thams cad la thun mong du snang bzhin pa bkag nas sgom pa'i don yin zhes bshad pa sogs so/ /gsum pa lta ba'i khyad chos ni/gzhan yang snang bsayod mtha' sel ba dang / /stong pasamed mtha' sel zhing stong pa nyid/ /rgyu dang 'brasabur 'char ba'i tshul shesan/ /mthar 'dzin lta bsa'aphrog par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs te/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis grub pas stong pa la rgyu 'bras rten 'brel gyi rnam bzhag 'jog pa mi 'gal ba ma zad/ thal 'gyur ba'i thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos gzhan yang yod de dper na/ myu gu chos can/ rang bzhin gyis ma grub ste/ rten 'brel yin pa'i phyir/ zhes rtags gsal bkod na/thal 'gyur bas 'dod lan gdab dgos la/ de'i phyir rtags la rten 'brel yin pa'i phyir zhes pa'i rten pa ni gzhan la brten pa yin cing grogs gzhan la brten nas grub dgos na/ de'i nus pas myu gu rtsod gzhi de rang ngos sam rang bzhin gyis ma grub par go nus pas na snang ba rten 'brel gyis myu gu rang bzhin yod pa'i rtag mtha' sel ba dang / gsal ba la rang bzhin gyis ma grub ste zhes

lam gtso rnam gsum gyi tshig 'grel/ 153dmigs kyis bkar bas na/ myu gu rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa yin gyi spyir ma grub pa ma yin pa go nus pas na/ rang bzhin gyis grub pas stong pa nyid kyis myu gu spyir med pa'i chad mtha' sel zhing / chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis grub pas stong pa nyid rgyu dang 'bras bur nam yang bslu ba med par 'char ba'i tshul tshad ma'i stobs kyis legs par shes pa na/ sgro 'dogs pa rtag pa dang skur ba 'debs pa chad pa'i mthar 'dzin pa'i lta ba ngan pas/ sngar bshad pa'i dbu ma'i lta ba rnam par dag pa de'i don 'phrog nus par mi 'gyur ba'i phyir ro zhes pa'o/ /de'ang rang rgyud pa man chad kyis snang bas med mtha' sel zhing stong pas yod mtha' sel ba yin la/ snang ba rang bzhin gyis grub par 'dod de/ rang bzhin gyis grub pa la rgyu rkyen gyis gsar du bcos pa dang / ltos sa ltos chos 'jog pa sogs kyi bya byed gang yang gzhag tu med de/ rtsa she las/rang bzhin dag ni bcos min dang / /gzhan la ltos pa med pa yin/ /zhes dang /rang bzhin gzhan du 'gyur ba ni/ /nam yang 'thad pa ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /thal 'gyur ba'i lugs la de las ldog ste snang bas yod mtha' dang / stong pas med mtha' sel zhing / rang bzhin gyi grub pa la sngar med gsar du bcos su rung ba dang / sngar yod glo bur du med par 'gyur ba dang rgyu

154 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/rkyen sogs gzhan la ltos pa gzhag tu mi rung bas/ rang bzhin gyis grub pas stong pa'i rgyu de nyid rang ngos nas ma grub pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ rang gi rgyu la ltos nas 'bras bu dang / rang gi 'bras bu la ltos nas rgyur 'gyur tshul dang / 'bras bu yang rang gi rgyu dang 'bras bu la ltos nas 'bras bu dang rgyu gnyis kar 'char ba'i tshul dang / res 'ga' yod cing yang glo bur du med par 'gyur ba'i tshul tshad ma'i stobs kyis legs par shes na/ rtag chad mthar 'dzin gyi lta ba las grol bar 'gyur ro/ /rten 'brel gyi rigs pa 'dis rtag chad kyi mtha' gnyis dus cig car du sel bas rigs pa'i rgyal po zhes gsungs pa yin te/ 'jug pa las/de phyir rten 'byung rig pa 'di yis ni/ /lta ngan dra ba mtha' dag gcod par byed/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir rten 'brel gyi gtan tshigs kyi gnad 'di ma go bas dngos smra ba rnams kyis/ sa myug gnyis rang bzhin gyis grub ste/ sa bon gyis myu gu skyed pa'i don byed nus pa'i phyir zhes smras la/ thal 'gyur bas gzhal na 'gal khyab yin/ phyi rol pa rnams kyis rten 'brel gyi gnad ma go bar dngos po rnams rgyu med dang / ngo bo nyid kyi rgyu dang / dbang phyug rtag pa sogs las skye bar 'dod dgos pa byung ba yin cing / rgyu rkyen las byung ba'i rten 'brel ni/ rang rgyud pa man chad dang thun mong ba'i rten 'brel dang / rtog pas btags pa tsam las byung ba'am grub pa ni thal 'gyur ba'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rten 'brel gyi don yin zhing / de lta bu'i thal 'gyur ba'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rten 'brel de ni sangs rgyas kyi dgongs bzhed thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos bla na med pa yin te/

lam gtso rnam gsum gyi tshig 'grel/ 155rin chen phreng ba las/de phyir sangs rgyas rnams kyi ni/ /bstan pa 'chi med yod med las/ /'das pa zab mo zhes bya ba/ /chos kyi khud pa yin shes kyis/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gzhan yang myu gu rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis sa bon dang chu lud drod gsher sogs kyi rgyu rkyen gyi rten 'brel tshogs na skye yi rdo ba dang mgal dum sogs las mi skye ba ni stong pa rten 'brel gyi don du shar ba dang /myu gu rgyu rkyen tshogs pa las skye ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis rang ngos nas skye ba ma grub pa ni rten 'brel stong pa'i don du shar ba'i gnad yin no/ /gsum pa mjug gi don la gnyis/ nyams su blang bar bskul ba dang / rtsom pa mthar phyin pa'i bya ba'o/ /dang po (nyams su blang bar bskul ba )ni/de ltar lam gyi gtsobo rnam gsum gyi/ /gnad rnamasarang gisaji bzhin rtogasapamitshe/ /dben pa brten te brtson 'grusastobasabaskyed nas/ /gtan gyi mdun ma myur du sgrubasashig bu/ /zhes gsungs te/ gong du bshad pa de ltar nges 'byung / byang sems/ yang dag pa'i lta ba ste lam gyi gtso bo rnam pa gsum nyams su len tshul gyi zab mo'i gnad

156 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/'gag rnams thos bsam gyis gtan la phab nas rang gis ji lta ba bzhin du 'khrul ba med pa rtogs pa de'i tshe na/ chos brgyad dang 'du 'dzis dben zhing grong las rgyang grags kyis 'phags pa'i spang ljongs sam nags tshal gyi dgon pa yid dang mthun pa brten par byas te/ gnas skabs kyi bde ba'i ro la ma sred par drag la yun ring ba'i mi rtag pa'i lcag gis bskul ba'i brtson 'grus kyi stobs ches cher bskyed nas rtse gcig tu nyams su longs la/ rang gzhan gyi don thams cad bde blag tu 'grub pa'i skye ba gtan gyi 'dun ma rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang myur du sgrubs shig bu skal ldan ngag dbang grags pa zhes rje rin po ches gdams pa yin no/ /de'ang nges 'byung dang snying rje nyams su len tshul ni sngar smos pa ltar la/ rje rin po ches/ bka' gdams lta ba'i skyong tshul stong pa nyid 'dzin stangs kyi yul du byas nas skyong bar gsungs pa'i don thos bsam gyi dus su/ dbu ma nas bshad pa'i rigs pa yang dag gis gtan la phab pa'i bdag med kyi don de nyid sgom pas nyams su len pa'i tshe na'ang 'khor ba'i rtsa bar gyur pa'i bdag 'dzin de/stong nyid kyi don la so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis yang yang dpyad pa'i stobs kyis drangs pa'i lhag mthong gis spang dgos pa'i phyir/ lta ba bsgom pa'i tshe stong nyid rang rgyud kyi blo'i dmigs yul tsam du byas pas mi chog gi 'dzin stangs kyi yul du byas nas sgom dgos par gsungs te/ po to ba'i be'u bum las/kha cig thos bsam dus na rigs pas/rang bzhin med par gtan la phab la/ /sgom dus mi rtog 'ba' zhig sgom zer/ /

lam gtso rnam gsum gyi tshig 'grel/ 157de lta na ni 'brel med stong nyid/ /logs su sgom phyir gnyen por mi 'byung / /de lta bas na sgom dus nyid na'ang / /gcig dang du bral rten 'brel la sogs/ /gang la goms pas so sor brtag cing / /cung zad mi rtog nyid du rong gnas bya/ / de ltar bsgoms na nyon mongs gnyen po/ /lha gcig rjes su 'brang bar 'dod cing / /pha rol phyin lugs spyod par 'dod pas/ /shes rab sgom pa'i lugs ni de yin/ /de yang gang zag bdag med goms pas/ /de nas de ltar rjes su 'jug bya/ /zhes gsungs/ sgom tshul 'di dag ni pha rol tu phyin pa'i lta ba'i skyong tshul yin zhing / de'i nang nas kyang so skye las dang po bas lta ba thog mar skyong ba'i skabs yin pas gtan tshigs sam rgyu mtshan yang dag la brten pa'i rigs shes rjes dpag gis bdag med bsgom pa yin la/ de la bdag med pa'i rgyu mtshan yang yang bsam pa'i dpyad pa ma byas na/ rigs shes des drangs pa'i bdag med nges pa'i nges shes shugs can mi skye zhing / de ma skyes na bdag med la dmigs pa'i sgom byung skye ba mi srid/ de ma skyes na bdag med mngon du 'gyur ba mi srid pa'i phyir/ dper na mi rtag pa dang las 'bras dang 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs byams

158 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/snying rje byang chub kyi sems sogs sgom pa'i tshe/ bdag ni 'chi'o snyam pa tsam gyi 'dzin stangs gcig kho na bzung bas mi chog par bdag nges par 'chi/ myur du 'chi/ nam 'chi la nges pa med pa'i thre/ mtshan zhib tu bsams datre/sa pa bzhin yin pa'i phyir te/ de ltar yang lhag mthong chen mo las/ lung dang rigs pas sgo du ma nas dpyod pa ni bdag med pa'i don ma rtogs pas rtogs pa'i don du yin la/ lta ba yang rnyed zin pas sgom pa'i tshe mi dgos so snyam na/ de ltar mthong lam du bdag med pa mngon sum du rtogs pa yin pas de nas mthong zin pa de sgom pa don med par 'gyur ro/ /gal te de ni sgom dgos te sgom spang rnams goms pas spong gi mthong ba tsam gyis mi spong ngo snyam na/ mtshungs te 'dir yang sngar thos bsam gyis gtan la phab pas nges zin kyang gtan la 'bebs pa la tre|mas par byed dgos pa'i phyir te/ ji tsam gtan la 'bebs pa de goms par byas pa de tsam du nges pa shugs drag pa dang rgyun ring ba rnams gsal ba dang brtan par 'gyur ba sogs su mthong ba'i phyir ro/ /des na rnam 'grel las/nges pa dang ni sgro 'dogs yid/ /gnod bya gnod byed ngo bo'i phyir/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ de gnyis gnod bya gnod byed yin pa nges pa ji ltar brtan pa dang shugs drag pa sogs su song ba de tsam du sgro 'dogs la gnod pas 'dir yang rang bzhin med pa'i nges pa je 'phel du gtang dgos la/ de yang gnod byed dang sgrub byed du ma'i sgo nas bsam dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /de lta ma yin na mi rtag pa dang las 'bras dang 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dang byang chub kyi sems dang /

lam gtso rnam gsum gyi tshig 'grel/ 159byams pa dang snying rje sogs la'ang de dag gi go ba rnyed nas mi dpyod par/bdag ni 'chi'o snyam pa tsam gyi 'dzin stangs kho na bzung nas bskyang dgos par 'gyur te rgyu mtshan kun nas mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na nges pa rnam dag 'dren pa la ni bdag ni 'chi'o snyam pa dang / sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya'o snyam pa dang / sems can snying re rje snyam pa tsam la sogs pa'i dam bca' tsam res mi chog gi rgyu mtshan sgo du ma nas bsam dgos pa bzhin du/ rang bzhin med pa'i nges pa brtan pa dang shugs drag pa sogs kyang dam bca' tsam zhig bzung bas mi chog gi gnod byed dang sgrub byed sgo du ma nas bsam dgos te/ skyes bu chung ngu'i skabs su yang dang yang du bshad zin to zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /lam gtso rnam gsum po 'di mdo rgyud kun gyi gnad 'dus yin pa'i phyir bka' gdams pa'i dge bshes gong ma rnams kyis kyang gdams pa'i snying po bla na med par mdzad de/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'brom ston pa la 'phan yul sbras kyi 'brom ming sring gnyis kyis bsnyen bskur zhus nas/ bshes gnyen chen po la jo bo rje lha cig gi gdams ngag bum pa gang byo'i tshul du mnga' ba lags pas/ de ring sangs rgyas thob pa'i gdams ngag cig mi gsang bar zhu 'tshal zhus pas/ston pa'i zhal nas/ dang po 'chi ba mi rtag pa dang las rgyu 'bras mang du sgoms la rang gi khas blangs pa'i srung sdom kun dag par bya/ byams pa dang snying rje mang du sgoms la byang chub kyi sems brtan par bya/ de'i phyir tshogs gnyis thabs sna tshogs kyi sgo nas bsag sdig pa thabs sna tshogs kyi sgo nas sbyang ba la 'bad par bya/ chos thams cad 'khor gsum mi dmigs pa'i rtsis zin pas dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad sems can thams cad dang thun mong du rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo

160 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/bar bya/ de ltar byas na jo bo rje dang ma mjal snyam pa'i mya ngan bya mi dgos/'tshang rgya bar byed pa la chos de las med/ phyis nas 'brom rgan po dang ma 'phrad snyam pa'i mya ngan bya mi dgos gsungs ang / yang dge bshes ston pa la slob ma sku mched gsum gyis thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam thams cad kyi don mdor bsdus nas nyams su blang ba'i thabs shig zhu lags zhus pas/ 'brom ston pa'i zhal nas/ rten gyi gang zag cig gis thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas thob par byed pa la lam gyi 'jug sgo bslab bya bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yod kyang rgyud la skye bar bya rgyu'i dngos po gcig las med/ gcig po gang yin na stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can yin/ de la bye brag tu phye na stong pa ni don dam byang chub kyi sems te chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin nam gnas lugs ye nas skye med du rtogs pa de yin/ snying rje ni kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems te de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can rnams la snying rje chen po skyes pa de yin/ des na theg pa chen po'i nyams su len pa rnams kyi dang po byang chub kyi sems gnyis po de rgyud la ma skyes pa skye bar byed pa'i thabs la 'bad cing / bar du yang byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis rgyud la skyes pa de nyid la sbyangs pas/ mtha' ma mthar phyin pa'i 'bras bu chos sku dang gzugs sku mngon sum du thob nges pa yin/de la dang po byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis rgyud la ma skyes pa skye bar byed pa'i thabs mang yang / mdor bsdu nas nyams su len pa la/ thabs kyi rtsa ba gsum/ yan lag gi gtso bo dgu las med/ dang po rtsa ba gsum ni/ blo sbyong ba dang / tshogs bsag pa dang / ting nge 'dzin btsal ba dang gsum du 'dus/ de dag gi yan lag gi gtso bo dgu ni/ dang po blo sbyong ba'i thabs mang yang / mi rtag

lam gtso rnam gsum gyi tshig 'grel/ 161pa bsgom pa dang / byams snying rje bsgom pa dang / bdag med gnyis bsgom pa dang gsum gtso bo yin te/ blo sbyong gi thabs su de gsum kho na gtso che zhing gzhan thams cad de'i khongs su 'dus/ tshogs bsag pa la bsag thabs mang yang bla ma'i bsnyen bkur dang / dkon mchog gi mchod pa dang / dge 'dun gyi bsnyen bkur dang gsum gtso bo yin te/ tshogs gsog gi thabs de gsum kho na che zhing 'dus/ ting nge 'dzin btsal ba la btsal thabs mang yang / tshul khrims rnam par dag pa bsrung ba dang / brgyud pa'i bla ma la gsol ba gdab pa dang / lus sems dben par bsten pa dang gsum gtso bo yin te/ zhi gnas lhag mthong gi ting nge 'dzin btsal ba'i thabs su de gsum kho na che zhing 'dus/ de ltar don dgu po de dril nas nyams su blangs pas byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis ngam ngam shugs kyis rgyud la skye ste/ don dam byang chub kyi sems skyes tsam na phyi nang gi chos thams cad stong pa skye med spros bral du lhan gyis rtogs pa 'byung / de tsam na rang gi nang du blo bde rnyed pa yin/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems skyes tsam na/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can rnams la byams snying rje lhag par skye ste bya rgyu sems can gyi don las med pa zhig 'byung / de tsa na ci byas sems can gyi don du 'gyur ba zhig 'ong ba yin/ de gnyis zung du 'brel te stong pa'i dus nyid na ma 'gag pa'i sems can la snying rje lhag par skye la/ snying rje'i dus nyid na bdag dang sems can gyi dngos po ma mthong ste snang ba sgyu ma lta bu'i ngo bo stong par rtogs te zung 'brel du skyes tsa na theg pa chen po'i lam phyin ci ma log par tshud pa yin/ de nyid la sbyangs pas goms pa mthar phyin tsam na chos sku dang gzugs sku lhun grub thob pa yin te/ don dam byang chub kyi sems stong pa nyid las chos sku/ kun rdzob byang

162 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/chub kyi sems snying rje las gzugs sku/ de gnyis dbyer med du sbyangs pa las chos sku dang gzugs sku dbyer med du thob gsungs/ gzhan yang 'di dag gi gsung sgros dang zhal gdams ni shin tu mang bar byung ngo / /gnyis pa rtsom pa mthar phyin pa'i bya ba ni/zhesapa 'di ni mang du thosapa'i dge slong blo bzang gragagapa'i dpal gyisarmakho dbon po ngag dbabagragasapa la gdamasaba'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ rgyal bas gsungs pa'i mdo rgyud dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa la ma gzigs pa'am ma mkhyen pa gang yang med pas mang du thos shing / thos don bsam pas rnam par nges pa dang / bsgoms pas nyams bzhes mthar phyin pa ngo bo 'jam dpal gzhon nu dang gnyis su med kyang rnam pa dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa yongs su grags pa'i mtshan blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyis/ slob ma'i thu bo ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar du ma mnga' zhing sku tshe phyi mar kun mkhyen legs pa don grub tu 'khrungs nas zung 'jug gi go 'phang mngon du mdzad pa rgyal rong tsha kho dbon po ngag dbang grags pa la thugs brtse bas gdams pa'i snying por gnang ba'o/ /rgyal gsung snying po bsdus pa'i legs bshad phul/ /'jam dbyangs gnyis pa'i gzhung bzang be+e ḍār+ya/ /'grel bshad rgyal mtshan mngon mtho'i rtser bkod kyang / /blo rmongs 'jug bde'i dga' ston 'di bskrun to/ /srid pa'i dpal las nges 'byung blo gros brtan/ /

lam gtso rnam gsum gyi tshig 'grel/ 163lhag bsam byang sems gser gyi yol go sa /rnam dag lta ba'i bdud rtsi yongs bskyil bas/ /thar 'dod rgud pa sel ba'i nyer 'tshor shog /bka' gdams brgyud pa'i lta spyod dri ma med/ /bdag gzhan 'gro ba'i rgyud la legs 'byor te/ /chos ltar bcos pas nam yang mi bslu bar/ /jo bo yab sras dgongs pa skong byed shog /ces pa 'di nyid kyi bshad rgyun kun gzigs bla ma 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i zhal snga nas rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po dang paṇa chen rin po che'i 'grel ṭīka steng nas bka' drin du bstsal pa thob cing / gdams ngag rin po che'i mdzod du rgyun bzhugs pa la nye bar mkho bas mtshams sbyar te dngul chu ba dharma bha dra'i 'grel bsdus sor bzhag don 'dus go sla'i tshul du thub bstan ris med la dad pa'i snang ba yangs por brdal ba ku swā li blo gros mtha' yas kyis khams kyi zab bu lung rdzong shod kyi sgrub gnas su bgyis pa dge legs 'phel// //

man ngag lugs kyi blo ldog rnam bzhi/༄༅/ /skabs bzhi pa blo ldog rnam bzhi rnam par nges pa la gnyis/ thos bsam gyi lag rjes spyir bstan pa/ blo ldog rnam bzhi bye brag tu dbye ba'o/ /dang po (thos bsam gyi lag rjes spyir bstan pa )ni/thosabasam lag rjesarisamedabastanab dang / /bstan 'dzin kun la bcosaminadadaya skye/ /phyogasasu ma lhung lasa'abrasazhib mora31da/ /gsung rab gdamasapar shar bsargyud grol mtha/ /tha mal blo sna btsan thabasasnang ba yi/ /man ngagalugasakyi blo ldogarnam ba bzhi/ /de ltar thos pa phyogs med du byas shing de'i don rigs pas zhib mor bsams pas thos bsam gnyis kyi shes rab rgyud la legs par skyes pa'i lag rjes/ ris su ma chad pa'i rgyal ba'i bstan pa theg pa che chung spyi dang / bstan pa de nyid 'dzin pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen khyad par can kun la rgyu mtshan shes nas bcos min gyi dad pa skye/ blo skyo ma snga btsan dang / rang rang gi grub mtha' dang chos lugs tsam la zhen pa'i phyogs su ma lhung bar gzu bor gnas shing las 'bras kyi spang blang ma 'chol bar zhib mor spyod/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab mdo rgyud thams cad tshig tsam du ma lus par rang rgyud la sbyor ba'i gdams par shar bas rgyud rnam par

166 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/grol ba ni thos bsam gnad du song ba'i lag rjes yin pas/ de lta na dal 'byor rnyed dka' sogs kyi dmigs pa phran tshegs ched du bsam pa la ma ltos kyang /thos bsam tshul bzhin ma nus pa'am nus kyang thos don rgyud la ma sbyor ba'i gang zag tha mal pa rnams kyi blo sna btsan thabs su sgyur bar byed pa/ man ngag pa rnams kyi lugs kyi blo ldog rnam pa bzhi po legs par bsams nas rgyud la bskyed par bya'o/ /gnyis pa la bzhi/ tshe 'di las blo ldog pa/ 'khor ba las blo ldog pa/ zhi bde las blo ldog pa/ gzung 'dzin las blo ldog pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ blo ldog bsgom pa'i rten dal 'byor rnyed dka' bsam pa/ blo ldog dngos mi rtag pa bsam pa'o/ /dang po (blo ldog bsgom pa'i rten dal 'byor rnyed dka' bsam pa )ni/dal brgyad 'byor pa bstoldan rin chenarten / /don che rgyu 'brasadabai yisarnyed par dka'/ /'di la gsum/ dal 'byor ngos gzung / de don che ba dang / rnyed dka' bar bsam pastu( /dang po la/ dal ba brgyad ni mi khom pa brgyad dang bral ba ste/ mi khom pa brgyad ni/ 'khor rnam bzhi mi rgyu ba'i yul mtha' 'khob pa dang / glen lkugs dang yan lag dang rna ba sogs dbang po ma tshang ba dang / tshe snga phyi dang las 'bras dang dkon mchog gsum min par 'dzin pa'i log lta can dang / sangs rgyas 'byung ba med pas rgyal ba'i bka' med pa bzhi ni mi'i 'gro ba'i mi khom pa yin la/ ngan

blo ldog rnam bzhi rnam par nges pa/ 167song gsum dang lha tshe ring po ni mi ma yin pa'i mi khom pa'o/ /lha tshe ring po ni bshes springs las/ 'du shes med pa dang gzugs med pa gnyis la bshad pa'i dang po ni/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i 'bras bu che ba'i phyogs gcig na grong las dgon pa'i tshul du yod la/ phyi ma ni gzugs med du skyes pa'i so skye'o/ /mi khom pa brgyad kyi gtam las/ 'dod pa'i bya bas rtag tu g.yeng ba'i 'dod lha lha tshe ring por bshad do/ /'byor pa bcu las rang 'byor lnga ni/mi nyid dbus skyes dbang po tshang / /las mtha' ma 31ga gnas la dad/ /ces pa'o/ /de la dbus su skyes pa ni 'khor rnam bzhi rgyu ba yod sar skyes pa'o/ / dbang po tshang ba ni glen lkugs su ma song zhing yan lag nying lag mig rna sogs tshang ba'o/ /las mtha' ma 61ga pa ni mtshams med byas sam byed du bcug pa ma yin pa'o/ /gnas la dad pa ni 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkar chos thams cad skye ba'i gnas dam pa'i chos 'dul ba la dad pa ste/ 'dul ba ni 'dir sde snod gsum ga la bya'o/ /lnga po de rang rgyud kyis bsdus shing chos sgrub pa'i cha rkyen yin pas rang 'byor zhes bya'o/ /gzhan 'byor lnga ni/sangs rgyas byon dang dam chos ston/ /bstan pa gnas dang de rjes 'jug /gzhan phyir snying ni brtse ba 'o/ /zhes pa'o/ /de la sangs rgyas byon pa'am 'byung ba ni bskal pa grangs med pa

168 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/gsum gyi tshogs bsags nas mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'o/ /dam chos ston pa ni sangs rgyas sam de'i nyan thos kyis chos ston pa'o/ /chos bstan pa gnas pa ni sangs rgyas shing chos bstan pa nas mya ngan las ma 'das bar du don dam pa'i chos mngon du byed pa'i tshul gyis sgrub pa'i chos ma nyams pa'o/ /chos gnas pa rjes su 'jug pa ni chos rtogs pa de nyid kyis skye bo rnams la dam chos mngon du bya ba'i mthu yod par rig nas ji ltar rtogs pa lta/ra bstan pa la rjes su 'jug pa'o/ /gzhan gyi phyir snying brtse bar byed pa ni sbyin pa po dang sbyin bdag gis chos gos sogs ster ba'o/ /de lnga ni gzhan rgyud la yod cing chos sgrub pa'i cha rkyen yin pas gzhan 'byor ro/ /gnyis pa de nyid don che bar bsam pa ni/ dal brgyad 'byor pa bcu dang ldan pa ni shin tu rnyed par dka' zhing rnyed na mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi go 'phang mtha' dag sgrub nus pas phan thogs che ba'i phyir mi lus rin po che zhes bya ste/slob springs las/bder gshegs lam brten 'gro ba 'dren par chas gyur cing / /sems kyi stobs chen mi yis rnyed pa gang yin pa/ /lam de lha dang klu yis rnyed min lha min dang / /mkha' lding rig 'dzin mi'am ci dang lto 'phyes min/ /zhes gsungs so/ /des na khams gsum gyi nang nas khyad par du 'phags pa'i rten bzang po da res lan gcig tsam rnyed cing / rnyed pa don che ba'i rten 'dis mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi rgyu nyin mtshan du brtson pas ma bsgrubs na rin chen

blo ldog rnam bzhi rnam par nges pa/ 169gling nas lag stong du log pa las kyang rmongs tshabs che ba la sogs pa bsam mo/ /gsum pa rnyed dka' bar bsam pa la/ rgyu'i sgo nas rnyed dka' ba ni/ spyir bde 'gro tsam zhig thob pa la'ang tshul khrims la sogs pa'i dge ba rnam dag sna gcig byed dgos pa dang / khyad par du dal 'byor tshang bar thob pa la tshul khrims rnam par dag pas gzhi bzung / sbyin sogs kyis grogs byas/ smon lam dri ma med pas mtshams sbyar ba sogs dge rtsa mang po zhig dgos na/ rgyu de lta bu sgrub pa yang shin tu nyung bar snang bas de la dpags nas 'bras bu bde 'gro'i rten spyi dang khyad par dal 'byor rnyed dka' bar sems pa'o/ /'bras bu'i sgo nas rnyed dka' ba ni/ spyir lung gzhi las/ ngan 'gro bde 'gro nas shi 'phos te ngan 'gror 'gro ba ni sa chen po'i rdul dang / de nas bde 'gror 'gro ba ni sen mo'i steng du chags pa'i rdul tsam las med par gsungs pas/rigs mi mthun pa'i ngan 'gro rnams la ltos te bde 'gro tsam yang srid mthar snang la/ rigs mthun bde 'gro la ltos te yang dal ba khyad par can ni ches dkon par bsam pa'o/ /dpe'i sgo nas rnyed par dka' ba bsam pa ni/ zhi ba lhas/rgya mtsho cher g.yeng gnya' shing gi /bu gar rus sbal mgrin chud ltar/ /mi nyid shin tu 'thob dkar gsungs/ /zhes dang / gzhan yang nyin mo'i skar ma/ u dum wa ra'i me tog sogs rnam grangs du mar sbyar te nges pa rnyed par bya'o/ /

170 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/gnyis pa mi rtag pa bsam pa la gnyis/ 'jig rten 'dir ring du mi gnas par 'chi ba rjes su dran pa dang / 'jig rten gzhan du ji ltar 'gyur ba'i tshul la bsam pa'o/ /dang po ('jig rten 'dir ring du mi gnas par 'chi ba rjes su dran pa )ni/'chingesanam 'chacha med 'chaba'i tshe/ /chosamin mi phan rtsaba'i dmigasapa gsum/ /man lagami zlogasnon med lothaskabasamed/ /dusal maresarkyen mang nyam chungadab/ /gnyen lusalongasaspyod mistapasathag gcod bcas/ /rgyu mtshanadagyosbyor 'chib rjesasu dran/ /zhes 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsam pa la/ skyes pa'i rtags kyis 'chi bar sdo/ba pas cis kyang 'chi nges pa dang / rgan gzhon ma nges par shi ba'i rtags kyis nam 'chi cha med pa dang / 'chi ba'i tshe chos ma gtogs gang gis kyang mi phan par lung gis bsgrubs te bsam pa ni rtsa ba'i dmigs pa gsum yin la/ de re re la'ang yan lag gsum gsum sbyar te/ 'chi bdag nges par 'ong zhing de'ang thabs gang gis kyang mi zlog pa dang / tshe la snon pa med cing 'brid byed nyin mtshan skad cig re re zhing yod pa dang / gson pa'i tshe yang chos dang 'jig rten gyi bya gzhag bsam tshad lag tu len pa'i long skabs med par 'chi ba thog tu 'bab pas na 'chi nges pa'i rgyu mtshan gsum/ gling gzhan dag tu tshe tshad phal cher nges pa yod kyang 'dzam bu gling pa'i tshe tshad kyi dus la nges pa med pa dang / nang gi nad dang phyi rol 'byung

blo ldog rnam bzhi rnam par nges pa/ 171gdon sogs 'chi ba'i rkyen ni shin tu mang zhing gson pa nyid kyang 'chi ba'i don du zhugs pa yin pas yid brtan med pa dang / lus chu bur lta bur shin tu nyam chung bas gnod pa chung ngus kyang srog 'jig par byed pas na nam 'chi cha med pa'i rgyu mtshan gsum/ 'chi ba'i tshe gnyen grogs 'khor g.yog brgya stong yod kyang gcig kyang khrid dbang med pa dang / lhan cig skyes pa'i lus gces par bskyangs pa nyid kyang sa rdo ltar 'dor dgos pa dang / longs spyod 'byor pa dpag med yod kyang khab tsam khyer sa med pas/ de dag gis 'chi ba'i skabs su mi stangs pas chos ma gtogs cis kyang mi phan pa'i rgyu mtshan gsum ste/ rgyu mtshan dgu po sbyor la 'chi ba rjes su dran par bya'o/ /gnyis pa lta'ijig rten gzhan du ji ltar 'gyur ba'i tshul la bsam pa )ni/shi nasa'agro ba gnyisasu skye ba ste/ /de dgabasamasanasatsho'adir blo sdog bya/ /de ltar myur du 'chi bar nges pas tshe 'dir sdod long med cing shi ba'i 'og tu med nas mi 'gro bar skye ba len dgos so/ /de yang 'gro ba gnyis las gzhan skye sa med pas bde 'gro'am ngan 'gror skye'o/ /de'ang rang dbang med cing las kyi gzhan dbang can yin pas las dkar nag gis ji ltar 'phangs pa bzhin skye'o/ /de ltar na bdag ngan song du skyes na ci 'dra zhig tu 'gyur snyam du ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal bsam ste/ klu sgrub kyis/rab tu tsha zhing grang ba yi/ /dmyal ba nyi ma gcig bzhin dran/ /

172 'jam mgon kong sprul yon to rgya mtsho /bkres skom dag gis rid pa yi/ /yi dwags dag kyang dran par bya/ /rmongs pa'i sdug bsngal rab mang ba'i/ /byol song blta zhing dran par bya/ /de'i rgyu rnams spang bde rgyu spyad/ /thob dka' 'dzam gling mi yi lus/ /de thob dus su ngan song rgyu/ /rab tu bsgrims te gcad par bya/ /zhes so/ /de'ang dmyal ba la tsha grang gtso bor gyur pa'i sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa yod de/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi zhal nas/dmyal ba bris pa mthong dang thos pa dang / / dran dang bklags dang gzugs su bgyis rnams kyang / /'jigs pa bskyed par gyur na mi bzad pa'i/ /rnam smin nyams su myong na smos ci 'tshal/ /zhes dang /'di na nyin gcig mdung thung sum brgya yis/ /rab tu drag btab sdug bsngal gang yin pa/ /des ni dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal chung ngu la'ang / /'ol yang mi nye char yang mi phod do/ /

blo ldog rnam bzhi rnam par nges pa/ 173zhes gsungs so/ /yi dwags la'ang bkres skom la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal mang po yod de/yi dwags na yang 'dod pas phongs pa yis/ /bskyed pa'i sdug bsngal rgyun chags mi 'chos pa/ /bkres skom grang dro ngal dang 'jigs pa yis/ /bskyed pa shin tu mi bzad bsten 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs so/ /dud 'gro la'ang gcig la gcig za ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal yod de/dud 'gro'i skye gnas na yang gsod pa dang / /bcing dang brdeg sogs sdug bsngal sna tshogs pa/ /zhi 'gyur dge ba spang pa rnams la ni/ /gcig la gcig za shin tu mi bzad pa/ /zhes gsungs rber+sha/ /de ltar 'chi ba rjes su dran pa dang shi nas ngan song du lhung ba'i sdug bsngal dag la bsams te tshe 'di la blo ldog cing 'jig rten phyi ma la don gnyer gyi blo bskyed par bya'o/ /gnyis pa 'khor ba las blo ldog pa la gnyis/ bde sdug gi rgyu las 'bras bsam pa/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ las 'bras spyir bsam pa/ lci yang sogs bye brag tu bsam pa'o/ /

174 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/dang po (las 'bras spyir bsam pa )ni/mibasbu 'phel che ma byasami'aphrad cing / /byasapa chud mizab lasakyi lam/ /spyir so so skye bo dang 'phags pa gang yin kyang tshor ba sim pa'i rnam pa can gyi bde ba tha na sems can dmyal bar skyes pa na rlung bsil ba langs pa la brten nas skyes pa yan chad thams cad ni sngon dge ba'i las bsags pa las 'byung gi mi dge ba'i las las bde ba 'byung ba ni gnas med pa la/ tshor ba gdung ba'i rnam pa can gyi sdug bsngal tha na dgra bcom pa'i rgyud la skyes pa man chad sngon mi dge ba bsags pa las 'byung gi dge ba'i las las sdug bsngal 'byung ba ni gnas med de/ rin chen phreng ba las/mi dge ba las sdug bsngal kun/ /de bzhin ngan 'gro thams cad do / /dge las bde 'gro thams cad dang / /skye ba kun tu bde ba dag /ces so/ /las de'ang mtshan nyid bzhi dang ldan te/ las 'bras nges pa 'phel che ba ma byas pa dang mi 'phrad pa/ byas pa chud mi za ba'o/ /dang po ni/ bde sdug gi 'bras bu dge sdig ci rigs pa dang phan tshun 'chol ba'am/ rgyu med dang gtso bo dang dbang phyug sogs mi mthun pa'i rgyu las 'byung ba

blo ldog rnam bzhi rnam par nges pa/ 175yang min par dge mi dge'i las spyi las bde sdug spyi dang / bde sdug gi khyad par sna tshogs pa rnams kyang las gnyis kyi khyad par sna tshogs las cung zad kyang ma 'chol bar so sor 'byung bas las 'bras nges can nam mi bslu ba la nges pa rnyed pa ni/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi yang dag pa'i lta ba zhes pa dkar chos thams cad kyi gzhir bsngags pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ las dge ba chung ngu las kyang 'bras bu bde ba shin tu che ba 'byung la/ las mi dge ba chung ngu las kyang 'bras bu sdug bsngal shin tu chen po 'byung bas nang gi rgyu 'bras kyi 'phel ba 'dra ba ni phyi rol gyi rgyu 'bras la med do/ /de yang ཿṭāms las/sdig pa chung ngu byas pas kyang 'jig rten pha rol 'jigs chen 'gyur/ /phung khrol chen po byed 'gyur te/ /khong par song ba'i dug bzhin no/ /bsod nams chung ngu byas pas kyang / /'jig rten pha rol bde chen 'dren/ /don chen dag kyang byed 'gyur te/ /'bru rnams phun tshogs smin pa bzhin/ /zhes rber+sha/ /gsum pa ni/ bde sdug myong ba'i rgyur gyur pa'i las ma bsags na 'bras bu bde sdug gtan mi myong ba ste/ ston pas tshogs grangs med pa bsags pa'i 'bras

176 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/bu la spyod pa rnams kyis kyang de'i rgyu thams cad bsag mi dgos kyang cha gcig bsag dgos par gsungs pas so/ /bzhi pa ni/ las dge mi dge byas pa rnams kyis yid du 'ong mi 'ong gi 'bras bu 'byin pa ste/ lung las/las rnams bskal pa brgyar yang ni/ /chud mi za ba'ang tshogs dang dus/ /rnyed na lus can rnams la ni/ /'bras bu dag tu 'gyur ba nyid/ /ces gsungs so/ /gnyis pa lci yang sogs bye brag tu bsam pa ni/rdziyang zhing bsamarten dngosastobasachebs/ /rnam smin rgyu mthunabadagawali'abrasabu 'byin/ /de'ang legs spyad nyes spyad kyi spyod pa 'jug pa'i sgo ni gsum du nges la/ sgo gsum gyi dge mi dge thams cad las lam bcu kho nar 'dus pa ma nges kyang /dge mi dge'i che long ngam rags pa kha na ma tho ba'i gzhi che ba rnams bcom ldan 'das kyis gnad bsdus nas nag po'i las lam bcur gsungs shing / de dag spangs na don shin tu che ba'i gnad rnams kyang bcur 'du ba gzigs nas dkar po'i las lam bcur gsungs te/ mdzod las/

blo ldog rnam bzhi rnam par nges pa/ 177de las che long bsdus nas ni/ /dge dang mi dge ci rigs par/ /las kyi lam ni bcur gsungs so/ /zhes dang / lung rnam 'byed las kyang /ngag rnams bsrungs shing yid kyis rab bsdams te/ /lus kyis mi dge ba dag mi byed cing / /las lam bcu po 'di dag rab sbyangs na/ /drang srong gsungs pa'i lam ni thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /las lam bcu po ni yongs su grags che bas 'dir zhib tu ma smos shing gong du'ang phyogs tsam bshad zin la/ de dag lci yang gi khyad par ni sa'i dngos gzhi las lci ba'i tshul drug gsungs te/ mngon par 'du byed pa ni dug gsum mam de gsum mi ldan pa'i bsam pa drag pos las kun slong ba'o/ /goms pa ni dge mi dge'i las gnyis yun ring po nas kun tu bsten goms lan grangs mang du byas pa'o/ /ngo bo nyid ni lus ngag gi bdun phyi ma phyi ma las snga ma snga ma lci zhing / yid kyi gsum ni snga ma snga ma las phyi ma phyi ma lci ba'o/ /gzhi ni sangs rgyas/chos/ dge 'dun/ bla ma lta bu rnams la phan gnod byed pa'o/ /mi mthun pa'i phyogs gcig tu nges pa ni ji srid 'tsho ba'i bar du gcig tu nges par mi dge ba'i las blangs te 'dug la dge ba ni gcig kyang mi byed pa'o/ /mi mthun phyogs sel ba ni/ mi dge ba'i phyogs spangs te 'dod chags dang bral nas dge ba'i las spyod

178 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/pa'o/ /bshes springs las kyang /rtag dang mngon par zhen dang gnyen po med/ /yon tan gtso ldan gzhi las byung ba'i las/ /dge dang mi dge rnam lnga chen po ste/ /de la dge ba spyod la brtson par gyis/ /zhes so/ /de'ang dkon mchog la sogs pa yon tan dang ldan pa'i gzhi dang pha ma sogs phan 'dogs pa'i gzhi gnyis su phye bas lnga'o/ /stobs dang ldan pa'i las ni bzhi ste/ zhing / bsam pa/ rten/ dngos po'i sgo nas stobs che ba'o/ /dang po ni/ dkon mchog gsum dang bla ma dang de 'dra ba pha ma sogs te 'di dag la ni bsam pa shugs drag po med cing phan gnod chung ngu zhig byas kyang bsod nams dang kha na ma tho ba che ba'i phyir ro/ /khyad par byang chub sems dpa' ni dge mi dge'i zhing shin tu stobs che ste/ 'ga' zhig khros nas phyogs bcu'i sems can thams cad brtson ra mun nag tu bcug pa bas khros te byang sems la rgyab kyis phyogs te 'dug nas ma rung pa 'di la mi lta'o zhes zer na sdig ches grangs med pa skyed pa dang / mchod rten gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed bshig pa dang bsregs pa las byang sems la khong khro dang gnod sems bskyed cing mi snyan par smras na sdig che ba dang / bsod nams bsags pa'i zhing yang de bzhin mchog tu gyur par gsungs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ rin chen phung po'i mdo las/ stong gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyis so so nas sangs rgyas kyi mchod rten ri rab tsam byed la/ de dag la'ang

blo ldog rnam bzhi rnam par nges pa/ 179bskal pa bye ba snyed du bsti stang du bya ba thams cad kyis bsti stang du byed pa las byang sems kyis thams cad mkhyen pa'i sems dang ma 'bral bas me tog gcig tsam 'dor ba bsod nams mang bar gsungs te/ de bzhin du thob bya mchog dman dang rang gzhan gyi don la dmigs pa sogs bsam pa'i khyad par can dang /de'ang shugs drag zhan dang rgyun ring thung sogs kyi sgo nas shes par bya'o/ /nyes spyod la'ang nyon mongs pa'i bsam pa shugs drag pa dang rgyun ring bas stobs che la/ de'i nang nas khong khro shin tu stobs che ste/ spyod 'jug las/bskal pa stong du bsags pa yi/ / sbyin dang bder gshegs mchod la sogs/ /legs spyad gang yin de kun kyang / /khong khro gcig gis 'joms par byed/ /ces so/ /de'ang tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa dang de las kyang rgyal sras la khro ba ni shin tu lci bar gsungs so/ /gsum pa ni/ lcags kyi gong bu chung yang gting du bying la/ de nyid snod du byas pa ni che yang steng du 'otswarto ba bzhin du mi mkhas pa dang mkhas pas byas pa'i sdig pa yang lci ba dang yang bar gsungs so/ /de'ang snga ma'i las la 'gyod nas phyi ma sdom zhing sdig pa mi gsang ba de'i gnyen po dge ba byed pa'i mkhas pa la yang bar gsungs kyi/ de dag mi byed par khyad gsod kyi sgo nas shes bzhin du 'jug pa'i mkhas par rlom pa la ni lci ba yin no/ /dge ba byed pa la'ang gnad don shes pa'i mkhas pa dang / sdom pa dang ldan pa dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par can dang ldan

180 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/pa rnams rim gyis phan yon 'gyur khyad che ba yin no/ /bzhi pa ni/ sems can la sbyin pa gtong ba la chos kyi sbyin pa dang / sangs rgyas mchod pa la sgrub pa'i mchod pa ni zang zing gi sbyin pa dang mchod pa las ches phul du byung ba ste des mtshon nas gzhan yang shes par bya'o/ /las lam de dag gis/ rnam smin gyi 'bras bu/ rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu/ bdag po'i 'bras bu 'byin par 'gyur te/ dang po ni/ las lam bcu po re re yang gzhi dug gsum che 'bring chung gsum la brten pas gsum gsum mo/ /de la srog gcod sogs chen po bcu po re res dmyal ba/ 'bring bcu po re res yi dwags/chung ngu bcu po re res dud 'gror skye bar sa'i dngos gzhir gsungs la/ sa bcu pa'i mdo las ni chung 'bring gnyis kyi 'bras bu ldog ste gsungs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ ngan 'gro nas mir skyes kyang rjes su 'brang ba ste/ ji skad du/gsod pa yis ni tshe thung 'gyur/ /rnam par 'tshe bas gnod pa mang /brkus pa yis ni longs spyod phongs/ /byi bo byas pas dgra zlar bcas/ /rdzun du smra bas skur ba ste/ /phra ma yis ni bshes dang 'byed/ /tshig rtsub nyid kyis mi snyan thos/ /ma 'brel bas ni tshig mi btsun/ /brnab sems yid la re ba 'joms/ /

blo ldog rnam bzhi rnam par nges pa/ 181gnod sems 'jigs pa sbyin par byed/ /log par lta bas lta ngan nyid/ /cesatshoso/ /gsum pa ni/ phyi 1dul gyi yul la nyes pa 'byung ba ste/phyi rol gzi chung gnod pa mang / /rdul 'khrigs dri nga mtho dman can/ /tshwa sgo can dang log pa dang / /'bras bu phra la chung ngam med/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /dge ba'i las stobs che chung snga mas rigs 'gre zhing /rnam smin ni/ dge ba'i las chung ngu dang 'bring dang chen pos mi dang 'dod lha dang khams gong ma gnyis kyi lhar skye'o/ /rgyu mthun dang bdag 'bras ni mi dge ba las bzlog ste sbyar ro/ /de dag 'phen rdzogs kyi dbye ba ni/ bde 'gror 'phen pa'i las ni dge ba dang / ngan 'gror 'phen pa'i las ni mi dge ba yin la/ rdzogs byed la nges pa med de bde 'gror yang yan lag dang nying lag dang dbang po ma tshang ba dang mdog mi sdug pa dang / tshe thung ba dang / nad mang ba dang / dbul ba sogs ni mi dge bas byed pa/ dud 'gro dang yi dwags la'ang dpal 'byor phun sum tshogasapatshoyod pa ni dge bas byed pa'o/ /de ltar 'phen byed dge bas 'phangs pa la rdzogs byed dge bas rdzogs pa dang mi dge bas rdzogs pa gnyis dang / 'phen byed mi dge bas 'phangs pa la rdzogs byed mi dge bas rdzogs pa dang dge bas

182 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/rdzogs pa gnyis te mu bzhi'o/ /myong bar nges pa dang ma nges pa gnyis las/ myong nges ni bsam bzhin du byas pa dang bsags pa'o/ /myong bar ma nges pa ni bsam bzhin du byas la ma bsags pa'o/ /byas pa dang bsags pa'i khyad par la byas pa ni bsam pa'am bsams nas kyang lus ngag gis kun nas bslangs pa'o/ /bsags pa ni rmi lam du byas pa sogs bcu po ma gtogs pa'i las so ma bsags pa ni rmi lam du byas pa sogs rnam pa bcu'o/ /myong nges la 'bras bu myong ba'i dus kyi sgo nas gsum ste/ mthong chos la myong ba ni las 'di'i 'bras bu tshe 'di la myong ba'o/ /skyes nas myong 'gyur ni tshe gnyis pa la 'bras bu myong ba'o/ /lan grangs gzhan la myong ba ni tshe gsum pa phan chad du myong ba'o/ /de dag gi tshul la'ang legs par bsam par bya'o/ /gnyis pa 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsam pa la gnyis/ sdug bsngal brgyad dang /spyi'i sdug bsngal gsum bsam pa'o/ /dang po (sdug bsngal brgyad bsam pa )ni/skye rga na 'chi sdug pa bral ba dang / /mi sduga'aphrad cing 'dod pa btsal ma rnyed/ /nyer len kubapo sdugabasngal / /zhes pa ste/ ngan 'gro sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin yin pa rtogs sla mod/ mtho ris na'ang bde ba med cing spyir 'khor ba mtha' dag sdug bsngal kho na'i rang bzhin yin te/ mgon po byams pas/

blo ldog rnam bzhi rnam par nges pa/ 183mi gtsang ba la dri zhim med bzhin 'gro lnga dag na bde ba med/ /de yi sdug bsngal rtag tu me mtshon rgya tshwa la sogs reg skyes bzhin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de la sdug bsngal gyi gtso bo ni brgyad de/ dang po skye ba sdug bsngal dang ldan/ skye ba gnas ngan len dang ldan/ skye ba sdug bsngal gyi gnas su gyur/ skye ba nyon mongs kyi gnas su gyur/ skye ba mi 'dod bzhin du 'bral ba'i chos nyid yin pas sdug bsngal gyi yan lag lnga dang ldan/gnyis pa rgas pa la gzugs nyams pa/ mthu stobs nyams pa/ dbang po nyams pa/ yul la longs spyod pa nyams pa/ tshe yongs su nyams pa ste yan lag lnga/gsum pa na ba la/ lus kyi rang bzhin 'gyur ba/ sdug bsngal dang yid mi bde 'phel ba/ yul gyi longs spyod yid du 'ong ba la spyod dbang med pa/ yid du mi 'ong ba bsten dgos pa/ srog dang 'bral bar nye ba ste yan lag lnga/ bzhi pa 'chi ba la/ nyedu/ 'bor g.yog longs spyod/ rang lus te phun sum tshogs pa bzhi dang bral la/ 'chi ba'i tshe sdug bsngal dang yid mi bde ba'i tshor ba drag po myong ba ste yan lag lnga po rnams la sems pa'o/ /lnga pa mi sdug pa dang 'phrad pa'i sdug bsngal la lnga ste/ dgra lta bu la 'phrad pa tsam gyis sdug bsngal dang yid mi bde skye ba dang / des chad pa gcod pa sogs 'jigs pa'i gnas su 'gyur pa dang / gtam ngan pas 'jigs pa dang / nyam nga bzhin du 'chi bas 'jigs pa dang / chos dang 'gal bas shi ba'i 'og tu ngan 'gror song dogs nas 'jigs pa ste de dag la sems pa'o/ /drug pa sdug pa dang bral ba'i sdug bsngal la lnga ste/ ches phangs pa'i gnyen la

184 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/sogs pa dang bral na des sems la mya ngan skye ba dang / ngag tu smre sngags 'don pa dang / lus la gnod pa skyed pa dang / yul de'i yon tan dran zhing 'dod pas yid gdung ba dang / de'i longs spyod ma tshang ba ste de rnams sems pa'o/ /bdun pa 'dod pa btsal te ma rnyed pa'i sdug bsngal bsam pa la lnga ste/ sdug pa dang 'bral ba dang 'dra'o/ /de'i ngo bo ni so nam byas kyang ston thog ma grub pa dang / tshong byas kyang khe sbogs ma thon pa sogs te/ gang la re ba de 'bad nas btsal kyang ma rnyed pas yi chad pa'i sdug bsngal lo/ /'di dag skye bzhis bsdus pa'i 'gro ba thams cad la yod mod kyang mi la gtso cher sbyor du yod pas kha cig gis mi'i sdug bsngal kho nar bzhag pa'o/ /brgyad pa mdor na nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga sdug bsngal zhes gsungs pa'i don bsam pa la lnga ste/ mngon par 'grub pa'i sdug bsngal gyi snod dang / mngon par grub pa la brten pa'i sdug bsngal gyi snod dang / sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal gyi snod dang / 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal gyi snod dang / 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du gyur pa ste de dag la yang yang sems pa'o/ /de la dang po ni/ nyer len gyi phung po 'di blangs pa la brten nas skye ba phyi ma phan chad kyi sdug bsngal rnams 'dren pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ phung po grub zin la brten pa'i na rga sogs kyi rten du gyur pa'o/ /gsum pa dang bzhi pa ni/ sdug bsngal gnyis po de'i gnas ngan len rjes su 'brel bas de gnyis skyed pa'o/ /lnga pa ni/ nyer len gyi phung po grub tsam gyis 'du byed sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du skye ste/ las nyon snga ma'i gzhan dbang du gyur pa'i 'du byed thams cad

blo ldog rnam bzhi rnam par nges pa/ 185'du byed kyi sdug bsngal yin pa'i phyir ro/ /nyer len gyi phung po'i rang bzhin gyi 'khor ba la skyo ba rnal ma zhig ma skyes na thar pa don gnyer gyi blo rnal ma skye ba med cing / sems can 'khor bar 'khyams pa la snying rje chen po yang skye thabs med pas theg pa che chung gang du 'jug kyang bsam pa 'di shin tu gal che'o/ /gnyis pa spyi'i sdug bsngal gsum bsam pa ni/ thamasacad kyang/ /yidabartan med cing mi ngomasathogamed zhugs/ /sdug bsngal gsum bsam 'khorabarablo sdogs /zhes pa ste/ 'khor ba pa'i 'gro ba thams cad kyang nges pa med pa dang / ngoms mi shes pa dang / lus yang dang yang du 'dor ba dang / yang dang yang du nying mtshams sbyor ba dang / yang dang yang du mtho dman du 'gyur ba dang / grogs med pa'i nyes pa drug bshes springs las gsungs pa ni bsdu na gsum du 'du ste/ 'khor ba la yid brtan bya sa med pa dang / de'i bde ba la ci tsam du spyad kyang ngoms pa'i mtha' med pa dang / thog ma med pa nas zhugs pa'o/ /dang po la bzhi las/ lus thob pa la yid brtan mi rung ba ni yang dang yang du lus 'dor ba'o/ /phan gnod byed pa la yid brtan mi rung ba ni pha bu dang / ma chung mar 'gyur ba dang / dgra bshes su 'gyur ba sogs nges pa med pa'o/ /phun tshogs thob pa la yid brtan mi rung ba ni mtho sa nas dma' sar lhung ba'o/ /'grogs pa la yid brtan mi rung ba ni grogs med par 'gro ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sngon dang phyi ma'i mtha' mi mngon par yongs su 'khor ba na/ lha

186 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/dang mi'i dbang phyug dag tu gyur nas 'dod pa'i dga' ba de dpag tu med pa la longs spyad kyang lan tshwa'i chu 'thung ba'am g.yan pa phrug pa ltar cung zad kyang ngoms mi shes pas sred pa je 'phel du 'gyur ba'o/ /gsum pa ni/ yang yang nying mtshams spyor ba ste skye ba brgyud pa'i mtha' mi mngon pa'o/ /mi'i sdug bsngal gzhan yang / tshogs kyi gtam las/ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal ma lus pa/ /mi rnams la yang yod par snang / /sdug bsngal gzir bas dmyal bar mtshungs/ /dbul bas gshin rje'i 'jig rten pa/ /mi la dud 'gro'i sdug bsngal yang / /mthu ldan stobs kyis mthu med par/ /rnam par gnon zhing 'tshe ba dag /chu bo lta bu nyid yin no/ /zhes dang / bzhi brgya pa las/mchog la yid kyi sdug bsngal te/ /tha mal rnams la lus skyes so/ /sdug bsngal nyid kyis 'jig rten 'di/ /nyin re nyin rer 'joms par byed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar dang / lha ma yin rnams lha'i dpal 'byor mi bzod pa'i phrag

blo ldog rnam bzhi rnam par nges pa/ 187dog gis yid gdung la/ de la brten nas lha dang 'thab pa na lus gcod pa dang /'dral ba sogs kyi sdug bsngal du ma myong ba dang / de rnams shes rab dang ldan yang rnam smin gyi sgrib pa can yin pas rten de la bden pa mthong mi rung bar gsungs/ 'dod pa'i lha rnams kyang 'chi 'pho ba dang lhung ba'i sdug bsngal/ spa bkong ba'i sdug bsngal/ gcod pa dang 'dral ba dang gsod pa dang spyugs pa'i sdug bsngal rnams yod cing / khams gong ma gnyis kyi lha rnams la sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal med kyang nyon mongs pa dang ldan zhing sgrib pa dang bcas la 'chi 'pho ba dang gnas pa la rang dbang med pas gnas ngan len gyis ni sdug bsngal lo/ /mdor na khams gsum gnas ris mtho dman gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal/ khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gsum gyi rgya mtshor rtag tu g.yeng ba'i tshul la bsam ste 'khor ba las blo ldog go /gsum pa zhi bde las blo ldog pa ni/rgyu 'brasamanajigabadun gyisagazhan don blo/ /skyegasgosemagasnyom pa dang yid 'ongabasgrub/ /byabachub donaganyer byamagadangasnying rje che/ /lhag pa'ibasam pasazhibader blo ldogabya/ /zhes pa ste/ de ltar 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsgoms pas srid pa thams cad me'i 'obs ltar mthong ste nyon mongs pa dang sdug bsngal nye bar zhi ba'i thar pa thob 'dod kyis yid kun tu gdungs pa des/ lam bslab pa gsum la bslabs na 'khor ba las grol ba'i thar pa 'thob cing / de'ang mtho ris kyi dpal ltar slar

188 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/ldog pa'ang ma yin mod/ 'on kyang skyon zad pa dang yon tan thob pa phyogs re ba yin pas rang don ma rdzogs la/ de nyid kyis na gzhan don yang nyi tshe bar zad cing mthar sangs rgyas kyis bskul nasatshotheg chen du 'jug dgos paratshorigs shing /de'i 'jug sgo ni byang chub kyi sems kho na yin la/ de rgyud la nam skyes pa na theg chen par 'jog go /'di la sdong po bkod pa las/ rigs kyi bu byang chub kyi sems ni sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyi sa bon lta bu'o zhes gsungs te/de'ang nas kyi sa bon ni rkyen gang dang tshogs kyang 'bras la sogs pa'i myu gu'i rgyur mi rung bas na myu gu'i rgyu thun mong min pa yin la/ des zin pa'irtechu lud sogs kyang nas kyi myu gu'i rgyur 'gyur ba de bzhin du bla med byang chub kyi sems ni sangs rgyas kyi myu gu'i nang nas sa bon lta bu thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyu yin la/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab ni chu lud sogs dang 'dra b.ratshobyang chub gsum ga'i rgyu thun mong ba yin no/ /de'i phyir rgyud bla ma las kyang / theg mchog la mos sa bon shes rab ni/ /sangasargyas chos skyed ma dang / zhes theg pa mchog la mos pa ni pha'i sa bon dang / bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab ni ma lta bur gsungs te/dper na pha bod la bu rgya hor sogs skye mi srid pas pha ni bu'i rigs ngesapa'i rgyu yin la/ ma bod la ni bu sna tshogs pa skye bas thun mong gi rgyur 'gyur ba bzhin no/ /klu sgrub kyis kyang / sangs rgyas rang sangaspu rgyaba'irnams dang / /nyan thos rnams kyis nges bsten pa/ /thar pa'i lam ni gcig nyid khyod/ / /gzhan dag med ces bya bar nges/ /

blo ldog rnam bzhirnam par nges pa/ 189zhes sher phyin la bstod pas nyan rang rnams kyang de la brten la/ des na sher phyin la ldazho zhes kyang gsungs pas/ theg pa che chung gnyis ka'i sras kyi yum yin pa'i phyir stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis theg pa che chung 'byed pa min gyi byang chub kyi sems dang spyod pa rlabs che ba rnams kyis 'byed pa yin no/ /de'i phyir thog mar byang chub kyi sems sbyang dgos pas de'i man ngag la jo bo rje nas brgyud pa la lugs gnyis/ sha ra ba'i slob ma gtum ston blo gros grags nas brgyud pa la rgyu 'bras rim pa lnga ste/ bdag sangs rgyas thob dgos pa la sangs rgyas kyi rgyur byang chub kyi sems dgos par 'dug de'i rgyur snying rje dgos par 'dug de'i rgyur byams pa dgos par 'dug de'i rgyur byas pa shes shing drin du gzo ba dgos par 'dug de'i rgyu sems can thams cad pha mar shes pa dgos par 'dug sems can thams cad pha ma yin drin re che/ 'di rnams sdug bsngal dang bral/ bde zhing skyid na ci ma rung / 'di rnams bde ba la 'god pa'i phyir sangs rgyas thob par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas thob nas kyang sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi sa la gzhag par bya'o snyam du bsam pa'o/ /yang bya yul ba'i slob ma gtsang pa rin po che nas brgyud pa la rgyu 'bras man ngag bdun la blo sbyong bar gsungs te/ de'i dbang du byas na/ 'thob bya'i sangs rgyas nyid rgyu med rkyen med las ma yin te/ rgyu byang chub kyi sems las skye/ de lhag pa'ibasam pa rnatshipar dag pa las skye/ de snying rje chen po las skye/ de byams pa chen po las skye/ de yid du 'ong ba las skye/ de byas pa shes shing drin du gzo ba las skye/ de ma'i 'du shes bsgoms pa las skye bar gsungs so/ /de'ang gzhan don gyi blo skye ba'i gzhi rang nyid sems can la chags sdang dang

190 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/bral ba'i sems snyoms pa bsgrub ste/ de'ang thog mar phan gnod gang yang ma byas pa'i bar ma/ de nas mdza' bshes/ de nas gnod byed kyi dgra/ de nas sems can thams cad la sems snyoms pa bsgoms te/ de'ang sems can gyi ngos nas ni thams cad bde ba 'dod sdug bsngal mi 'dod par mtshungs pas na kha cig la nye bar bzung nas phan 'dogs shing / kha cig la ring bar bzung nas gnod pa byed pa'am phan pa mi byed pa mi rigs so snyam pa dang / rang gi ngos nas ni thog ma med pa nas 'khor ba na sems can gang lan brgyar bdag gi gnyen du ma gyur pa ni gang yang med pas gang la ni chags par bya la gang la ni sdang bar bya snyam du sems pa'o zhes sgom rim bar pa las gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de nas thams cad yid 'ong gi rnam pa can du bsgrubs te/ de'ang sems can re re bzhin yang rang gi mar bsam pa/ de'i drin dran pa/ de'i phyir de nyid 'khor ba nas 'don pa'i drin gzo bya dgos par bsam mo/ /'khor ba las sgrol ba'i thabs su bdag nyid byang chub chen po'i go 'phang don du gnyer bar 'dod pas de'i rgyu sems can rnams la byams pa dang / snying rje dang / lhag pa'i bsam pa sgom pa'i blo sbyang bar bya'o/ /de la byams pa'i dmigs pa ni bde ba dang mi ldan pa'i sems can no/ /rnam pa ni bde ba dang phrad na ci ma rung / bde ba dang phrad par gyur cig snyam pa dang /bde ba dang phrad par bya'o snyam pa'o/ /phan yon ni/ rin chen phreng ba las/rdze'u tshod sum brgya'i kha zas dag /nyin rer dus gsum byin pas kyang / /byams pa yud tsam thang gcig gi /bsod nams dag la char mi phod/ /

blo ldog rnam bzhi rnam par nges pa/ 191lha mi byams par 'gyur ba dang / /de dag kyang ni srung ba dang / /yid bde ba dang bde mang dang / /dug dang mtshon gyis gnod med dang / /'bad pa med par don 'thob dang / /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten skye 'gyur te/ /gal te grol bar ma gyur kyang / /byams chos yon tan brgyad thob bo/ /zhes gsungs pas mtshon mtha' yas so/ /sgom pa'i rim pa ni thog mar mdza' bshes dang / de nas bar ma dang / de nas dgra la bsgom par bya zhing / de nas sems can thams cad la rim pa bzhin du bsgom mo/ /sgom tshul ni ji ltar sems can sdug bsngal gyis sdug bsngal ba'i tshul yang yang bsams na snying rje skye ba ltar/sems can la zag bcas zag med kyi bde ba med cing / bde bas phongs lugs rnams yang yang bsams te de goms pa na bde ba dang 'phrad 'dod ngang gis 'byung la/ de'ang dge ba sna tshogs pa rnams yid la byas nas de dag sems can rnams la bstab par bya'o/ /snying rje'i dmigs pa ni/ sdug bsngal gsum gyis ci rigs par sdug bsngal ba'i sems can no/ /rnam pa ni sdug bsngal de dag dang bral na snyam pa dang / bral bar gyur cig snyam pa dang / bral bar bya'o snyam pa'o/ /sgom pa'i rim pa ni thog mar mdza' bshes dang / de nas bar ma dang / de nas dgra dang / de nas phyogs

192 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/ bcu'i sems can thams cad la'ang bsgom mo/ /de ltar btang snyoms dang /byams pa dang / snying rje'i yul so sor phye nas rim can du sgom pa de ni chos mngon pa'i mdo'i rjes su 'brangs nas slob dpon ka ma la shrī las mdzad pa yin pa gnad shin tu zab pa'o/ /sgom tshul ni mar gyur pa'i sems can de rnams srid par lhung nas phyi dang so so'i sdug bsngal ji ltar nyams su myong ba rnams la sems pa'o/ /snying rje skyes pa'i tshad ni/ sgom rim dang po las/ gang gi tshe yid du 'ong ba'i bu mi bde ba bzhin du sems can thams cad la'ang sdug bsngal gtan nas byang bar 'dod pa'i rnam pa'i snying rje rang gi ngang gis 'jug pa bdag nyid kyis mtshungs par 'jug par 'gyur ba de'i tshe de rdzogs pa yin pas snying rje chen po'i ming 'thob ste zhes gsungs te/ 'dis byams pa chen po skyes pa'i tshad kyang rig par bya'o/ /lhag pa'i bsam pa ni/ de ltar byams pa dang snying rje bsgoms pa'i mthar kye ma bdag la sdug cing yid du 'ong ba'i sems can 'di ji ltar bde ba dang 'phrad pa dang sdug bsngal las thar bar bya snyam du sems shing / de dag sgrol ba'i khur khyer ba la tha na tshig tsam gyis kyang blo sbyong la de dag gnas skabs kyi bde ba mtho ris dang / thar pa nyi tshe ba tsam ma yin par byang chub chen po kho nar 'god par 'dod pa'i bsam pa dang ma 'bral ba ni lhag pa'i bsam pa khyad par du 'phags pa ste/de'ang nyan rang gi 'phags pa dag kyang 'khor bar mi ldog cing spros med la sems ngang gis gnas pa dang yon tan dri ma dang yang ldan pa yin pas rang cag so so skye bo la ltos na blos mi 'khyud pa'i rngam chen yin mod kyi/ sangs rgyas dang byang sems rnams kyis sgrib pa gnyis spang tshul dang / ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa

blo ldog rnam bzhi rnam par nges pa/ 193mkhyen pa'i ye shes rgyas tshul dang / yon tan mu mtha' med pa mnga' tshul dang /thugs rje'i shugs dang nus mthu'i rtsal rtogs par dka' ba bzhugs tshul dang /phyogs thams cad la dus thams cad du sems can gyi don spyod pa'i phrin las 'jug tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams dang bsgrun na nyan rang gi rnam grol de ches chung bar 'dug ste/ dper na ri rab dang nyungs dkar gyi khyad las kyang khyad par che/ des na rang don spangs rtogs thams cad yongs su rdzogs nas gzhan don phrin las zad pa med pa'i rang bzhin can thar pa'i mchog rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'thob par bya/ ji ltar bya na bdag sangs rgyas thob par gyur cig gu snyam du yang yang bsams nas dman pa'i zhi bde las blo ldog par bya'o/ /bzhi pa gzung 'dzin las blo ldog pa ni / chosakun rangabazhinasnye ba med pardzidon/ / sor rtogagisadabyodagazhing 'dzin blo ldogabya/ /zhes pa ste/ kun nas nyon mongs pa dang rnam par byang ba'i chos kun gyi rang bzhin gdod ma nas skye ba med pa'i don la so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis yang dang yang du rtog cing dpyod pas/ de las 'phags pa'i ye shes skyes shing 'di ltar snang ba'i gzung 'dzin gyi 'khrul ba mtha' dag las blo ldog par 'gyur te/ de'i yul bden pa gnyis la sogs pa gong du smos zin cingo / yulasmocan sor rtog nyid bsam byung gi shes rab skyed pa la gal che ba ni/ 'od srungs le'u las/ 'od srungs 'di lta ste/ dper na shing gnyis rlung gis drud pa de las me 'byung ste/ byung nas shing gnyis sreg pa de bzhin du/ 'od srungs yang dag par so sor rtog pa yod na 'phags pa'i
