194 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/shes rab kyi dbang po skye ste/ de skyes pas yang dag par so sor rtog pa de nyid sreg par byed do/ /zhes so sor rtog pa las 'phags pa'i shes rab skye bar gsungs la/ sgom rim bar pa las kyang / des de ltar shes rab kyis rnam par dpyad de gang gi tshe rnal 'byor pas dngos po gang gi ngo bo nyid don dam par nges par mi 'dzin pa de'i tshe rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin la 'jug go /chos thams cad kyi ngo bo nyid med pa nyid kyang rtogs so/ /gang zhig shes rab kyi dngos po'i ngo bo nyid so sor brtags nas mi sgom gyi/ yid la byed pa yongs su spangs pa tsam 'ba' zhig sgom par byed pa des rnam par rtog pa rnam yang mi zlog cing ngo bo nyid med pa nyid nam yang rtogs par mi 'gyur te shes rab kyi snang ba med pa'i phyir ro/ /'di ltar yang dag par so sor rtog pa nyid las yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du shes pa'i me byung na gtsub shing gtsubs pa'i me bzhin du rtog pa'i shing sreg go zhes bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' bstsal to zhes so/ /sgom pa la'ang bsam pa gal che ba ni/ dam pa snga ma rnams kyi zhal nas/ sngar thos pa'i chos rnams blo la rug gis yod par byas la/ yang dang yang du sems par byed/ 'jal bar byed/rtogs par byed dgos/ chos brjed du bcug nas sems 'dzin rkyang pa re la slob pa de la grogs med/ sgom chen rab la ston pa rab/ sgom chen 'bring la ston pa 'bring 'ong ba yin/ ci tsam bsgoms pa de tsam du chos shes pa je cher 'gro ba zhig dgos/ de ltar bsam pas nges shes brtan na dge mi dge'i bsam pa thams cad rtog pa yin pas spang bya yin zhes sdig grogs kyis zer ba na/ chos nas de ltar ma gsungs/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen yang de ltar mi bzhed snyam nas kho'i kha la mi nyan pa zhig 'ong / de med na dad pa ni bag re yod kyang shes rab med pa de la ngu

blo ldog rnam bzhi rnam par nges pa/ 195ba'i kha la bltas na ngu bro/ dgod pa'i kha la bltas na dgod bro/ chu sna bzhin du ci zer la bden snyam nas gar khrid sar 'gro gsung ngo / /blo ldog rnam bzhi rnam par nges pa'i skabs bzhi pa'i 'grel ba'o/ /theg pa'i sgo kun las btus pa gsung rab rin po che'i mdzod bslab pa gsum legs par ston pa'i bstan bcos shes bya kun khyab ces bya ba las lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa rim par phye ba gnas bdun pa'i 'grel pa las btus nas bkod pa'o// //

theg pa chen po'i gdams ngag blo sbyong don bdun ma/༄༅/ /dang po sngon 'gro ni/ dang po sngon 'gro dag la bslab/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi byang sems sbyong ba ni/ chos rnams rmi lam lta bur bsam/ /ma skyes rig pa'i gshis la dpyad/ /gnyen po nyid kyang rang sar grol/ /ngo bo kun gzhi'i ngang du bzhag /thun mtshams sgyu ma'i skyes bur bya/ /gtong len gnyis po spel mar sbyang / /de gnyis rlung la bskyon par bya/ /yul gsum dug gsum dge rtsa gsum/ /spyod lam kun tu tshig gis sbyang / /len pa'i go rim rang nas brtsam/ /gsum pa rkyen ngan byang chub kyi lam du bsgyur ba ni/ snod bcud sdig pas gang ba'i tshe/ /rkyen ngan byang chub lam du bsgyur/ /le lan thams cad gcig la bda'/ /kun la bka' drin che bar bsgom/ /'khrul snang sku bzhir bsgom pa yi/ /stong nyid srung ba bla na med/ /sbyor ba bzhi ldan thabs kyi ma'epyog /'phral la gang thug lha/ma du sbyar/ /bzhi pa tshe gcig gi nyams len dril nas bstan pa ni/man ngag snying po mdor bsdus pa/ /stobs lnga dag dang sbyar bar bya/ /theg chen 'pho ba'i gdams ngag ni/ /stobs lnga nyid yin spyod lam gces/ /lnga pa blo wongs pa'i tshad bstan pa ni/ chos kun dgos pa gcig tu 'dus/ /dpang po gnyis kyi gtso bo bzung / /yid bde 'ba' zhig rgyun du bsten/ /yengs kyang thub na 'byongs pa yin/ /drug pa blo spyong gi dam tshig bstan pa ni/ spyi don gsum la rtag tu bslab/ /'dun pa bsgyur la rang sor gzhag /yan lag nyams pa brjod mi bya/ /gzhan phyogs gang yang mi bsam mo/ /nyon mongs gang che sngon la sbyang / /'bras bu'i re ba thams cad spangs/ /dug can gyi zas spang / gzhung bzang po ma bsten/ shag ngan ma rgod/

198 blo sbyong don bdun ma/'phrang ma bsgug gnad la mi dbab/ mdzo khal glang la ma 'byo/ mgyogs kyi rtse ma gtod/ gto log mi bya/ lha bdud du mi dbab/ skyid kyi yan lag tu sdug ma 'tshol/ bdun pa blo sbyong gi bslab bya bstan pa ni/ rnal 'byor thams cad gcig gis bya/ /'e1ga gnon thams cad gcig gis bya/ /thog mtha' gnyis la bya ba gnyis/ /gnyis po gang byung bzod par bya/ /gnyis po srog dang bsdos la bsrung / /dka' ba gsum la bslab par bya/ /rgyu yi gtso bo rnam gsum blang / /nyams pa med pa rnam gsum bsgom/ /'bral med gsum dang ldan par bya/ /yul la phyogs med dag tu sbyang / /khyab dang gting 'byongs kun la gces/ /bkol ba rnams la rtag tu bsgom/ /rkyen gzhan dag la ltos mi bya/ /da res gtso bo nyams su blang / /go log mi bya/ res 'jog mi bya/ dol chod du sbyang / brtag dpyad gnyis kyis thar bar bya/ /yus ma sgoms/ ko long ma sdoms/ yud tsam pa mi bya/ 'or che ma 'dod/snyigs ma lnga po bdo ba 'di/ /byang chub lam du bsgyur ba yin/ /gdams ngag gi khungs smos pa ni/ man ngag bdud rtsi'i snying po 'di/ /gser gling pa nas brgyud pa yin/ /gdams ngag la ched du brjod pa ni/ sngon sbyangs las kyi 'phro sad pas/ /rang gi mos pa mang ba'i rgyus/ /sdug bsngal gtam ngan khyad bsad nas/ /bdag 'dzin 'dul ba'i gdams ngag zhus/ /da ni shi yang mi 'gyod do/ /blo spyong don bdun ma'i rtsa ba rdzogs so// //

theg pa chen po blo sbyong don bdun ma'i khrid yig blo dman 'jug bder bkod pa byang chub gasdokying lam/༄7/ /gu ru bud+dhā bodhi satwe bh+yo na maḥbyams pa'i 'bor lo sngon du 'gro/ /don gnyis phyogs las rnam par rgyal/ /thub mchog zhabs kyi pad+mo ni/ /mi phyed dad pas gtsug tu bcing / /dpa' bo snying rje'i gru bzung nas/ /srid 'a11 sdug bsngal mtsho las sgrol/ /'jam dpal spyan ras gzigs dbang sogs/ /grags chen rgyal ba'i sras la 'dud/ /stong nying snying rje'i lam bzang ston/ /bla na med pa'i dge ba'i bshes/ /rgyal ba kun gyi 'dren pa ni/ /bla ma'i zhabs la phyag bgyi'o / /

200 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/sras bcas rgyal ba'i bgrod gcig lam/ /go bar sla bas bslad med la/ /lag len bde bas 'jug par spro/ /zab pas sangs rgyas 'grub de 'chad/ /'dir byang chub kyi sems sgom pa'i man ngag khyad par du 'phags pa blo sbyong don bdun ma'i khrid ston pa la gsum/ brgyud pa'i byung khungs/ spyi'i dgos don/ khrid gzhung dngos 'chad pa'o/ /dang po (birgyud pa'i byung khungs )ni/ thub dbang sras dang bcas pa'i thugs kyi man ngag snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa'i byang chub sems kyi mnga' bdag gser gling pa chos kyi grags pa dang / rang gi sku sha dngos su sgyin cing byams snying rje la brten nas stong nyid rtogs pa bla ma dharma rak+ṣi ta dang / gzhan gyi sdug bsngal rang la dngos su len nus pa bla ma byams pa'i rnal 'byor pa gsum las/ jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti shas yun ring du 'bad rtsol chen po'i tshul gyis rdzogs par gsan nas byang chub sems kyis thugs rgyud gtams/ bod kyi mgon du phebs te chos kyi 'khor lo dpag tu med pa zhig kyang tshul 'di kho na la brten nas bskor/ rigs can gsum gyi gdul bya mtha' yas pa byang grol du bkod pa las slob ma'i gtso bo khu rngog 'brom gsum dang / de las kyang spyan ras gzigs dngos 'brom ston rin po che'i zhal slob rigs gsum sprul pa sku mched gsum la gzhung / gdams ngagaman ngag gsum gyi bka' so sor babs pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po rnams las rim par brgyud de/ bka' gdams gzhung drug bshad srol gyi bka'

blo spyong don bdun ma'i khrid yig byang chub gzhung lam/ 201dge lugs pa la babs/ bden bzhi gdams ngag tu ston pa'i bka' dwags brgyud pa la babs/ man ngag thig le bcu drug gi bka' srol gnyis kas skyong bar bzhed/de ltar lha chos bdun ldan gyi bstan pa'i bdag po bka' gdams rin po cher grags pa/ lha bzhis lus brgyan/ sde snod gsum gyis ngag brgyan/ bslab pa gsum gyis sems brgyan pa'i bka' brgyud rin po che 'di la/ mdo lugs rang rkang dang / sngags dang cung zad 'brel ba'i gdams ngag mtha' yas pa bzhugs pa thams cad kyang stong nyid snying rje zung 'brel gyi lam ston pa sha stag yin mod/ gtso bor kun rdzob byang sems kyi bka' babs pas brgyud 'dzin skyes chen phal mo ches bdag gzhan brje ba'i man ngag dang rnam thar rtsal du bton cing / de la'ang khrid tshul gyi phyag srol 'dra min mang ba las/ don bdun ma 'di ni bya 'chad kha ba chen po ye shes rdo rje'i gdams pa'i bka' srol las byon pa lags so/ /gnyis pa (phyi'i dgos don )ni/ mtho ris lha mi'i bde 'bras la snying po med pa lta zhog nyan rang gi byang chub thob kyang myang 'das mthar thug ma yin pas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang kho na don du gnyer dgos/ de 'thob par byed pa la byams snying rje la blo sbyong ba kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems dang / spros bral rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang du mnyam par 'jog pa don dam byang chub kyi sems sgom pa de gnyis la ma brten pa'i thabs gzhan yod pa ma yin te/ 'phags pa klus/bdag nyid dang ni 'jig rten 'dis/ /bla med byang chub thob 'dod na/ /de yi rtsa ba byang chub sems/ /ri dbang rgyal po ltar brtan dang / /

202 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/phyogs mthas gtugs pa'i snying rje dang / /gnyis la mi brten ye shes lags/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de'ang bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rnams kyang gang dang ldan na mi gnas pa'i myang 'das kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sogs theg pa chen po'i grangs su chud pa'i rtsa ba ni sems bskyed pa kho na yin cing / de'ang byams snying rje la brten nas skye ba dang / mthar thug gi sangs rgyas thob pa na'ang dmigs med snying rjes gzhan don nyag cig mdzad pa las ci'ang byar yod pa ma yin pa dang /las dang po ba'i rgyud la don dam byang sems ji bzhin pa mi skye zhing kun rdzob byang sems sbyong na nges par skye la/ de skyes pas don dam byang sems rang shugs su rtogs par 'gyur ba sogs sgo du ma nas thog mar sems bskyed pa'i don 'bras kun rdzob byang chub sems nan tan du bsgom dgos la/ de'i gdams ngag 'dun pas sbyong ba'i thabs kyi rtsa ba ni/ slob dpon zhi ba lhas/gang zhig bdag dang gzhan rnams ni/ /myur du bskyab par 'dod pa des/ /bdag dang gzhan du brje bya ba/ /gsang ba'i dam pa spyad par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'og tu 'chad pa'i bdag gzhan brje ba'i sgom rim kho na ste/ blo sbyong rim pa gzhan rnams kyang 'di las 'phros pa'i yan lag sha stag go /gsum pa (khrid gzhung dngos )la gnyis/ gzhung khrid dngos 'chad pa dang /

blo spyong don bdun ma'i khrid yig byang chub gzhung lam/ 203brgyud pa'i gdams pas kha skong ba'o/ /dang po la bdun/ sngon 'gro rten gyi chos bstan pa/ dngos gzhi byang chub kyi sems sbyong ba/ rkyen ngan byang chub kyi lam du bsgyur ba/ tshe gcig gi nyams len dril nas bstan pa/ blo 'byongs pa'i tshad/ blo sbyong gi dam tshig blo sbyong gi bslab bya'o/ /dang po (sngon 'gro rten gyi chos bstan pa )ni/dang po sngon 'gro dag ldobaglab/ /ces gsungs te/ 'di la gnyis/ thun gyi sngon 'gro dang / khrid kyi sngon 'gro'o/ /dang po (thun gyi sngon 'gro dani/ thun la 'jug pa'i thog ma thams cad du rang gi spyi bor pad zla'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma zhal 'dzum bag sku gzi brjid dang ldan zhing / thugs dmigs med snying rjes 'gro la dgongs te bzhugs pa rtsa brgyud bla ma kun 'dus kyi ngo bor bsam/ mos gus dung dung ba'i ngang nas spro na brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyang bya/ khyad par du bla ma yang dag pa yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen pos bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems khyad par can rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol zhes gsol ba lan brgya stong du btab pa'i mthar/ bla ma de nyid rang gi spyi bo'i tshangs bug nas mar byon/ snying 'od kyi gur khang sgong skogs kha gyen bstan lta bur bzhugs par bsam la mos gus dung dung ba zhig bya ba ni bla ma'i rnal 'byor te thun 'go thams cad du gal che'o /gnyis pa (khrid kyi sngon 'gro dal/ dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/'khor ba'i nyes dmigs/ las rgyu 'bras bsam pa bzhi po khrid gsar pa yin na

204 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/lam rim ltar rgyas par 'chad cing rgyud la skye nges su bsgom dgos la/ dmigs pa'i rtsa ba mdor bsdus la mos na/ chos sgrub pa'i rten dal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i mi lus rin po che 'di thob pa la rgyu dge ba phun sum tshogs pa bsgrub dgos/ sems can gyi nang na dge ba rnam dag bsgrub pa ches nyung bas 'bras bu dal 'byor thob pa dka'/ dud 'gro la sogs pa 'gro ba gzhan la ltos na mi lus thob pa srid mtha' tsam du 'dug pas bdag gis da res mi lus lan gcig thob pa 'di chud zos su mi gtang bar chos rnam dag cig ci nas kyang bya/ de'ang tshe la nges pa med cing 'chi ba'i rkyen shin tu mang / de ring tsam yang mi 'chi bar 'dug pa'i gdeng yang med pas da lta nyid nas dam pa'i chos la 'bad dgos/ 'chi ba'i tshe dge sdig gnyis po ma gtogs zas nor longs spyod gnas lus dbang thang gang yod rjes su mi 'brang zhing phan pa spu tsam yang med pas cis kyang dgos pa med/ shi ba'i 'og tu las kyi dbang gis 'gro ba rigs drug gang du skyes kyang bde ba skra rtse tsam med/ dge sdig gi las las bde sdug gi 'bras bu 'byung ba ni bslu ba med pas sdig pa srog la babs kyang mi byed/ dge ba kho na 'bad pa chen pos bsgrub par bya'o snyam pa nan tan du sbyang / thun mjug rnams su yan lag bdun pa ci nus dang / thun mtshams su dmigs pa'i don lag len du 'debs pa ni sbyor dngos thams cad la 'gre bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis/ don dam byang sems zhar byung du bsgom pa/kun rdzob byang sems gtso bor bsgom pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ thun dang / thun mtshams rber+sha/ /dang po (thun )la sbyor ba bla ma'i rnal 'byor song nas/ lus drang por 'dug ste

blo spyong don bdun ma'i khrid yig byang chub gzhung lam/ 205dbugs phyir 'gro dang nang 'gro lan nyer gcig gi bar du ma 'khrugs par bgrangs pas bsam gtan gyi snod du rung bar 'gyur ro/ /dngos gzhi ni/chosarnamasarmi lam lta bar2khas/ /zhes gsungs pas/ snod bcud dngos po'i chos gzung ba'i yul du snang ba 'di rnams rang gi sems kyi 'khrul snang kho na yin pas/ don la bden par grub pa cung zad kyang med de rmi lam gyi snang ba lta bu'o zhes bsam la 'dun pa cung zad sbyang / sems nyid bden nam snyam na/ma snyesarigaspa'ir sal dbyad/ /ces gsungs te/ rang sems kyi ngo bo la cer gyis bltas pas kha dog dbyibs sogs gang du'ang ma grub cing 'byung ba'i khungs med pas dang por ma skye/ da lta lus kyi phyi nang la sogs pa gang du 'ang mi gnas/ mthar 'gro zhing 'gag pa'i yul med pa skye 'gag gnas bral gyi rig pa'i gshis la sems 'tshol gyi dpyad pas thag chod kyi nges shes 'thob par bya/ de'i tshe lus sems thams cad stong pa'o snyam pa dang / stong pa la cis kyang phan gnod med do snyam pa sogs gnyen po'i rnam rtog byung na/gnyen po nyid kyang rang sar grol/ /zhes gsungs te/ gnyen po bden med kyi 'dun pa de ga'i ngo bor bltas pas/ de nyid kyang gtad med rang sar grol ba de'i ngang du lhod kyis glod/ de dag ni dpyad

206 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/sgom pa'i grub don man ngag tu bstan pa'o/ /ngolha( kunagazhi'itshang 'bakazhag /ces pa ni 'jog tshul dngos bstan pa ste/ rnam shes tshogs bdun gyi spro bsdu thams cad dang phral nas/ chos thams cad kyi ngo bo kun gzhi ngang lugs dge ba bde gshegs snying po'i sgras bstan pa/ spros bral gsal la mi rtog pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi ngang du/ gshis cir yang ma grub pa la blos gang yang mi 'dzin par rang bab tu gzhag pa ste/ mdor na rnam rtog gi rjes su mi 'brang bar sems nyid gsal la rtog med kyi ngang du ci gnas su mnyam par gzhag pa ni 'jog sgom pa'i bab so'o/ /rjes yan lag bdun pa sngar ltar 'gre'o/ /gnyis pa (thun mtshams su bsgom pa )ni/ro/na ma ma'i che/'a(85pa bya/ /zhes pas thun mtshams su spyod lam ci byed kyang mnyam bzhag gi nyams dang ma bral bar/ rang gzhan snod bcud gang snang thams cad med bzhin du snang ba sgyu ma'i skyes bu ltar bden med du shes pa'i 'dun pa rgyun chags su bskyed do/ /gnyis pa kun rdzob byang sems gtso bor sgom pa la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ thun mtshams kyi chos so/ /dang po (sbyor ba la )sngon 'gro sogs gong ltar la/ gtong len gyi gzhi byams snying rje bsgom dgos te/ de'ang thog mar rang gi rtsa ba'i ma mdun du yod par dmigs/ 'dis bdag lto na gnas pa nas bzung ste 'bad rtsol chen pos

blo spyong don bdun ma'i khrid yig byang chub gzhung lam/ 207bskyangs/ mo rang na tsha 'khyags ltogs thams cad bsran/ zas gos ster/ mi gtsang ba phyis/ bzang po bslabs/ ngan pa las bzlog pas da lta sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang mjal zhing chos sgrub tu yod pas shin tu drin che/ tshe 'di kho nar ma zad tshe rabs dpag tu med pa rnams su'ang de kho na ltar byas nas bdag gi don byas pas/ 'di rang 'khor bar 'khyams shing sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong ba snying rje snyam pa drag tu bsgom/ de nas kha tsam min pa'i snying rje skyes shing 'byongs nas rim par rgya je che la bslab ste/ sems can thams cad rtsa ba'i ma 'di ji lta ba bzhin du thog ma med pa nas mar ma gyur pa gcig kyang med/ phan ma btags pa med snyam pas thog mar skye sla ba mdza' bshes gnyen 'dun/ sdug bsngal shin tu che ba'i ngan song gsum/ nyam thag pa'i mi/ tshe 'dir skyid kyang shi ma thag dmyal bar 'gro ba'i sdig po che rnams la sgoms/ de 'byongs nas skye dka' ba gnod byed dgra dang gdon sogs la bsgom/ de nas sems can thams cad la bsgom/ bdag gi pha mas mi 'dod bzhin du sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong ba ma zad sdug bsngal gyi rgyu khams po che la longs spyod pa 'di rnams snying re rje/ ci tshugs bya/ da ni ngas kyang 'di rnams kyi drin lan du gnod pa bsal/ bde ba dang skyid pa byas nas phan gdags par bya'o snyam pa'i blo bsran mi bzod pa tsam du sbyong ngo / /gnyis pa (dngos gzhi )ni/gtong lenaganyisapo smrelgomarasbyang / /de nyid rlung lgobaskyonatebya/ /zhes gsungs te/ snying rje'i yul gyur pha ma de rnams la sdug bsngal gyis dngos su

208 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/gnod/ kun 'byung gis brgyud nas gnod pas/ ma'i rgyud la yod pa'i sdug bsngal sna tshogs pa dang kun 'byung las dang nyon mongs pa thams cad bdag gis blang bar bgyi'o snyam pas/ de rnams thams cad rang la byung bar bsgom zhing /byung na dga' ba'i 'dun pa drag tu bya/ bdag gi lus longs spyod dus gsum gyi dge ba dang bde ba thams cad pha ma sems can la lhos pa med par gtang bar bgyi'o snyam pas/ bde ba de rnams gzhan la re re bzhin thob par sgom zhing thob na dga' ba'i 'dun pa drag tu bya/ khyad par dmigs rnam gsal ba'i ched/ rang gi dbugs nang du rngub pa dang bstun sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sdug bsngal ci yod pa thams cad nag 'ub kyis bsdus/ sna sgo nas zhugs/ rang gi snying nang du thim pas sems can rnams sdig sdug dang gtan bral du song bar bsam/dbugs phyir 'gro ba na rang gi bde ba dang dge ba ci yod pa thams cad zla zer lta bu'i rnam pas sna sgo nas dkar lam gyis song / sems can thams cad la thim/de rnams 'phral de las sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bsam zhing dga' ba'ang bsgom/ de ltar rlung la gtong len bskyon pa 'di nyid thun gyi dngos gzhir byas te sbyang / phyis su'ang dran pas nam zin zin la nyams su len/ blo sbyong gi dngos gzhi 'di nyid yin te/ zhi ba lhas/bdag bde gzhan gyi sdug bsngal dag /yang dag brje bar ma byas na/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni mi 'grub cing / /'khor ba na yang bde ba med/ /

blo spyong don bdun ma'i khrid yig byang chub gzhung lam/ 209ces sogs rgya cher gsungs so/ /gsum pa thun mtshams kyi nyams len ni/kul gsum dug gsum dge rtsagasum/ /zhes pa ni/ yul yid du 'ong ba dang phan 'dogs pa la zhen chags/ yid du mi 'ong ba dang gnod byed la zhe sdang / bar ma la ci'ang mi bsam pa'i gti mug ste yul gsum la brten nas dug gsum rgyun chags su 'byung bas de ma thag ngos zin par byas la/ dper na 'dod chags skyes pa'i tshe/ sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa 'dod chags ji snyed pa thams cad bdag gi 'di la 'dus par gyur cigasems can thams cad 'dod chags med pa'i dge rtsa dang ldan par gyur cig de rnams kyi nyon mongs pa'i go bdag gi 'dis chod nas sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du nyon mongs pa dang bral bar gyur cig snyam du bsam/ zhe sdang sogs la'ang des 'gres te lam du khyer bas dug gsum dge ba'i rtsa ba mtha' yas pa gsum du wīr ro/ /spyod lam kunaspyotshig gisasbyongs/ /zhes pas dus thams cad du/bdag la de dag sdig smin cing / /bdag dge ma lus der smin shog /ces pa'i 'phags pa'i gsung ltar/ khe dang rgyal kha thams cad jo bo sems can pa

210 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/rnams la 'bul lo/ /gyong dang bub kha thams cad bdag gis blang bar bgyi'o zhes bka' gdams pa'i gsung sgros las byung ba dang / sems can rnams kyi sdig pa dang sdug bsngal thams cad bdag la smin cing / bdag gi dge ba dang bde ba thams cad sems can rnams la smin par gyur cig ces rgyal sras thogs med kyis gsungs te de lta bu gang rung brjod cing 'dun pa drag tu bya/lenawā'igo rim ranganagabartsam/ /zhes pas/ gzhan gyi sdug bsngal rang la len nus pa'i phyir go rim gyi thog mar rang nas brtsam ste/ rang la ma 'ongs par smin 'gyur gyi sdug bsngal thams cad da lta yid kyis blang la de byang nas gzhan gyi sdug bsngal rnams blang ngo / /gsum pa rkyen ngan byang chub kyi lam du bsgyur ba/sdodaya da sdig pasagangabamitshe/ /rkyen ga byangachub lam dubaskur/ /zhes gsungs te/ snod kyi dpal 'byor nyams pa dang bcud kyi sems can ma rung bas 'tshe ba sogs sdig pa'i 'bras bu sdug bsngal mang pos gang ba'i tshe/ thog tu babs pa'i rkyen ngan de dag byang chub lam du bsgyur dgos pas/ de la gsum/kun rdzob byang sems la brten pa/ don dam byang sems la brten pa/ spyod pa khyad par can la brten pa'o/ /dang po (kun rdzob byang sems la brten pa )ni/le lan thamasacad gcig labada'/ /

blo spyong don bdun ma'i khrid yig byang chub gzhung lam/ 211zhes pas/ rang gi lus la na tsha/ sems kyi sdug bsngal/ mi kha skur 'debs/dgra gyod kha mchu/ mdor na rang dang rang phyogs la mi 'dod pa che phra ci byung yang /'dis gnod pa byas so snyam pa'i le lan gzhan la mi bda' bar/ bdag med pa la bdag tu 'dzin pa'i sems 'dis 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas da lta ba'i bar du rang 'dod kho nas mi dge ba sna tshogs byas pa'i 'bras bu sdug bsngal 'di rnams thog tu babs pa yin pas gzhan su'ang ma lan gyi/ bdag gces 'dzin 'dis lan pas 'di gcig pu ci thul bya'o snyam pas chos thams cad bdag 'dzin gyi thog tu rtsal sprugs la gtang ste/ spyod 'jug las/'jig rten dag na 'tshe ba gang yod dang / /'jigs dang sdug bsngal ji snyed yod gyur pa/ /de kun bdag tu 'dzin pa las byung na/ /'dre chen 'di ko bdag la ci zhig bya/ /zhes dang /'di yis brgya phrag thams cad du / /'khor bar bdag la gnod pa byas/ /da ni 'khon rnams dran byas te/ /khyod kyi rang sems ngan pa gzhom/ /zhes rbe|gas gsungs rber+sha/ / kun labaka' drin che bar bsgom/ /

212 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/zhes pas/ spyir sangs rgyas sgrub pa ni yul sems can rnams la ma brten par sgrub pa'i thabs med pas byang chub 'dod pa'i gang zag la sangs rgyas dang sems can bka' drin mnyam/ khyad par sems can thams cad pha mar ma gyur pa gcig kyang med pas drin che/ yang sgos gnod byed la sogs pa 'di rnams bdag gi tshogs bsag dang sgrib sbyong gi grogs dang dpung gnyen yin pas shin tu bka' drin che snyam du bsam la gtong len bsgom/ tha na khyi dang 'bu srin yan chad la khong mi khro bar dngos su phan ci thogs la 'bad/ mi nus na sems can nam gnod byed 'di myur du sdug bsngal dang bral/ bde ba dang ldan/ sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par gyur cig snyam pas ngag tu'ang brjod/ yang da phyin chad bdag gis dge ba ci byed thams cad 'di'i don du bya'o snyam du sems bskyed/ lha 'dre la/thog ma med pa nas bdag gis 'di la gnod pa bskyal bas gnod pa byung / da res de'i lan du sha khrag la sogs pa sbyin no snyam pas gnod byed de'i mdun du rang lus blos gtang la/ bdag gi sha khrag la sogs pa gang 'dod la khyod kyis rol cig ces brjod cing blos lings kyis bskyur bas/ gnod byed des sha khrag sogs la longs spyad pas rgyud zag med kyi bde bas gang / byang chub kyi sems gnyis skyes par bsgom/ yang bdag gnyen po dang bral nas nyon mongs pa skyes pa ma tshor ba la gnod byed 'dis sbran pas 'di bla ma'am sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa yin nges te/ bdag gi byang chub kyi sems sbyong ba'i bskul ma byas pas shin tu bka' drin che snyam du bsam/ yang / nad dang sdug bsngal byung na/ 'di ma byung na bdag tshe 'di'i bya bas g.yeng ste chos mi dran par 'dug 'dis chos dran du bcug pas bla ma dkon mchog gi phrin las yin bka' drin che snyam du zhe thag pa nas bsam/

blo sbyong don bdun ma'i khrid yig byang chub gzhung lam/ 213mdor na rang don sgrub pa'i bsam sbyor su la yong ba de 'jig rten khyim pa yin cing / gzhan don sgrub pa'i bsam sbyor su la yod pa de chos pa yin pas/ glang ri thang pa'i zhal nas/ ngas ci tsam gyi chos zab mo zhig zhal phye ste bltas kyang skyon thams cad rang gi yin par 'dug yon tan thams cad jo bo sems can gyi yin par 'dug de'i gnad kas khe dang rgyal kha gzhan la sbyin/ gyong dang bub ka rang gis len pa 'di min pa go rgyu med gsungs so/ /gnyis pa (din dam byang sems la brten pa )ni/'khrul snang skubazhin ltabayi/ /stong nyid zungab blan med/ /ces gsungs te/ spyir snang ba thams cad dang / sgos rkyen ngan de'ang rmi lam du mes 'tshig pa'am chus khyer nas nyam thag pa ltar rang sems 'khrul ba'i snang ba mi bden pa la bden par bzung ba ste/ snang yang bden par grub pa rdul tsam yang med par thag bcad/ snang tsam de 'dzin med kyi ngang la bzhag pas ngo bo stong pa chos sku/ rnam pa gsal ba sprul sku/ de gnyis zung du 'jug pa longs sku/ de rnams dbyer med ngo bo nyid kyi sku ste/ skye 'gag gnas gsum ngos bzung dang bral ba'i ngang la mnyam par 'jog pa ni sku bzhi ngo sprod kyi gdams ngag lta ba'i go cha/ stong nyid kyi srung 'khor zhes 'khrul snang gcod pa'i man ngag bla na med pa'o/ /gsum pa (spyod pa khyad par can la brten pa )ni/spyor ba banildan thabasakyi mchog /

214 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/ces gsungs te/ de'ang tshogs bsags pa'i sbyor ba/ sdig pa bshags pa'i sbyor ba/ lha 'dre la gtor ma sbyin pa/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong la mchod gtor 'bul ba'i sbyor ba bzhi dang ldan pa ni rkyen ngan lam du byed pa'i thabs rnams kyi mchog yin/de la dang po ni/ bdag 'dod pa bde ba 'dod kyang 'ong ba sdug bsngal kho na 'ong ba 'dir sdug bsngal gyi rgyu sdig pa spang bde skyid kyi rgyu tshogs bsag pa'i brdar 'dug pas de ltar bya'o snyam pas bla ma dkon mchog la mchod pa/ dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur/ 'byung por gtor ma/ mar me/ swāsmo phyag bskor sogs lus ngag yidatshogasum gyis tshogs gsog ci 'grub dang / skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ khyad par yan lag bdun pa dang maṇ+ḍal la 'bad/ bdag na ba legs na na bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sos pa legs na sos par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ shi ba legs na shi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes re dogs 'gog pa'i gsol ba gdab bo/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'dun pa sngar ltar la/ sngar byas kyi sdig pa la 'gyod pa rnam par sun 'byin pa'i stobs/ phyin chad srog la bab kyang mi byed snyam pa nyes pa las ldog pa'i stobs/ dkon mchog la skyabs su 'gro zhing sems bskyed pa rten gyi stobs/ stong pa nyid bsgom pa dang gzungs sngags khyad par can bzla ba sogs gnyen po'i sgo drug la 'bad cing re dogs 'gog pa'i gsol 'debs byed pa gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs bzhi po tshad du longs par bya/gsum pa ni/ gnod byed la gtor ma sbyin nas khyed kyis sngar bdag gi lan chags bsnyag tu phyin cing bu lon khyer bar byas pa shin tu bka' drin che/ da dung bdag brlag par mdzad du gsol/ sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal mi

blo spyong don bdun ma'i khrid yig byang chub gzhung lam/ 215'dod pa nad byur chags nyam nga thams cad bdag la smin par mdzad du gsol/sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral bar mdzod cig ces phrin las bcol/ de ltar mi nus na/ gtor ma thongs/ byams snying rje gtong len sgoms la/ngas khyod la 'phral dang yun du gang phan pa bya yi/ nga'i chos kyi bar chad ma byed cig ces bka' sgos/bzhi pa ni/ chos skyong la gtor ma 'bul ba/ chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen zhi ba dang mthun rkyen 'grub pa'i phrin las bcol/ khyad par gong smos re dogs 'gog pa'i gsol 'debs bya'o/ /rkyen glo bur ba lam du lhong ba'i phyir/'phral la gabathug27(ma du sbyar/ /zhes pas glo bur du na tsha gdon bgegs nyon mongs pa sogs rang la byung ba'am/gzhan ma mi 'dod pas gtses pa mthong na gtong len kho na bya'o snyam pa dang / dge ba sogs rang gi bsam sbyor legs pa kun la sems can thams cad 'di bas kyang ches lhag pa'i chos kyi bya ba la ngang gis 'jug par gyur cig snyam pa dang /bde ba dang skyid pa byung na'ang de bzhin du sbyar/ gal te rnam rtog ngan pa skye ba'am dbang med du bya ba ngan pa la 'jug dgos pa byung na/ sems can thams cad kyi rnam rtog ngan pa'am bya ba ngan pa thams cad bdag gi 'di la 'dus par gyur cig snyam du bsam/ mdor na za nyal 'gro 'chag spyod lam ci byed kyang gzhan phan gyi bsam pas zin par byas nas/ 'phral rkyen bzang ngan gang thug kyang blo sbyong gi sgom kho nar sbyar bar bya'o/ / bzhi pa tshe gcig gi nyams len dril nas bstan pa la gnyis/ tshe 'dir ji

216 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/ltar bya ba dang / 'chi khar ji ltar bya ba'o/ /dang po 9 'dir ji ltar bya ba )ni/man ngagasnying po mdor bsdusapa/ /stobasalnga dag dngasbyar bar bya/ /zhes pa ste/ dam pa'i chos nyams su len pa'i man ngag zab dgu gcig dril nyams len gnad 'gag mdor bsdu na stobs lnga ste/ dang po 'phen pa'i stobs ni/dus 'di nas bzung ste sangs ma rgyas kyi bar dang / khyad par ma shi'i bar dang /sgos su lo 'di dang zla ba 'di/ yang sgos de ring nas sang gi bar du byang chub kyi sems gnyis dang gtan nas mi 'bral bar bya'o zhes blo'i 'phen pa drag po gtang /gnyis pa goms pa'i stobs ni/ spyod lam mam dge sdig lung ma bstan gyi bya ba ci zhig la 'jug gi 'dug kyang dran shes kyis krig gis bzung nas byang chub kyi sems gnyis dang ma bral bar yang dang du sbyang ba ste/ mdor na dge sbyor gyi gtso bo byang chub sems la bslab pa'o/ /gsum pa dkar po'i sa bon gyi stobs ni/ byang chub kyi sems skye ba dang 'phel ba'i don du dge ba la chog shes med par lus ngag yid gsum gyis dge ba la rtag tu 'bung ba'o/ /bzhi pa sun 'byin pa'i stobs ni/ bdag gces 'dzin gyi rnam rtog nam byung ba na/ sngar yang thog ma med pa nas 'khor bar 'khyams shing sdug bsngal sna tshogs myangs pa khyod kyis lan/ tshe 'dir yang sdig pa sdug bsngal ji snyed byung ba thams cad 'di kho nas lan/ da yang khyod dang 'grogs na skyid med/ da res 'di

blo sbyong don bdun ma'i khrid yig byang chub gzhung lam/ 217ci brlag ci thul bya dgos snyam pas bdag 'dzin gyi rnam rtog rgyangs kyis spang ba'o/ /lnga pa smon lam gyi stobs ni/ dge sbyor gang byed kyi gsham du/ spyir sems can thams cad bdag kho nas sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'dren nus par gyur cig khyad par dus 'di nas sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du byang chub kyi sems rin po che rnam pa gnyis rmi lam du'ang mi brjed cing gong du 'phel bar shog cig rkyen ngan ci byung yang byang chub sems kyi 〈snags su khyer nus par gyur cig ces zhe thag pa nas gdab cing / dge ba thams cad de'i don du bsngo bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa chos 'di'i lugs kyi 'da' kha ma'i gdams ngag ji ltar byed ce na/thegachen 'pho ba'i gdamasangagani/ /stobasalnga nyidawaṃn spyod lamabartes/ /zhes pa ste/ chos 'di la sbyangs pa'i gang zag 'chi nges pa'i nad kyis thebs pa'i tshe/ dang por yo byad ci yod pa thams cad spyir bla ma dkon mchog sgos rang nyid la phan yon 'di rang che snyam pa'i phyogs su gtang la/ chags zhen 'khri ba spu rtse tsam med par byed pa dkar po'i sa bon gyi stobs/ nus na yan lag bdun pa 'bul/ mi nus na'ang bdag gi dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ci yod pa'i mthus bdag gis skye ba thams cad du byang chub kyi sems rin po che mi brjed cing sbyang nas gong du 'phel bar gyur cig chos 'di ston pa'i bla ma yang dag pa dang mjal bar gyur cig de ltar 'grub par bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po ches byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes yid rtse gcig pas smon pa smon lam gyi stobs

218 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/dang / bdag gces 'dzin 'dis skye ba grangs med par sdug tu bcug da res kyang 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal myong / don dam par bdag dang sems ma grub pas 'chi rgyu med/ na'o 'chi'o bsam pa'i bdag 'dzin khyod ci nas brlag par bya'o snyam pa sogs sun 'byin pa'i stobs dang / 'chi kha dang / bar do dang / skye ba thams cad du byang chub kyi sems rin po che rnam pa gnyis dang mi 'bral bar bya'o snyam pa 'phen pa'i stobs dang / sngar bsgoms pa'i byang chub kyi sems gnyis po gsal 'debs pa ni goms pa'i stobs yin pas/ gtso bo de dag rtse gcig tu bya zhing grogs su spyod lam yang gces te lus gnad chos bdun nam/ mi nus na gzhogs g.yas 'og tu bcug lag pa g.yas la 'gram pa brten pa'i mthe'u chung gis sna bug g.yas bkag rlung g.yon nas rgyu bar byos la byams snying rje sngon du 'gro bas rlung 'gro 'ong dang sbyar te gtong len sbyang / de'i rjes la 'khor 'das skye 'chi la sogs pa thams cad sems snang yin/ sems nyid cir yang ma grub par shes pa'i ngang la blos cir yang mi 'dzin par bzhag de dag gi ngang la dbugs 'gro nus par bya'o/ /'chi kha'i gdams ngag 'ud che ba mang ste 'di las ngo mtshar ba med gsungs/ 'gron bu ma nyams pa'i sreg thal dang rdo khab len gyi phye ma gnyis sbrang spyon la sbyar ba spyi bor byug pa'ang rdzas kyi 'pho ba'i man ngag yin no/ /lnga pa blo 'byongs pa'i tshad bstan pa ni/chosakunadagosapabartegasgyu 'dus/ /zhes gsungs te/ theg pa che chung gi chos thams cad kyi dgos pa ni bdag 'dzin 'dul ba gcig pur 'dus pas/ chos byed bzhin blo sbyong sgom bzhin bdag

blo spyong don bdun ma'i khrid yig byang chub gzhung lam/ 219gces 'dzin je chung du 'gro dgos/ bdag 'dzin gyi gnyen por ma song na chos byas tshad don med du song ba yin/ chos chos su 'gro mi 'gro'i rtsa ba 'di la thug pas 'di chos pa srang la 'jal ba'i rgya ma yin gsungs/dpangasho gnyisakyigakho bo gzung / /zhes pa ni gzhan dag gis chos pa tshad ldan du mthong ba yang dpang po yin mod kyi/rang blo lkog gyur 'jig rten phal pas mi rtogs/ spyod lam legs pa sna res kyang mgu bar srid/ rang sems rang la ma khrel ba zhig rtag tu byung na blo 'byongs pa'i rtags yin pas/ gzhan gyi dpang po la chags mi 'jog par rang sems kyi dpang po gtso bor bzung ngo / /midabade 'ba' zhigargyun du brten/ /zhes pa ni/ rkyen ngan sdug bsngal ci byung yang 'jigs skrag yi mug nam yang mi skye bar/ blo sbyong gi grogs su song nas yid bde 'ba' zhig pa dang rgyun du 'grogs pa ni blo 'byangs pa'i tshad yin pas rkyen ngan gang byung yang de la dga' ba bsgom nas/ de 'i steng du gzhan gyi rkyen ngan thams cad kyang dga' bzhin du len pa la bslab par bya'o/ /yengasakyang thaban 'byangasapa yin/ /zhes pa ni/ dper na rta rtsal can de yengs kyang rta las mi lhung ba ltar glo bur du rkyen ngan byung ba na ched gtad dran pas ma bzung yang rkyen ngan de nyid blo sbyong gi

220 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/grogs su 'gro thub na 'byangs pa ste/ dgra gnyen gnod byed bde sdug ci snang thams cad kyi steng du byang chub kyi sems gnyis rtsol med lhang lhang skye ba'o/ /bzhi po de byang chub sems 'byangs shing gnad du song ba'i rtags yin gyi/ sbyang mi dgos pa'i rtags yin zer ba min pas sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du gong 'phel la bslab bo/ / drug pa blo sbyong gi dam tshig ni/sbyidon gsumal rtag cabaslab/ /ces gsungs te/ spyi don gsum ni/ blo sbyong khas blangs dang ma 'gal ba ste/ so thar byang sems sngags kyi bslab pa phra mo tshun chad rang gis gang blang ba la nyes lhung gi dri mas ma gos pa dang / tho cor ma shor ba ste/ bdag gces 'dzin med pa gzhan gyis go ru re bas lha rten bshig pa/ shing gnyan gcod pa/ chu gnyan dkrug pa/ mdze sprang dang 'grogs pa sogs tho co'i spyod pa spangs te rnam thar gtsang sing nge bar bya ba dang / phyogs rer ma lhung ba ste/ mi'i gnod pa bzod lha 'dre'i gnod pa mi bzod pa dang / de go ldog pa dang / gnyen la bzod dgra la mi bzod pa dang / de rnams la bzod kyang na tsha sogs sdug bsngal la mi bzod pa dang / de thams cad bzod kyang skyid thog tu chos 'chor ba sogs blo sbyong phyogs re ba spang ba dam tshig yin pas rtag tu bslab par bya'o/ /'dunasnga bsgyur la rang sor gzhag /ces pa ni/ sngar rang gces gzhan mi gces pa'i 'dun pa de go ldog tu bsgyur la

blo sbyong don bdun ma'i khrid yig byang chub gzhung lam/ 221gzhan don kho na gces par gzung / blo sbyong thams cad mngon tshan chung la sa chod che ba zhig bya dgos pas/ phyi'i spyod lam chos mthun gyi grogs po gzhan rnams dang 'dra bar rang so thub par gzhag la gzhan gyis ma tshor bar rgyud smin pa zhig bya'o/ /man lam nyamasayabarjod mi bya/ /zhes pas/ gzhan la 'jig rten gyi skyon zhar ba glen pa la sogs pa dang chos kyi skyon sdom pa nyams pa sogs mi snyan pa'i tshig mi brjod par/ zhi dal 'dzum dang bcas pas 'thad cing yid la 'bab pa'i tshig brjod do/ /gzhan phyogasagangaspang mibasam mo /zhes gzhan phyogs sems can spyi dang khyad par chos sgor zhugs pa gang gi'ang skyon mi bsam ste/ skyon mthong ba de nga rang gi snang ba ma dag pas lan/ khong la de 'dra med/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la'ang skyon du mthong ba kha cig byung ba dang 'dra snyam du bsam la rang blo skyon can tshar gcad par bya'o/ /nyon mopasagabache sngon la sbyang / /zhes rang rgyud la nyon mongs gang che brtag la/ thog mar de'i steng du chos thams cad spungs nas 'dul zhing sbyang bar bya/'brasabur re ba thamasacadasnyung / /

222 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/zhes blo sbyong bsgom pas lha 'dre thul du re ba dang rang bzang por mthong du re bas gnod lan du phan gdags pa sogs tshul 'chos yin pas spang ste/ mdor na tshe 'di'i bde skyid snyan grags/ phyi ma lha mi'i bde ba rang nyid mya ngan las 'das pa thob 'dod sogs rang don yid byed kyi 'bras bu la re ba thams cad spang ngo / /dugacan gyizasaspang /zhes pa ni/ dngos po bden 'dzin dang bdag gces 'dzin gyis kun nas bslangs pa'i dge sbyor thams cad zas dug can dang mtshungs pas spang la/ 'dzin med sgyu ma lta bu la bslab lngasto/ /gzhung bzabapo mabasten/zhes pa ni/ dper na 'jig rten pa'i mi gzhung bzang po can des sa phyogs dus tshod ci tsam song yang rang la ltos pa'i mi brjed pa med pa de bzhin du rang la gnod pa byas pa la 'khon du bzung nas 'khon 'jin de las nam yang mi ldog pa spang la/gnod pa'i lan du slar yang phan dgos pa'i bsam sbyor dang ldan par bya'o / /shag ngan ma rgod/ces pa ni spyir gzhan gyi mtshang 'bru ba la dga' bar mi bya/ sgos su pha rol pos rang la tshig ngan smras pa'i lan du gzhan la gnod pa'i tshig mi smra bar ma zad/nyes pa byung na'ang 'dis lan mi smra bar nam yang gzhan gyi yon tan bsngags pa la brtson par bya'o/ /

blo spyong don bdun ma'i khrid yig byang chub gzhung lam/ 223'phrabam skugs/zhes pas/ gzhan gyi gnod pa byas pa zhe la bzhag nas lo mang po 'oston kyang ma brjed par gnod lan 'khyol ba'i 'phrang byung dus gnod skyel ba de spang nas gnod lan du phan gang thogs gdags pa ste/ gdon gyi gnod pa lta bu la'ang gnod 'dzin mi bya bar byams snying rje 'ba' zhig sgoms/gnad la mi dbab/ces mi'i skyon mtshang nas 'bru ba sogs gnad la bkar ba'i tshig dang mi ma yin pa'i srog sngags 'dren pa sogs gzhan sems la zug rngu bskyed pa'i tshig mi brjod/ mdzo khal glang la mi 'byo/zhes pas/ rang la babs pa'i khag ngan gzhan la bskur ba dang rang thog babs pa'i bya dka' ba g.yo sgyus gzhan gyi steng du bsgyur na/ mdzo'i khal glang la byo ba lta bu ste de ltar mi bya/maskyogasakyirtse migartade/ces rta rgyug pa'i tshe su mgyogs la blo rtse gtod pa bzhin chos pa 'dra 'dra'i nang du rnyed bkur snyan grags sogs rang la lhag par 'ong du re ba dang / zang zing gi rnyed pa thob pa'i thabs sna tshogs la brtson pa'i bsam sbyor spang ste/ rnyed bkur snyan

224 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/grags byung ma byung la khyad med par bya'o/ /sto mthog mi bya/zhes pas phugs rang bzang bar 'dod nas 'phral pham kha len pa dang nad gdon zhi ba dang rkyen ngan pa bzlog tu re nas blo sbyong byed na/ lto bcos bon gyer bzhin du log pa'i chos su song ba yin pas/ de ltar mi bya bar skyid sdug gang byung yang re dogs snyem 'phrig spang ste sgoms/ rgyal sras thogs med zhal nas/ tshan gcig gis rnam rtog la blo sbyong ba 'di 'dre gdon la phan pa'i thabs zhig tu go ba 'dra ste/de tsugs byed na ngan byed pa dang khyad med/ chos bya ba nyon mongs pa dang rnam rtog gi gnyen por 'gro ba zhig dgos pa yin gsungs/ 'dis mtshon nas chos log zer ba'ang rtag chad du lta ba lta log mchog 'dzin gyi sgom pa sgom log sdom pa gsum dang mi mthun pa spyod log ste/ dam pa'i chos tshad ma nas gsungs pa'i lta spyod dang 'gal ba rang gzhan mchog dman su la yod kyang chos log zer zhing 'bor ba dang ngan song du 'phen pa yin te/ dper na gcod log gam/ nad la sman log ces pa lta bu'o/ /gang zag kha cig gis sbyar ba'am/ gter nas byung ba 'ga' zhig chos log red ces brtsams chos dang gter chos de dag yang dag dang log pa gang yin min le'u gcig gi tshig don la'ang ma dpyad par smra ba ni/ grub mtha' rang rang gi zhen phyogs sam gang zag gi gnas skabs la ltos nas bsgrags par snang mod/ gang zag gi rgyud tshod sangs rgyas ma gtogs gzhan gyis mi bzung bar gsungs pas/ lta spyod tshad dang ldan phyin gang zag de la rang ma mgu yang de tsam gyis chos log tu bsgrub mi nus te/ dper na gser bzang po dang 'dra

blo sbyong don bdun ma'i khrid yig byang chub gzhung lam/ 225min gnyis tshong pa po mchog dman gyi khyad par med pa bzhin no/ /des na sangs rgyas kyi zhal nas gang zag la mi rton chos la rton zhes yang yang bka' bstsal pa ste/ 'di'ang go ba gal cher snang ba ni 'phros su smos pa'o/ /lhabadud du mi dbab/ces pas blo sbyong sgom bzhin nga rgyal dang rlom sems byas te rang rgyud rengs na/ lha bdud du babs pa dang 'dra bar chos chos min du song ba yin pas/ chos sam blo sbyong ci tsam sgom bzhin rang rgyud je thul du 'gro bar byas te kun la bran gyi tha ma ltar bya'o/ /skyid kyispun lagasgyu sdug ma 'tshole/ /zhes yon bdag sogs la na tsha shi chad byung na zas nor 'ong / grwa rogs grogs mched shi na dpe cha lha rten 'ong / rang dang mnyam pa shi na nga gcig pu la bsod nams 'ong / dgra shi na legs snyam pa sogs mdor na rang skyid pa'i yan lag tu gzhan la mi 'dod pa sdug bsngal 'ong du re ba spang bar bya dgos so/ /bdun pa blo sbyong gi bslab bya bstan pa ni/rnal 'byor thamasacadagasagagisabya/ /zhes gsungs te/ zas za ba/ gos gyon pa/ nyal ba/ 'a11 'dug la sogs pa thams cad gzhan la phan gdags pa'i bsam pa dang mi 'bral ba'i rnal 'byor gcig pus lam du khyer/

226 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/logaganon thamagacadabacugagisabya/ /zhes dpyad kyi log gnon du dpyad rang bya ba bzhin/ blo sbyong sgom pa'i tshe na tsha rkyen ngan mang ba/ mi kha bskur 'debs zug pa/ 'dre gdon dgra gyod kyis 'tshe ba/rang gi nyon mongs pa che ru song ba/ sgom snying mi 'dod pa sogs byung na/ 'jig rten gyi khams na bdag gi nyes pa 'di lta bu byung ba'i sems can mang po yod pas de rnams snying re rje snyam du bsam la/ mi 'dod pa 'di'i steng du sems can thams cad kyi mi 'dod pa'i sdug bsngal thams cad 'du bar gyur cig snyam du bdag gzhan brje ba'i log gnon gcig pu bya'o/ /thobaltamatha'aganyizla(la bya ba gnyis/ /zhes pas thog ma nangs par ldang ma thag pa'i tshe/ de ring byang chub kyi sems gnyis dang mi 'bral bar bya'o snyam pa'i 'phen pa shugs drag po gtang / nyin mo'ang dran pa rgyun chags kyis zin par byas/ mthar do nub nyal ba na de ring gi bsam sbyor rnams la brtags te byang chub kyi sems dang 'gal ba byung na rang la ngan bgrang ste bshag pa dang / phyin chad de ltar mi 'byung ba'i dam bca' bya/ ma 'gal bar 'dug na dga' ba bsgom zhing phyin chad rang gzhan thams cad de las ches lhag pa la 'jug nus pa'i smon lam gdab pa ste bya ba gnyis po del dus rgyun du bslab/ nyes lhung sdom pa sogs la'ang bsam 'dun de bzhin du bya'o/ /gnyisapogang byungabazodasngar bya/ /

blo spyong don bdun ma'i khrid yig byang chub gzhung lam/ 227zhes rang nyid shin tu sdug bsngal ba dang nyam thag pa byung na'ang sngon las su bsam ste zhe 'khang sems sdug mi bya bar gzhan gyi sdig sdug thams cad len zhing sdig sgrib sbyong ba'i thabs la 'bad/ 'khor dang longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa sogs bde skyid cher byung na'ang bag med btang snyoms kyi dbang du mi gtang bar nor dge phyogs su gtang / dbang thang dge bar bsgyur/ sems can thams cad bde skyid dang ldan par smon lam gdab/ mdor na bde sdug gnyis po gang byung yang bzod par bya/gnyisapo sgrogadababaskosanasabasrung / / zhes sdom pa gsum sogs chos spyi'i bslab bya dang blo sbyong gi sgos kyi bslab bya dang dam tshig tshul bzhin srung ba las 'di phyi'i bde ba thams cad 'byung bas dam tshig de gnyi sa srog dang bsdos nas bsrung / de'ang ci byed rang don gyi rnam rtog gi 'khri ba ma zhugs par gzhan phan gyi bsam pa kho nas bsrung ngo / /dka'abagasum la bslab par bya/ /zhes pa ni/ nyon mongs pa dang por ngo shes par dka'/ bar du bzlog par dka'/mthar rgyun gcod par dka' bas/ dang por skye ma thag nyon mongs pa yin pa ngos zin par bya/ bar du gnyen po'i stobs bskyed nas spang / mthar phyin chad 'di lta bu gtan nas mi 'byung bar bya snyam pa'i zhe bcad de gsum po la bslab par bya'o/ /rgyuwaṃgakhobo rnamagasum blang / /

228 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/zhes chos sgrub pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo bla ma bzang po dang / rang gi blo las su rung bas chos tshul bzhin nyams su lon pa dang / zas gos sogs chos sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen 'dzoms pa ste de gsum rang la 'dzoms na dga' ba bsgom/ gzhan la'ang de gsum tshang bar smon lam gdab/ ma tshang na gzhan la snying rje bsgom/ sems can thams cad kyi rgyu'i gtso bo ma tshang ba thams cad rang la spungs te blang / rang gzhan thams cad de gsum dang ldan par smon lam gdab/nyamasapa med pa rnam gsum bsgom/ /zhes pa ni theg pa chen po'i chos kyi yon tan thams cad bla ma la rag las pas bla mar mos gus nyams pa med pa dang / blo sbyong theg chen chos kyi yang snying yin pas blo sbyong sgom pa la spro ba nyams pa med pa dang / sdom gsum gyi bslab bya nyams pa med pa rnam pa gsum la bslab bo/ /'bral medagasum dang ldan par bya/ /zhes dus rtag tu lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig pa spang zhing dge ba'i rtsa ba 'bral ba med pa dang ldan par bya'o/ /kul la phyogasamedadagatu༄kha / /khyab dang gting 'byongagakun labartes/ /zhes yul la phyogs ris med par sems can dang / 'byung ba bzhi sogs sems can ma yin pa dang / mi ma yin sogs blo yul du bzang ngan gang shar thams cad

blo sbyong don bdun ma'i khrid yig byang chub gzhung lam/ 229la blo sbyong kho nas khyab par bya ba dang / de'ang kha tsam tshig tsam ma yin par gting nas 'byang bar bya ba gces so/ /bkol brnamasalartagasgyu bsgom/ /zhes blo sbyong dka' ba'i yul sdang ba'i dgra/ gnod pa'i bgegs/ khyad par rang gis phan btags pa'i lan du gnod pa byed pa'i log sgrub mkhan dang / rang gi 'gran zlar 'dug pa/ lhan cig tu 'grogs pa/ zhe 'gras med kyang rang bzhin gyis gnod pa/ las kyi dbang gis snying du mi sdug pa sogs la lhag par byams snying rje rtsal du bton nas bsgom mo/ /bla ma dang pha ma sogs yul gnyan po la gnod par 'gyur ba'ang khyad par du spang ngo / /rkyen gzhan dag la stosami bya/ /zhes khams bzang ngan dang / longs spyod dkon mod dang / mi kha byams mi byams dang / gnod pa yod med sogs rkyen bzang ngan gang la'ang rag ma las par/mthun rkyen 'dzoms na 'dzoms thog tu blo sbyong / ma 'dzoms na ma 'dzoms pa de nyid kyi thog tu byang chub kyi sems gnyis sgom pa ste/ mdor na rang gzhan la mi ltos par blo sbyong gi rnal 'byor dang rtag tu mi 'bral ba'o/ /da resagatsobo nyamasasu blab/ /zhes thog ma med pa nas lus grangs med pa blangs pa thams cad don med kho nar song / phyis nas kyang mthun rkyen 'dzoms pa 'di 'dra mi 'ong bas/ da res mi lus

230 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/thob/ yang dag pa'i chos dang mjal ba'i skabs 'dir tshe rabs gtan gyi 'dun ma 'grub pa'i don gyi gtso bo zhig nyams su blang dgos/ de'ang tshe 'di'i don las phyi ma'i don gtso che/ phyi ma'ang 'khor ba las thar pa gtso/ rang don las gzhan don gtso/ chos bshad sgrub gnyis las sgrub pa gces/ sgrub pa gzhan las byang chub kyi sems sbyong ba gtso/ de'ang lung rigs kyi dpyad sgom las bla ma'i man ngag phur tshugs su sgom pa gtso/ spyod lam gzhan las mal du bsdad nas sbyong ba gtso che'o/ /spyote zugag mi bya/zhes pa ni go log drug spang ba ste/ chos sgrub pa'i dka' spyad mi bzod par dgra 'dul gnyen skyong zhing las tshong khe sogs kyi sdug bsngal bzod pa bzod pa go log chos rnam dag sgrub pa la 'dun pa mi byed par tshe 'di'i bde skyid dpal 'byor la 'dun pa byed pa 'dun pa go log thos bsam sgom gsum gyi ro mi myong bar zang zing longs spyod kyi ro myong ba ro myong go log sdig pa byed pa la snying rje mi byed par chos phyir dka' thub byed pa la snying rje bsgom pa snying rje go log rang la ltos pa'i mi chos la mi sbyor bar tshe 'di'i che thabs la sbyor ba gnyer sems go log 'khor 'das kyi bde skyid dang dge ba la dga' ba mi sgom par gzhan la mi bde ba dang dgra la sdug bsngal byung ba la dga' ba sgom pa rjes su yi rang go log ste/ drug po de rnam pa kun tu spang bar bya'o/ /reb('jog :khabya/

blo sbyong don bdun ma'i khrid yig byang chub gzhung lam/ 231zhes res 'ga' byed/ res 'ga' mi byed pa de chos la nges shes ma skyes pa yin pas blo sna mi mang bar rtse gcig tu blo sbyong bar bya/dol chod du sbyang /zhes rnam g.yeng dang ma 'brel bar blo sbyong kho nar blo lings kyis bskyur la phyogs gcig tu sbyang /rtog dbyod gnyisakyisathar bar bya/ /zhes rang rgyud la rgyun du rtog cing dpyod pa gnyis kyis nyon mongs dang bdag 'dzin las thar bar bya dgos te/ de'ang rang rgyud la nyon mongs pa skye ba'i yul yid la byas te drag tu skye mi skye brtag skye na gnyen po drag tu bsten/ yang gces 'dzin ci 'dra 'dug blta/ gal te med pa ltar 'dug na chags sdang gi yul zhig brten la brtag de'i tshe gces 'dzin skye bar 'dug na bdag gzhan brje ba'i gnyen pos de ma thag spang ngo /kutha(ma lha/mas/zhes pha rol po la rang gi drin yod kyang yus che mi bya ste bdag bas gzhan gces sgom pa'i phyir dang / mkhas pa dang btsun pa dang chos nyams su blangs nas dka' thub yun ring byas pa sogs rang don yin pas gzhan la yus bya don med pa'i phyir/ yus gzhan la mi tshong ngo / mi la re ba ma che lha la gsol ba thob bya ba rwa sgreng pa'i bka' yin gsungs/

232 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/ko long mi sdom/ zhes gzhan la phrag dog gi bsam pa mi bya/ gzhan gyis rang la mi mang sar dma' 'bebs pa dang gnod pa byed pa sogs la lan mi bya zhing sems rgyud 'khrug pa spang / po to ba'i zhal nas/ 'o skol chos pa rnams chos bdag 'dzin gyi gnyen por ma song bas/ bzod bsran sha'u bas chung / ko long gtsang btsan bas dam par gda' ste/ des chos kyi go mi chod/ bdag 'dzin gyi gnyen por 'gro ba zhig dgos gan+da/ngas/kud tsam pa mibya/zhes cung zad tsam res dga' mi dga'i rnam 'gyur ston pa ste grogs kyi sems la gzan pa mi bya/'or che ma 'dod/ces pas rang gis chos nyams su blangs pa dang / gzhan la phan btags pa dang /dge ba'i las byas pa sogs la gzhan gyi 'or che'i tshig gi gtang rag 'byung du re ba mi bya ste/ mdor na snyan grags yong du re ba spang ba'o/ /de ltar bslab bya de rnams ni blo sbyong mi nyams shing gong 'phel du 'gyur ba'i thabs yin la/ mdor na rgyal sras rin po ches/ tshe hril gyis byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis po mnyam brje gnyis kyi sgo nas legs par sbyangs nas/ 'byangs pa'i gdeng 'thob par bya'o zhes gdams pa ltar 'bad do/ /

blo sbyong don bdun ma'i khrad yig byang chub gzhung lam/233snyigasam lnga bo bdoba'adiyi// byathatso lam duzlo/ji ba nadi//mnangaṭ+wāṃbadud ngapo ṭ+wāṃ//gser ngaspranasabargyud pa na/ /dzhaisapani dus dung/sesnasasdunadang rkye/snro dang /nyon mo/zlo dī dang /lta byā'i gas ma lngatram̐ dbas ba'i ba' matram̐n na ṭ+wāṃnyung/ 'aXn mthu~Xpa shan kyā mang bas chas snazhan gya gnyen pas ma bab pa n+d+ra/'ibla sbyang mkhanazhi la na ngan+d+ra sdu tsam mang ba ban dge sbyor 'phel ba dper na shang ca tsam mang byān me lce phya phyara'aphelab ltar/menyon tram̐ngs dung rkyen ngan ziX ༷da byang chub kya lam kho nar byisgyur byā gzhan la ) pa'altidachas/dbang zlo'i kaugan+d+ra man thazis ca) rdzu ༵na thags shang rgyudal 'byaraḍi'amanajeg dīdudahūṃXpahūm̐bu'ad/ ja ba s+t+ri ma rnazi gaḍim spyar+sha nas rdzuchag tu sku na ba ja ba gar glang pa nas brgyud pa' zab chas yan na sa pa'//sngonasbyangasalasakyi 'phro sad pas//r+pāgi mosapa mang ba'i rgyus//sdug brdzu/ gtog ṭ+wāṃdabahanas//ba//rten /dul ba gdamasangagazhus//da sprupa 'gyodado//zhes pa ni/dge ba'i bzhes gnyen chen po 'chad kha ba nyid sngon gyi las 'phro sad

234 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/nas/ chos 'di kho na la thugs mos pas dka' spyad chen pos chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba rang sems bdag 'dzin 'dul ba'i gdams ngag 'di nyid/ jo bo yab sras kyi bka' bathre/da las zhus 3|nga thugs legs par sbyangs pas/ bdag bas gzhan gces kyi thugs rang 'dod kyi 'khri ba gtan nas med pa skyes te/ chos sgor zhugs pa'i don 'bras mthar thug pa grub cing gdeng thob pas shi yang 'gyod pa med pa'o/ /sh+lau ka phyi ma'adi gnyis gzhung mdzad pa pos mjug sdud pa'i gsung yin no/ /gnyis pa brgyud pa'i gdams pas kha skong ba ni/ de ltar blo sbyong gi chos zab mo 'di rang nyid gcig pur 'dug na skyo rogs yin te bde sdug thams cad blo sbyong kho nas lam du khyer chog pa ma zad/ chos zab mor lam ngan lhongs nas sems lhong du/ 'gro na sdod snying 'dod/ sdod na 'gro snying 'dod pa sogs byung na 'di ltar bsgom ste/khyod kyi gshis lugs 'di 'dra na/ /gnas mal 'di yang yang rab yin/ /blo sems 'di yang bde mo yin/ /gzhan du khyod kyi sdug bsran 'dis/ /dmya04 bar ma skre)sa kha rje che/ /btso sreg ma myong kha rje che/ /zhes dang /

blo sgrong don bdun ma'i khrid yig byang chub gzhung lam/ 235gzhan yang 'jigs pa rab bsam ste/ /bdag la khrel bdas chen po bya/ /lto la gyong bskur dka' thub bya/ /gos la gyong bskur dman cha blang / /bde sdug khyad gsad gnyen po bsgom/ /zhes sems dpa'i rim pa las gsungs pa ltar rang la shags 'debs gnad du 'gro bar bya'o/ /na ba'i tshe na nad g.yog yin te/ de'ang sman pa/ nad g.yogamadza' bshes sogs la 'di las drag pa zhig byed thang snyam sems yus pa'i dus su/ na ba 'di gzhan sus kyang ma lan bdag 'dzin kho nas lan/ sman dang nad g.yog gis phan na sngar 'di ma byas snyam pa med rung su'ang 'jigs pa 'di las ma thar/ da res bdag 'dzin khyod la 'di mkho bas snying tshim snyam du bsam la/de'i steng du gzhan gyi nad gdon sogs lan pa la bslab bo/ /gzhan yang jo bo gser gling pa'i gsung las/ rtog pa thams cad 'bur 'joms te / /gnyen po thams cad bcom brdeg yin/ /'dun ma thams cad chig 'dril te/ /lam rnams thams cad gcig chod yin/ /gnyen po rnam byang gi chos bzhi ste/ /mtha' 'khob 'dul na dgos pa yin/ /

236 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/'bor ngan log sgrub bzod pa ni/ /snyigs ma'i dus su mkho ba yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ rnam rtog skyes ma thag blo sbyong ngam stong nyid kyi ngang du 'bur 'joms bya/ gnyen po thams cad phyi nas dal bus bsgom pa ma yin par nyon mongs skyes ma thag thog brdzi blo brdeg tu bcom/ 'phral phugs kyi 'dun ma sna kha mang po mi gshom par sems la gang phan dang bdag 'dzin brlag ci thub gcig pur bsgril/ bdag 'dzin dang nam bral na sangs rgyas pa yin pas lam gcig chod des lam rim pa brtsi mi dgos/ rnam par byang ba'i phyogs kyi gnyen po thams cad bsdu na chos bzhi po 'dir 'dus pa'o/ /rkyen ngan dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin/ /'dre gdon rgyal ba'i sprul pa yin/ /na tsha sdig sgrib kyi phyags shing yin/ /sdug bsngal chos nyid kyi yo langs yin/ /kun nas nyon mongs kyi chos bzhi ste/ /mtha' 'khob 'dul na dgos pa yin/ /'bor ngan log sgrub bzod pa la/ /snyigs ma'i dus su mkho ba yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ rkyen ngan la brten nas tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong / dam pa'i chos dran pa/ rtogs pa la bogs 'don pa sogs dge ba 'i bshes gnyen gyi bya ba byed

blo sbyong don bdun ma'i khrid yig byang chub gzhung lam/ 237par 'gyur bas rkyen ngan spang mi dgos/ lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul dang gdon gyi gnod pa byung na/ dge sbyor dang thugs dam 'phel ba'i grogs su 'gyur bas bla ma dang sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa yin pas 'jigs mi dgos/ dam chos tshul bzhin sgrub pa la sngon gyi las ngan slong bas lus la na tsha sna tshogs 'byung yang 'byung la/ byung ba de'ang nad tshabs chen po lta ci smos/ chung ngu klad pa na ba tsam gyis kyang thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad phyags mas 'ded pa ltar 'dag pa mdo las yang yang gsungs pas nad la dga' ba ba〈snam/ sems la sdug bsngal byung na sdug bsngal de'i ngo bo la bltas pas stong nyid du 'char/ sdug bsngal ci tsam che rung chos nyid kyi yo langs yin pas yid zhum pa mi dgos/ de rnams byung na byung bas bzang ste nyams len gyi grogs su khyer chog pas kun nas nyon mongs pa'i chos bzhi mi spang nyams su blang ba'i gdams ngag go /skyid kyi gnya' gnon chen po yin/ /sdug gi mjug sdud chen po yin/ /mi mkho shos ni 'dod thog yin/ /ltas ngan g.yang du len pa yin/ /gnyen po log gnon gyi chos bzhi ste / /mtha' 'khob 'dul na dgos pa yin/ /'khor ngan log sgrub bzod pa la/ /snyigs ma'i dus su mkho ba yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ lus sems bde zhing skyid na chos min bya ba sna tshogs byed 'dod

238 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/du 'ong bas/ skyid par snyam pa'i ngo bo la bltas pas dngos por ma grub/ skyid par snang ba tsam de sems can rnams la sbyin nas lam du khyer/ skyid snang de'i dbang du mi gtang bar rang tshod thub par byas pas skyid kyi gnya' gnon yin/ sdug bsngal byung na yi mug mi bya bar ngo bo la bltas pas stong par yal/ sdug snang de'i steng du sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa blang zhing rang tshod thub par byas pas sdug bsngal mtha' dag gi mjug sdud pa yin/ mi mkho mi 'dod pa thams cad thog tu babs na bdag gces 'dzin brlag pa'i grogs bsam thog 'dod thog yin/ bdag 'dzin khyod la 'di rang mkho/ 'di cis kyang brlag tu chug cig snyam blo bde 'bol gyis gzhag ltas ngan dang cho 'phrul byung na ci lan/ gang drag snyam pa'i rnam rtog sna tshogs 'char/ de'i tshe 'di dgos rgyu yin/ byung ba legs/bdag gces 'dzin 'di'i steng du ltas ngan thams cad spungs shig snyam du snyem 'phrig med par gzhag gnyen po gzhan gyis ma thul ba'i log gnon gyi chos bzhi'o/ /bdag ni skyon gyi rtsa ba ste/ /rgyangs kyis bskyur ba'i chos shig yin/ /gzhan ni yon tan gyi 'byung khungs te/ /bcangs te len pa'i chos shig yin/ /gnyen po mjug sdud kyi chos gnyis te/ /mtha' 'khob 'dul na dgos pa yin/ /'khor ngan log sgrub bzod pa la/ /snyigs ma'i dus su mkho ba yin/ /

blo sbyong don bdun ma'i khrid yig byang chub gzhung lam/ 239zhes gsungs te/ mdor na blo sbyong gi rtsa ba thams cad rang don rgyang du bskyur ba dang / gzhan don bcangs te 'jug pa gnyis la 'dus pas khrid kyi mjug don bsdus pa yin pa'i phyir nyams len gyi rtsa bar bzung ngo / /log cer logs la cer cer ltos/ /shig ge bshig la 'bol le zhog /des ni mi 'ching grol bar 'dod/ /ces pa ni nyon mongs pa dang rnam rtog phra rags gang shar byung yang de'i rjes su 'brang nas sems phyi ru yengs na tha mal pa dang khyad med par lam log par 'gyur bas/ kha nang du cer gyis log nas ngo bo la cer gyis blta/ bltas pas ma mthong ba'i stong nyid de'i ngang du shig ger bzhig lhod kyis glod la bzhag pas rnam rtog nyon mongs ci tsam mang rung mi 'ching zhing rang grol ye shes kyi tshogs su 'gyur ba ste/ don dam byang sems kyi sgom rim snying po'o/ /de ltar jo bo rje lha gcig gi bka' srol las byon pa'i blo sbyong gi gdams ngag brgyud pa so so'i khrid srol ji snyed cig bzhugs pa'i nyams len gyi gnad don thams cad don bdun gyi gzhung 'dir 'du bas/ khrid yig rgyas bsdus mang po dang / de 'chad pa po mtha' yas par bzhugs pa las/ khyad par 'phags pa rgyal sras rin po che thogs med zhabs dang rje btsun kun dga' snying po'i khrid yig dag las khrid tshul zhib mor thob par/ skyes chen zung gi gsung gi bdud rtsi'i nying khu gcig tu bsdus te las dang po bas go sla gtsor bton/ gzhan phan gyi bsam pa bzang po kho nas 'dus gsal du bsdebs pa'o/ /

240 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/mdo sngags lam gyi rtsa ba ste/ /dam chos kun gyi snying po'i bcud/ /zab cing nyams su blang bde ba/ /khrid tshul kun las rmad du byung / /zab chos 'di 'dra thos pa dka'/ /thos nas nyams su len pa dka'/ /'di spyod bsod nams nor ldan pa/ / deng sang sa steng gser bzhin dkon/ /co des na smra mang ngal ba'i rgyu/ /'on kyang gzhan phan lhag bsam gyis/ /'di byas dge bas lus can kun/ /byang chub sems gnyis 'byong bar shog /ces pa'ang rang slob lnga rig pa kame mthu stobs kyis ring nas bskul zhing nye char byang chub kyi sems rin po che la mi 'phrog pa'i 'dun pas g.yar dam 'cha' ba mchog gi sprul pa'i sku karma thabs mkhas rnam rol dang / bla ma karma nges don sogs sgrub la gzhol ba'i skal ldan rnams kyi thugs dam gsal 'debs su/bzhed bskul nan bcar gyi ngor byams mgon karma si tu'i 'bangs blo gros mtha' yas kyis/ dpal spungs yang dben kun bzang bde chen 'od gsal gling du sbyar bas 'gro ba mtha' yas pa la phan par gyur cig dge legs 'phel// //

blo sbyong brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dad pa'i gdung sel/༄tsho/ /thub pa'i dbang po rgyal tshab byams pa dang / /'phags pa thogs med mkhas mchog dbyig gi gnyen/ /grol sde rnam gnyis gu ṇa mi tra dang / /seṅge bzang po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /byams dang snying rje byang chub sems 'byongs shing / /blos btang zlog sgom nus par byin gyis rlobs/ /gang spel ku sā li pa che chung dang / /gser gling pa dang mgon po a ti sha/ /'brom ston po to ba dang sha ra ba/ /rnal 'byor 'chad kha ba la gsol ba 'debs/ /byams dang snying rje byang chub sems 'byongs shing / /blos btang zlog sgom nus par byin gyis rlobs/ /spyil bu pa dang 'od zer bla ma dang / /lha sdings byang chub 'bum pa kun rgyal mtshan/ /yon tan dpal ba mkhan chen bde ba dpal/ /bka' bzhi grags pa gzhon nur gsol ba 'debs/ /byams dang snying rje byang chub sems 'byongs shing / /blos btang zlog sgom nus par byin gyis rlobs/ /byang sems bsod grags thogs med bzang po dpal/ /yon tan blo gros gzhon nu blo gros dang / /paṇa chen shāka mchog kun dga' mchog grub mtshan/ /rje btsun grol mchog zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /byams dang snying rje byang chub sems 'byongs shing / /blos btang zlog sgomanus par byin gyis rlobs/ /lung rigs rgyamatsho kun mkhyen sgrol ba'i mgon/ /rgyal tshab rnam gnyis rnal 'byor yon tan mgon/ /mgon po dpal 'byor mgon po grags pa'i mtshan/ /mgon po rnam par rgyal la gsol ba 'debs/ /byams

242 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/dang snying rje byang chub sems 'byongs shing / /blos btang zlog sgom nus par byin gyis rlobs/ /tshe dbang nor bu phrin las shing rta'i zhabs/ /bstan pa'i nyin byed grub brnyes blo gros mtshan/ /karma lhag mthong gzhan phan 'od zer rje/ /blo gros mtha' yas zhabs la garber+shal ba 'debs/ /byams dang snying rje byang chub sems 'byongs shing / /blos btang zlog sgom nus par byin gyis rlobs/ /mkha' khyab rdo rje zhi ba'i snying po'i zhabs/ /pad+ma dbang mchog mkhyen brtse 'od zer sde/ /nyams rtogs mthar phyin nor bu don kun grub/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /byams dang snying rje byang chub sems 'byongs shing / /blos btang zlog sgom nus par byin gyis rlobs/ /sras bcas rgyal ba'i thuḍa rje gcig bsdus sku/ /'brel tshad don ldan mtshungs med chos kyi rje/ /brgyud srol kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /snying khong rus pa'i gting nas gsol ba 'debs/ /byams dang snying rje byang chub sems 'byongs shing / /blos btang zlog sgom nus par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhen log nges 'byung gnyis pos gzhi bzung nas/ /theg chen lam las phyir mi ldog pa'i gsang / /yang dag byang chub sems mchog rnam pa gnyis/ /skyes brtan gong du 'phel bar byin gyis rlobs/ /chos brgyad rmang bskyel bdag 'dzin rtsad nas chod/ /gzhan gces gting nas 'byongs te ci snang kun/ /byang chub lam gyi grogs su khyer nus pa'i/ /blo sbyong mtha' ru phyin par byin gyis rlobs/ /don dam skye 'gag gnas bral stong nyid dang / /kun rdzob rten 'brel sgyu ma'i tshul rtogs nas/ /srid pa ji srid mkha' khyab 'gro ba'i don/ /lhun grub thams cad gzigs par bdag gyur cig /ces blo sbyong khrid yig gi yan lag tu blo gros mtha' yas kyis so / //

blo sbyong smon lam byang sems rgya mtsho'i 'jug ngogs/༄7/ /'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs dbang dang / /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /thugs bskyed mthar phyin bden pa yis/ /bdag gzhan mkha' mnyam 'gro kun la/ /byang chub sems mchog skye bar shog /sems can zhe sdang la zhugs dang / /tsha grang dmyal ba myong ba yi/ /sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras bdag la thim/ /bdag gi byams pa'i sems dang ni/ /zhe sdang med pa'i dge rtsa rnams/ /nam mkha' mnyam pa'i 'gro la sbyin/ /zhe sdang dmyal ba'i gnas stongs nas/ /rdo rje rigs kyi spyan ras gzigs/ /me long ye shes mchog thob shog /ser sna 'dod chags la zhugs dang / /yi dwags bkres skom myong ba yi/ /sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras bdag la thim/ /bdag gi sbong ba'i sems dang ni/ /'dod chags med pa'i dge rtsa rnams/ /nam mkha' mnyam pa'i 'gro la sbyin/ /ser sna yi dwags gnas stongs nas/ /pad+ma rigs kyi spyan ras gzigs/ /sor rtog ye shes mchog thob shog /gti mug spyod la zhugs rnams dang / /dud 'gro glen zhing lkugs pa yi/ /sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras bdag la thim/ /bdag gi skyes sbyangs shes rab dang / /gti mug med pa'i dge rtsa rnams/ /nam mkha' mnyam pa'i 'gro la sbyin/ /gti mug dud 'gro'i gnas stongs nas/ /bde gshegs rigs kyi spyan ras gzigs/ /chos dbyings ye shes mchog thob shog /phrag dog khong nas 'khrugs rnams dang / /'thab cing rtsod pa'i lha min gyi/ /sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras bdag la thim/ /bdag gi sgo gsum bzod pa dang / /phrag dog med pa'i dge rtsa rnams/ /nam mkha' mnyam

244 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/pa'i 'gro la sbyin/ /'thab rtsod lha min gnas stongs nas/ /las kyi rigs kyi spyan ras gzigs/ /bya grub ye shes mchog thob shog /nga rgyal sems kyis non rnams dang / /pham lhung myong ba'i lha rnams kyi/ /sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras bdag la thim/ /bdag gi brtson 'grus brtsams pa dang / /nga rgyal med pa'i dge rtsa rnams/ /nam mkha' mnyam pa'i 'gro la sbyin/ /pham lhung lha yi gnas stongs nas/ /rin chen rigs kyi spyan ras gzigs/ /mnyam nyid ye shes mchog thob shog /thog med las sgrib ji snyed dang / /skye rga na 'chi 'khor ba yi/ /sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras bdag la thim/ /bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum gyis/ /thog med nas bsags dge rtsa rnams/ /nam mkha' mnyam pa'i 'gro la sbyin/ /brel phongs mi yi gnas stongs nas/ /chos sku dri med spyan ras gzigs/ /rang byung ye shes mchog thob shog /so thar byang sems gsang sngags kyi/ /nyams chag nyes lhung bdag la thim/ /bdag gi sdom gsum bsrungs pa'i dge /nam mkha' mnyam pa'i 'gro la sbyin/ /sdom gsum rnam par dag gyur nas/ /nyams pa'i dri tsam mi 'byung bar/ /rigs 'dus rdo rje sems thob shog /srog bcad rten gsum gzhig gzhom sogs/ /tshe thung las sgrib bdag la thim/ /rten gsum bzhengs dang srog bskyabs dge /nam mkha' mnyam pa'i 'gro la sbyin/ /dus min 'chi ba'i ming mi grags/ /rdo rje tshe dpag med 'thob shog /rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa sogs/ /'gro ba'i nad kun bdag la thim/ /rdog rdung spangs dang sman sbyin sogs/ /nad med bde skyid dge rtsa rnams/ /nam mkha' mnyam pa'i 'gro la sbyin/ /dug gsum nad sel sman gyi bla/ /be+e ḍār+ya 'od sku thob shog /rku 'phrog ma byin blangs pa yis/ /bkres skom dbul phongs bdag la thim/ /chos nor sbyin 'bras ji snyed pa/ /nam mkha' mnyam pa'i 'gro la

blo sbyong smon lam/ 245sbyin/ /'dod dgu 'bad med lhun grub pa/ /nam mkha' mdzod la longs sbyod shog /mi dge 'ba' zhig byas pa yis/ /ma dag zhing du skye ba yi/ /las sgrib ji snyed bdag la thim/ /sems bskyed 'gyur ba bcu la sogs/ /nam mkha' mnyam pa'i 'gro la sbyin/ /kun kyang mngon dga' bde ldan sogs/ /dag zhing kho nar skye bar shog /log lta 'ba' zhig bsgoms pa yis/ /dkon mchog mnyes par mi bgyid pa'i/ /las sgrib ji snyed bdag la spyin/ /dad pa rnam gsum dge rtsa sogs/ /nam mkha' mnyam pa'i 'gro la sbyin/ /bslu med las dang 'bras bu la/ /yid ches khong nas brdol ba yis/ /dge sgrub sdig spong byed par shog /bdag 'dzin 'ba' zhig goms pa yis/ /rang snang dgra ru lta ba yi/ /chags sdang ma lus bdag la thim/ /tshad med bzhi yi dge rtsa rnams/ /nam mkha' mnyam pa'i 'gro la sbyin/ /kun kyang byams pa snying rje dang / /dga' ba btang snyoms sems ldan rberteg /'khrul snang bden par 'dzin pa'i sems/ /sdug bsngal 'byung khungs bdag la thim/ /stong zhing bdag med rtogs pa ni/ /nam mkha' mnyam pa'i 'gro la sbyin/ /stong nyid zab mo rgyud la skyes/ /rdzogs sangs go 'phang mchog thob shog /mdor na 'jigs pa bcu drug sogs/ /mi 'dod pa dang 'phrad pa dang / /nye du zas nor gnas grogs sogs/ /'dod pa rnams dang bral ba dang / /dgra 'dul gnyen skyong so nam sogs/ /yod pa bskyang gis mi long dang / /mnga' thang longs spyod snyan grags sogs/ /med pa btsal gyis mi rnyed dang / /bar chad glo bur ye 'drogs sogs/ /'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal ji snyed pa/ /bdag gi bdag 'dzin steng du len/ /dus gsum dge ba'i dngos kun dang / /kha rje dbang thang lus srog bcas/ /ltos pa med par 'gro la spyin/ /sems can thams cad bde

246 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/ skyid ldan/ /byang chub spyod la 'jug par shog /bdag gis chos bshad dge bskul dang / /sha zos zho 'thung bzhon pa zhon/ /bdag la dad gus zas nor sbyin/ /ma dad log lta skur 'debs dang / /'phrog bcom rdeg rdung ngan sems 'chang / /bzang ngan las kyis 'brel ba sogs/ /mdor na bdag lus mthong ba dang / /bdag gi ming thos skyon yon dran/ /rlung rdzis reg pa'i 'gro kun kyang / /thog med sdig sgrib zad nas ni/ /'phags mchog thugs rje chen po yis/ /bde ba can du 'dren par shog /bdag gi sgo gsum bya spyod dang / /lus kyi dri ma tshun chad kyis/ /'gro phan kho na byed nus shog /bdag gi lus srog la 'tshe ba'i/ /mi dang mi min gnod sems can/ /thog ma kho nar 'tshang rgya shog /bdag la brten nas cung zad kyang / /sdig pa'i 'bras bur ma gyur cig /rmi lam chu zla smig rgyu ltar/ /brtag na bden par ma grub pa/ /bdag 'dzin 'di yis thams cad bslus/ /bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro kun dang / /gdon bgegs mi ma yin la sogs/ /don dam stong pa nyid du mnyam/ /stong la bden zhen byed pa 'khrul/ /kun rdzob pha mar ma gyur med/ /'jig rten dag na pha ma las/ /drin che ba ni gang zhig yod/ /ma bur gnod sems 'chang ba 'khrul/ /de bas pha ma sems can ni/ /phyogs ris med pa'i drin dran pas/ /khe dang rgyal kha gzhan la sbyin/ /gyong dang bub kha rang la len/ /bdag gi lhag bsam 'di yi mthus/ /thams cad sgrib sbyang tshogs rdzogs shing / /byang chub sems mchog rin po che/ /stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can/ /phyin ci ma log rgyal ba'i lam/ /bde blag nyid du skyes nas kyang / /rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas myur 'thob shog /ces pa'ang blo sbyong la mos pa lam du byed pa'i blo gros mtha' yas kyis dben pa'i ri ngogs su snying nas smon pa dge// //sarba maṅga lam̐//

dpe skrun smon tshigarig pa'i rdo rje gsung rab mdzod khang nas/ /blo gros mtha' yas mdzod kyi lde mig ces/ /deb phreng 'phrul gyi par du bskrun pa'i dges/ /kun gyi blo gros gter sgo rang dgar 'byed/ /rig pa'i nor bu rigs drug thang mar brdal/ /ma rig rmongs pa'i dbul ba ring du bcil/ /gsung rab rgya mtsho'i brjod don kha yi rlangs/ /mtha' yas skye 'gro'i blo yi mkha' la 'thul/ /rtogs pa'i chu ris snying rje'i sprin du 'khrigs/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i mdzad 'phrin char du bsnyil/ /las nyon mi gtsang dri ma dag par bkrus/ /mngon mtho'i ljang pa lang 'tsho rab tu smin/ /mngon rtogs lam gyi skya rengs ngang gis shar/ /sgrib gnyis mun pa'i go skabs dbyings su nub/ /kun mkhyen rta bdun dbang pos mdun bsus nas/ /chos kyi 'bror lo'i 'od zer 'bum du spros/ /ma lus sdug kun ljan ljin rab tu skem/ /

248 dpe skrun smon tshiga'aphags pa'i tshogs kyi pad tshal ci dgar bzhad/ /mchog gsum snang ba mi nub rtag tu brtan/ /rdzogs ldan dpal yon nam mkha'i spun zlar shar/ /snyigs ma'i rgud cesags mtha' dag cig car zhi/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bus 'dzin ma'i khyon kun gang / /chos kyi sbyin bdag mnga' thang 'byor pa rgyas/ /zab rgyas rgyu mthun chos sku yun du gnas/ /'gro kun bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rnam rgyal ba'i/ /'bras bu chos sku'i go 'phang mngon byed shog /ces pa'ang blo gros mtha' yas pa'i mdzod ces pa'i deb phreng rim byon gyi dpe skrun smon tshig tu 'jam mgon bla brang gi mkhan po'i ming tsam 'dzin pa blo gros rnam rgyal ne gis/ phyi lo 2008 zla 1 tshes 15 nyin bris pa dge'o// //

sko/ /'jamamagonakongasprulaskuphrengadangapoyon tan rgyamatsho'am blogrosamatha'ayabasani/ langagashegasalas/ deyi'ogatubyasadusal/ /'dren pa blogrosazhebyab/ /shes byalngarnamasaston pa po/ /dpa'abochen po'abyungabara'agyur/ /zhegasal ba sogasamadorgyudadu mnasalungagisabasngagasapa bzhin snyigasadusa'aba'imagonapoganganyidatha mala'ajigarten phal ba'isnangangodangamathun paraskye ba sprupa'izlosagarabasgyuratshulani/ rababyungabacubazhi pa'ichubyaspyilo 181 3 loramakhamasa'abri zla zab mosgangaduskubaltamasashing/ byamasamagon si tupad+manyin byedabangapodangargyal dbangakarmapa theg mchogardo rje sogasarisamed skyesachen du mazhabasal gtugasatetha snyadarig gnasadang/ mdorgyudadagongasa'agrel man ngabacas parathosabasamasgom pa mtharaphyin paragyur/ skutshesmad kyidusatshod phal chedapalaspungasayangakhrodasgrub khangatsā 'drarinachen bragatu bzhugasanasartse gcig sgrupa la gzhol b.ramadzad/ gsungartsomagatsobomadzodachen lngasabasdus pa'ipod grang100 lhagacam bzhugs/ thugasasrasagatsoborgyaladabangakarmapa mkha'akhyabardo dngami pham 'jam dbyangasarnamargyalasogasa'agran bral gyi skye chen bgrangalasa'adarababyungabacolnga pa'isaphagaspyilo1899loragazugasasku'i bkod pa zhi dbyings bsdutshul bstanato/ / smubye༄/ (7 rdzespyo—lge—spro py-irtesta ji4watwestobyengasti༄zhu 7lkedaX ske ko sdukhu /rnye trī/༷༷ ༷༷ —wa〉〉 3/she 7po9mori ri)cid+ku ) /war+sha r+sha( tshosdewardzo ༄ risderdo sku trī siriri ོrnge spugekāwa77wa/ shā/༄ phaphro7wa/snye/ju rwa gi gi pa dza pa pa pa'i sde/
